reviews.text:
I have visited many McDonald’s locations, but unfortunately, my experience at the Times Square location was the worst I’ve ever had.

It was early in the morning, and I just wanted a quick breakfast. I ordered my food and went upstairs to eat. A few minutes later, my fiancée began to feel unwell, so I quickly stepped out to a nearby pharmacy to get her some medication. When I returned just a few minutes later, a security guard stopped me and asked if I had ordered food. I explained that I had already ordered and had the receipt, but I needed a moment to find it.

Instead of listening, he repeatedly asked if I was going to order and kept pointing at the kiosk. It seemed like he did not understand what I was saying. I calmly told him, “Sir, you’re not listening to me,” but he then got angry, and again, pointed to a sign about the 30-minute limit time, which was not relevant to the situation. I was simply trying to explain that I had a brief emergency and needed to step out for a few minutes.

All of this happened while I was searching for my receipt, and I was not given the chance to calmly find it. Once I showed the receipt, he allowed me upstairs without saying anything and simply pointed toward the stairs.

The entire situation felt unnecessary and could have been avoided with better communication. I understand that Times Square is very busy, and I respect that rules need to be enforced. However, a little patience and basic communication would have made a big difference.

I simply wanted to enjoy a quick breakfast and leave. Emergencies do happen, and customers should be treated with understanding and professionalism in those moments.

God forbid if you ever have an emergency, because if you do, this security guard will give you a harder time than what you already have.
reviews.author: WarriorOfPeace

reviews.text:
Waited 30 minutes for a cone ice cream despite following up twice — unacceptable service.
I ordered a cone through the self-service kiosk at 8:44 PM. No receipt was printed, but I waited near the counter assuming the order was in the system.
By 9:05 PM, after waiting over 20 minutes, nothing had been prepared. I saw other customers receive assistance after speaking with staff, so I approached a male staff member and explained that I had been waiting since 8:44. He said he would check.
By 9:14 PM, my order still had not come out. I returned again, showed my card payment history, and explained that I had now been waiting 30 minutes for an ice cream. Only then did he contact the ice cream station, and I finally received my order.
The staff member did not hand me the item himself and asked another employee to do so.
This was not an issue of the store being busy. An ice cream taking 30 minutes with multiple follow-ups reflects poor communication and inadequate customer service.
reviews.author: DABIN PARK

reviews.text:
I had a really disappointing experience at this location. First of all, the setup doesn’t work for the volume of people coming through — it’s in the middle of Times Square but completely unprepared for the crowds. There was no system in place to manage lines or assist customers, and the few employees behind the counter were overwhelmed and unresponsive to questions, directing everyone to the self-serve kiosks.

The food was subpar: stale fries, chewy chicken nuggets, no ice, and no ketchup or sauces available. To make it worse, no napkins were stocked, and the bathroom had no soap. Basic things like cleanliness, condiments, and customer service were just missing entirely.

If you’re in the area, I’d recommend avoid this spot.

I've lived in this Maccas. I've been dragged out of this Maccas. I've hung out at this Maccas. I've eaten at this Maccas. I have early childhood memories of this Maccas. Yet another McDonald’s joint... this place has gone through many facelifts and is set to go through yet another soon. I don't really eat here much anymore, but I find it to be very intimidating to navigate and stand to wait for what I ordered due to the door maiden being extra demanding and bossy.

I get a very nostalgic feeling from this place whenever I go. Usually years go by between visits and I'm always surprised both at seeing the new shopfront and changes made as well as how much it has stayed the same. Most of my favorite burgers have long split the scene. No matter how much things change here or what comes or goes, there's always something for everyone here.

I suppose when I'm 70 if I still live here in the 09, I'll probably start walking around the Maccas at 5am until it opens... do they still do that? I don't know.

reviews.text:
I have visited this branch multiple times, usually on weekends, and have consistently received good service. I always order takeaway, typically bringing the food home by bicycle. I usually order one large drink and two or three small ones, and until now, the staff have always packed the large drink separately and grouped the small ones together, which made it easy and safe to carry.

However, this morning (Thursday), I visited during breakfast hours for the first time and was extremely disappointed. The large and small drinks were all packed together in a single bag without proper care. On my way home, one of the small drink lids came off inside the bag, spilling the drink all over my hands, feet, and even my face. This was not only messy but completely ruined my morning before I could even eat.

I don’t know whether this happened because the staff was careless or because they were not properly trained, but either way, it’s unacceptable. I hope management seriously looks into this and ensures that proper packing procedures are followed in the future. I never want to go through something like this again.

reviews.text:
I am a loyal and frequent customer of this location and visit nearly every morning. The treatment I received was unacceptable.

On December 25, 2025, I placed an online order for pickup at Restaurant 39148. When I arrived, the restaurant was closed due to Christmas. I fully understand holiday closures. However, the online ordering system did not indicate that this location was closed or unavailable for pickup, resulting in payment for an order I could not receive.

I returned the following morning to retrieve my order or request a refund. Instead of assistance, I was met with hostility and accusations of dishonesty from the managers on duty. I was told I was lying because they claimed no orders were received the prior day. Even after presenting clear proof of purchase and payment from my debit card, I continued to be treated as though I was attempting to defraud the company.

One manager walked away from the register in visible frustration before completing my order. Another manager’s demeanor implied that I was stealing from the brand. The tone set by management caused the entire staff to treat me with suspicion. I was humiliated and discredited in front of others, despite being a daily customer of this location.

I clearly stated that I was willing to accept a refund. My concern is not the food but the conduct. Accusing a customer of dishonesty, disregarding documented proof, and responding with contempt reflects a serious failure in leadership and customer service.

McDonald’s is a respected global brand, and this experience fell far below its standards. I am requesting a review of this incident and appropriate corrective action to ensure customers are treated with professionalism and respect.
reviews.author: Mariah Kamara (Naomi)

reviews.text:
The food was great, and the service was exceptional—exactly what you’d expect from a global brand. However, something in the store left me shocked and deeply hurt.

On the wall map, Kashmir was shown as part of another country. I want to ask—who designed or approved this map? How can such a serious misrepresentation be displayed so casually in a global outlet?

Let me be clear:
Kashmir was a part of India, is a part of India, and will always be a part of India.

This kind of error is not just incorrect—it’s offensive and disrespectful to the sovereignty and sentiments of millions of Indians. I urge McDonald’s global management to take immediate action to correct the map and ensure this does not happen again. As a global brand, you have a responsibility to be accurate and sensitive to geopolitical realities.

Please treat this issue with the seriousness it deserves.

reviews.text:
: ★☆☆☆☆

I recently had the displeasure of dining at McDonald's in Edinburgh, and I must say that my experience was nothing short of a complete disappointment. From the slow and inefficient service to the abysmal quality of the food, my visit left me feeling utterly unsatisfied.

First and foremost, the service at this particular McDonald's was excruciatingly slow. Despite the relatively small number of customers, it seemed as though the staff were moving in slow motion. It took an unreasonably long time for my order to be taken, and even longer for it to be prepared and brought to my table. The lack of urgency and attentiveness was quite frustrating, especially considering the reputation of fast food establishments.

When my order finally arrived, I was immediately taken aback by the dismal quality of the food. The burgers were cold, as if they had been sitting out for an extended period of time before being served. The patties were overcooked and resembled charred hockey pucks, lacking any semblance of juiciness or flavor. It was clear that attention to detail and basic quality control were sorely lacking in the kitchen.

To add insult to injury, my burgers were completely devoid of any sauce. Not only did this significantly detract from the taste, but it also left me questioning the competence of the kitchen staff. How can a restaurant as renowned as McDonald's overlook such a basic element of their signature burgers? It was a glaring oversight that further contributed to my disappointment.

The chips, or rather, the sorry excuse for chips, were another letdown. They were clearly old and tasted stale. The once-crisp exterior had been replaced by a sad and limp texture, leaving me with a distinct feeling that I was eating a hollow shell of what should have been a satisfying side dish. It was a far cry from the hot and crispy chips one would expect from a fast food establishment.

Overall, my experience at McDonald's Edinburgh was a colossal letdown. The slow service, coupled with the cold, burnt burgers and the absence of sauce, left me with a strong sense of dissatisfaction. The sad excuse for chips further added to my disappointment. It's disheartening to witness such a renowned fast food chain fail so miserably in delivering the quality and service they are known for. Needless to say, I will not be returning to this particular McDonald's anytime soon.

Ps atleast serve some Tomato sauce or clean the trash cans!!

When I asked, “What did you put on this?” she said it was chocolate powder. I requested a new one, and she said “okay,” but then proceeded to make her colleague’s soy latte instead of mine. I naturally assumed she was making my latte.

When I pointed out, “This is not soy latte,” she replied, “I’ll make yours,” but continued to make her colleague’s drink first, and then my latte was made very poorly.

Worst McDonald's I've been to in a very long time.

*Edit
I have since returned to this McDonald's and have had a much better experience. Maybe that one visit was just an off day or maybe there was a change in management. Whatever the reason, I hate to pigeon hole a place based on 1 visit. I will eat here again as it's close to home, and let you all know how it goes. Upgrading from 1 to 3 stars.

Edit* I ordered a cone which immediately fell apart all over my hands. She grabbed a cup and put it in there and thought that was sufficient. I asked for a new one. She disappeared for a minute anf gave me the same cone in a cup and said it was new. I'm done with this McDonald's. 0 stars

reviews.text:
I ordered two Big Mac “no meat” burgers and one large Coca-Cola, but instead I was given Big Macs with meat. This is completely unacceptable, as I am a pure vegetarian. Unfortunately, I even ate part of the burgers by mistake because I trusted the restaurant and was confident they would prepare my order correctly. This broke my trust completely, and now I will have to check my food every time before eating, which should not be necessary when ordering from a professional restaurant.

When I spoke to the manager, Prabh, he agreed to make the burgers again but refused to provide a refund. He told me I could either have the burgers remade or get a refund, but not both. This is very poor customer service. A refund should have been given along with the correct order as compensation for the serious mistake.

Mistakes can happen, but how they are handled shows how much a business respects its customers. Serving meat to a vegetarian is a very big mistake, and I hope the restaurant takes this seriously and improves its service to ensure this never happens again.

There is no need for a place that serves food to ever have garbage overflowing all over the place. It's a real shame that I have to give you own star. If I  could I'd give you a zero .

Firstly, I got a burger served to me with a large hole in the meat.
I told the lady that the burger isn't very appetising and showed her and she said oh ok is it the hole? Did you want another one? No apology. Then I just took the new burger quietly and said ok mistakes happen but then I ordered an ice-cream with flake. I ordered it to be delivered to the table as wasn't feeling well. I needed to rest so I ordered it to the table.
Time passed and noone was coming so I had no choice to get up and ask.
The ice cream had been sitting on the bench melting because she was too lazy to walk to my table which wasn't far from the front counter.
She gave me a small cup with an ice-cream upside down melted and the flake was buried inside it somewhere. The icecream was a mess and I told her but she just  couldn't be bothered. I have been giving feedback before and I don't know why I was stupid to go back and today was my last day.
They have lazy staff with a bad attitude , no customer service skills, dirty premises and poor attention to detail with food preparation and lack of hygiene. Today going to the queen st  McDonald's was a stressful and disappointing experience for the last time. you could not pay me to go back there.
I'm completely done with McDonalds and I can honestly say that this McDonald's in Brisbane is an embarrassment to the McDonald's company. Good riddance

reviews.text:
Today is my birthday, and I came to dine with my friends. When I returned from the restroom, I discovered that my order was missing both the ice cream and the drink. I went to the counter to report the issue. After returning to my seat and opening my burger, I found that the Chicken Mac I ordered had been replaced with a beef burger. I do not eat beef, so I immediately went back to the counter. I showed the staff my receipt and the opened burger, clearly explaining that I ordered a Chicken Mac and was given a beef burger.

What happened next was absolutely unacceptable. The staff member looked directly at the beef burger in my hand and insisted, “This is the chicken burger.” I had to hold back my anger and told her again, “This is a beef burger.” It is unbelievable that an employee at McDonald’s cannot tell the difference between a fried chicken patty and a beef patty.

It only became even more ridiculous when another employee walked by and the staff member stopped her to ask, while pointing at my burger, “Is this a chicken burger?” The other employee immediately replied, “That’s a beef burger,” and replaced it with the correct order. This clearly shows that the initial staff member had no idea what she was talking about.

This is a serious issue with employee training. If she wasn’t sure, she should have confirmed with another staff member instead of confidently giving wrong information. And frankly, it is shocking that McDonald’s employees would need to be reminded of something as basic as distinguishing chicken from beef. I never expected that I would have to point out such a fundamental mistake. It completely ruined my birthday dining experience.

reviews.text: The food at this McDonald’s was fresh and my order came out really quickly, with nothing missing, which I appreciated. Ordering was easy and fast, so that part of the experience was great. My drink and ice cream weren’t filled up all the way, and they also weren’t using the correct cups for frozen drinks, which was a bit disappointing. The tables in the dining area were quite dirty and could use more regular cleaning. On a positive note, the bins weren’t overflowing as they were being changed regularly, and the napkin dispensers around the store were well stocked, which is really convenient as you don’t have to ask for more. Finding the toilets was a bit confusing since there aren’t any clear signs, and while the toilets themselves were somewhat clean, the mirrors were noticeably dirty. Overall, the food and speed of service were good, but the cleanliness and attention to detail could definitely be improved.
reviews.author: Ashlee Aird

reviews.text:
I've been to many, many McDonalds on 4 different continents in my 66 years. This one was terrible. The worst.

Initially tried ordering at the kiosk and it kicked me out twice. Stood in line and was served. Paid but did not get a receipt but saw the charge go through my credit card. Waited for a bit then said to the lady that served me that I did not get a number or receipt. She said I hadn't paid. I said yes I had and she said I hadn't. At that point I was pretty frustrated so just paid again under protest. A few minutes later she called me over and said I had paid and processed a refund. No apology. A refund did finally come through my credit card, several days after the two charges.

I know people make mistakes and I know people have bad days but that server was just plain rude. Will NEVER be going back.
reviews.author: Tony Moore

reviews.text:
I recently ordered a Happy Meal expecting it to include the advertised toy, but instead, I received a drawing book without any prior notice or explanation. There were no signs in the store indicating that the toys were out of stock, and the staff did not acknowledge the issue or offer an apology.

While I understand that inventory shortages can happen, it would have been reasonable for the staff to at least inform customers before ordering or express some understanding of the disappointment. Transparency and basic customer service would have made the situation much more acceptable.

I hope this feedback can help improve the experience for future customers.

Clearly, the chef was working off the rule 'how much sauce does it take to ruin a burger.' Thank you for your 'thoughtful' service, showing me that a burger can indeed 'drink' sauce! Next time, could you provide a straw? Just in case I end up having to drink the sauce! If your goal was to make customers eat messily, well, congratulations, you’ve succeeded!

I was travelling late at night from London to Scotland and felt very hungry, so I ordered a Big Mac, a toffee latte, and a melon bag. I selected table service and waited for nearly half an hour, but nothing arrived. So, I went to the till area and stood there waiting for a staff member, but no one came.

Then, a security guard approached me very rudely and asked why I was standing there. He was extremely disrespectful. A few minutes later, a staff member finally came, and I explained that my order was missing. They gave me the food, but the melon bag was missing, and the toffee latte was not hot.

This has been the worst experience I’ve ever had at McDonald’s. After a long journey, everything was closed, there was no access to a bathroom, part of my order was missing, and the security staff were especially disrespectful. Please provide better service in the future.

reviews.text:
I have shopped at this McDonald's many times. I have never had a problem before. This morning one of the servers behaved dishonestly. I eat here because I pressed a button, but despite this, he wanted to give me my cocoa and food without my wallet. When I told the guy that I wanted the tray, the lady came over arrogantly and asked me what my problem was. I told him. He took me at my word. I told him that if I wanted food here, he had to give me a tray. There were about six customers in the morning, there was not much traffic. I asked her by her name, Cassie's name plate. She was about 30 years old, a short woman with blonde hair, with a ponytail. In the future, I will not come here again because of this unsightly service. In addition, while they were busy writing the review, they laughed in a rude and inappropriate way.

And the cocoa tasted like water.

reviews.text: I'm a senior in need of a knee replacement, and the regular toilets are up 4 flights of stairs. I asked a server where the disabled toilet was, and if there was a code. He said there wasn't one- the only one was upstairs. After eating, I checked the main floor and there was a disabled toilet about 20 feet from where I was sitting. It was unlocked, so I went in. When I was in there, someone came and knocked. I said hello, and the door was rattling. I said occupied, and it sounded like someone was about to use a key. I went to the door and shouted occupied, and he said "it sounds like someone is in there". When I came out, there was a little girl and her brother standing there waiting. They looked like they could have climbed the stairs. So no disabled toilet for seniors, but children are allowed?? Ridiculous!

reviews.text:
Do not visit unless you want to potentially be locked inside.

1. Tried to use self-serve kiosk but it wasn't working properly.
2. Went to counter to order instead, where 3 employees were chatting. I made eye contact with one and she ignored me, until another worker came by a couple of mins later and pointed out that I was waiting to order.
3. When I tried to order a Big Mac, the lady who'd made eye contact with me previously stared at me as if she wasn't sure why I was talking to her.
4. Here comes the kicker. I wanted to use the washroom after my meal, but I couldn't find one, so I asked. Turns out there's a metal roll-up door at the back, near the counter. It was closed but an employee opened it for me with a button on the wall. It opened up to a whole other area of McDonald's with more seating as well as the washrooms. The toilet cubicle had the biggest gap in the door and anyone would've been able to see everything. Not great, but not the main issue. Main issue was when I came out, that roll-up door was shut. I knocked loudly on the door several times to no avail. There was no button on my side of the door either. I paced around for a while and knocked several more times until I realized no one was coming, so I started pounding on the door. That's when I finally heard voices outside exclaiming that someone was inside, and the door started opening. 3 employees stood outside apologizing.

Use the washrooms at your own risk.
reviews.author: Jacquie W

reviews.text: Giving one star because zero isn’t an option. I just came wanting my McDouble, I see it on the counter sitting there for a solid 10 minutes, and they don’t give it to me. reviews.text:
I've been to McDonald's in 5 countries especially all over the United States an this was by far the worst experience I've ever had.  My entire experience went bad starting with the cashier.
She was awful.  I was never greeted nor did I get any sort of smile.  As I gave her my order, I asked for a Powerade because where I live they all carry it.  She told me they don't have it so I asked her what they did carry.  She told me, "We carry the regular drinks."  I asked her what they were because I didn't know.  She said the same thing again we carry the regular drinks.  I told her that I thought Powerade was a regular drink and asked her again what the regular drinks were.  She repeated the exact same thing then told me with an incredibly amount of attitude that she wasn't comfortable telling me the names of the drinks on the menu. At this point I was incredibly frustrated and the cashier next to her noticed my frustration and told me what drinks they offered.  I was really bothered, but relieved to finally have my order placed for me and my kids.  I asked her for her name and she told me it was Aubrey.  I don't know if this was really her name or not since she wasn't wearing a name tag.
Once I received my order I started becoming annoyed by every little thing that happened after that.  My 2 kids meals were missing their BBQ Sauce so I had to return to the counter.  After that, I started serving them their food and noticed that we didn't get any napkins so I returned to the counter.  When I took a bite, the Bic Mac bun was stale.  Lastly, I noticed that my drink was a Medium when I ordered myself a Large.  I was so bothered about everything else that I hadn't noticed. When I returned to the counter again, I brought the receipt and one of the guys told me that the receipt stated a Medium Drink and a Large Fries.  So when I said Large I apparently had to specify that both items of the same meal needed to be Large.
I understand that this is an incredibly busy place that serve hundreds of people a day, but it doesn't excuse the disrespect and crudeness to the customers.  It is a clear reflection of what the management team of this place allows their staff to get away with and it really makes me question the actual quality and cleanliness of the food served.  If they allow people to treat the customers like this then they probably allow the staff to avoid other things like washing their hands.
I waited a few days to post this review because I don't like to post angry.  I highly recommend to anyone on Hollywood Blvd AVOID this MCD and enjoy any number of the other great restaurants a few steps away.

reviews.text:
Poor Customer Service

I wish I knew the name of this staff so I can properly address this feedback to him. Nonetheless, I’ll give you a few description of his features to help you recognize him and experience him for yourself — he's a short guy, chubby for his size, bald, with distinctive accent and I guess in his 40s already or above. On top of that, he’s a rude person too.

To cut this whole story short, I will tell you how this staff responded to us after we asked him a quick follow-up question. Again, allow me to remind you that we are tourists in this city. We normally get confused so we ask questions and we do it politely. So anyway, while placing our orders to him we asked if the burgers include fries because we weren’t sure if he registered the 'meal option' for us. You know what he said? “Do you see there’s fries!?” --- This he replied in a rude tone and unamused face.

Realizing what he meant by that, we requested to add ‘kids size’ fries for our burgers. After that he asked us again. I thought he didn’t register what I said so I responded again IN A VERY NICE WAY: “Kids size” — to which he promptly replied to us, “I SAID IS THERE ANYTHING ELSE?!” -- Again, in the same inappropriate manner.

To be honest, we stood there feeling stunned BUT STUPEFIED. My cousin and I still wanted to add more (esp we didn’t have drinks yet) but the fact that we were being treated that way, we realized we were done for already. So we said we’re good and that was it for us. He dismissed us with pleasure and yelled again... “NEXT IN LINE PLEASE!”

Awful.
reviews.author: Daniela Bichara

reviews.text: I went to this McDonald's the other day at two in the afternoon. The lines were practically out the door. More than 40 people in line in front of me when I got there. They only had one cash register open taking orders. And one person fulfilling orders. Why in the world a restaurant in a busy location like this would not have more workers managing the registers and fulfilling orders is beyond me. I tried to talk to the manager and all he did was apologize. He didn't seem to have a clue of what he was doing. This like many McDonald's are way under staff. My order for a 10 piece chicken nuggets to large fries and a Coke came out to over $10. I'm sure the profit just for my meal could go a long way towards paying the salary of an additional worker for an hour. Not to mention the other 40 people in line in front of me. McDonald's needs to get a clue and how the restaurants are being run. This definitely is not fast food.

reviews.text:
Probably one of the worst McDonalds I've ever been to. The atmosphere is so negative - the employees seem to have an attitude even when THE ONLY interaction that's done between the McDonald's employees and the customer is hand over the food, and in my case, they didn't even hand it to me - they just yelled my number and left my food on the counter.  Since this McDonalds doesn't have any condiments outside, I had to wait on an employee to request some salt.  There was an employee in front of me who COMPLETELY ignored me when I called for her.  I gave her the benefit of the doubt and thought maybe she just didn't understand English, so I called her in Spanish.  She looked at me with disgust and told me that she'd get to me when she's ready (she was stuffing some McDonalds carry-bags inside some shelves and taking pictures of them).  A different employee who was just about to leave work (who also didn't speak English), overheard my request for some salt and gave me some packets.  When I asked him if there was a manager present, he told me, "No. There aren't any managers here".

The food ordering process was ridiculous. They offer the food items individually, and towards the end, when you've already added the fries and drink (they only have 1 drink there - Coca-Cola), THEN do they give you the option to add some fries and a drink - somewhat confusing you in order to purchase additional fries and drinks.  Oh but wait! You can't pay for your meal unless you have a seat number, so once you've already selected your meal, you have to leave the huge self-serv monitor kiosk and find a seat and number to log in just so you could purchase your food.  This was the most backwards, inconvenient, and poor service McDonalds I've EVER been too.  Definitely will not be visiting this McDonalds - and for that matter - ALL McDonalds moving forward.  Burger King and Wendy's are WAAAAAY better.
reviews.author: J. Enriquez

reviews.text:

reviews.text:
Stopped by this McDonald's.

What a terrible experience. Slow, machine for shake wasn't working, they forgot the drinks, the drink for the Happy Meal, and no dessert available.

If one stops in a McDonald's on South Beach on a Saturday afternoon and you are missing so many items, plus one leaves just to find out missing items, our experience was awful.

The store is also a design that is not welcoming to family or groups.

It is bland, sterile and utterly a cold atmosphere. One thinks of McDonald's as an inviting ambiance, but this one was for sci-fi 😱 horror movies.

In summary, stay away from this McDonald's and drive out to a nearby restaurant to enjoy South Beach to its fullest.  There are plenty of other restaurants in that area with the food and desserts one wishes to purchase while there.

reviews.text:
I have visited this McDonald's on four different occasions and, unfortunately, each time I have encountered poor service and a limited product offering.

On none of my visits have they had the Happy Meals I desired, which I found very odd. Furthermore, when I ordered one of the few hamburgers available, the meat was undercooked and pink in the center.

What I found even more disappointing was the staff's response when I expressed my dissatisfaction. Instead of apologizing or offering a solution, they seemed to ignore my complaint and waited for me to leave.

Overall, my experience at this McDonald's has been very negative. I hope the staff and management take steps to improve the quality of service and product offering.

reviews.text: The only positive aspect of this location was the staff. However, the overall experience was disappointing. The food took an excessive amount of time to be delivered, and the restaurant frequently ran out of basic items such as Pepsi, Coke, and Sprite, offering only large drinks and large fries as alternatives. The service was unsatisfactory, as the staff member taking my order spoke too softly and was unprofessional when asked to repeat herself. Additionally, the restroom was poorly maintained, with no toilet paper available. I ordered a ten-piece meal, but received only nine pieces, one of which was an unusually small chicken nugget. I would not recommend visiting this location.

reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with this McDonald’s location.

I placed a mobile pickup order and picked it up without checking it. When I got home, I was shocked to see that my muffin was completely burnt. The muffin was black and overcooked, and the food was not edible at all. It was so badly burnt that I had no choice but to throw it away. This is unacceptable. If you are serving food to customers, at least make sure it is properly cooked and not burnt to this level.

This is not the first issue I have had here. A few days ago, I placed a mobile order before 10:30 AM. I arrived at 10:38 AM, and they had canceled my order without any proper explanation. When I asked about it, the cashier was very rude and did not even try to explain the reason. There was no apology, no effort to help, and no basic customer service.

The quality of food and the way customers are treated at this location is unacceptable. I strongly recommend everyone to avoid this location. This kind of careless food preparation and rude behavior towards customers should not be tolerated.

Very disappointed
reviews.author: preetham adluri

reviews.text: This is a failed McDonald's trying to hold on in a failed city. Seattle was once a great city, and now it is just a failure. A big failure. This McDonald's has coos standing at the corner watching everyone. And violent people nearby yelling at the pavement washers, while the police just stand there doing nothing. And the dining area is shut down--looks nice but no entry. In fact the front door is barricaded and you can't enter it. Instead you stand at the door barricade and hope someone shows up to take your order, and just wait and wait. Eventually they take your order and eventually you get your food. But the dining area is shut down, maybe to avoid liability for the high drug use and violence in the area? Maybe dining area had druggies doing drugs in that area? Regardless, if you go here be aware of what you are walking in to. Do not feel safe, keep both eyes open, watch your 6. Stay alert, stay alive.  Reminds me much of downtown Minneapolis. Oh, and the same meal that costs me $17 in Virginia, costs me $28 at this place. Wow!!.  Thanks to the new minimum wage laws

I used to go several times a week, but had to stop after I was assaulted one time, and last time I was there a lady who was falling asleep while standing infront of the store woke up long enough to accuse me of "looking at her too long" and pulled out a tazer and attempted to taze me.  I hadn't even noticed her until she said something.   The employees at the store are to busy either goofing off inside, ignoring a line of people to visit with each other, or they are too busy talking to the same people that make it so dangerous to be there to actually take an order. I believe the front facing of the location needs to reimagined if there is no access to the public and the city need to partner with the businesses for safety concerns. The smell of urine alone and pressure to give people money on the street, made us leave after we paid for some food. There were some food trucks in front of Nordstrom rack that had a cleaner and safer feel for a quick snack
reviews.author: kaizer8243

reviews.text: Awful customer service. I called today around 5pm a women answered I KINDLY explained I didn't receive half my order from doordash and doordash won't refund so I wondered if something could be done. She hung up, I call back and they answered and hung up. Really? I'm a disabled student, it's the only money for food I had today and I depend on services like this to get by I can't make food. I wasn't rude, I had a awful day and was trying to settle down to eat something and didnt get half of it. I've always liked your food, never had issues but this is bull. The chick could of just said they can do anything instead of making me feel bad.
reviews.author: Jasper Johnston

reviews.text:
Just saw a guy getting a hit from weed from the homeless outside.
Nit the worse part tho
Aweful customer service. They f ignore u if u try to pick up ur order and even get bothered when they finally face you.
Always late. I plece an order i arrive 10 mins after the time they say it will be ready and always have to wait at least 15 more mins
As the cherry on top. The entire place is surrounded by ppl getting high on all types of drugs.
The place is simple disgusting and the employees … ughhhhh.
This place needs to be shut down n be inspected by the cuty it self . Not their own corript staff !
reviews.author: Ibautista1983

reviews.text:
This place is peak Seattle: dirty, depressing, and surrounded by the kind of characters that make you question if society was a bad idea. You can’t even go inside—probably because it’s safer that way—so you’re stuck waiting on the sidewalk, watching a live demo of what happens when a city gives up.

I didn’t eat here, and I never will. I just felt obligated to leave this PSA for any poor tourist who still thinks Seattle has “charm.” Do yourself a favor—hand your wallet to the nearest guy screaming at traffic, stab yourself with a rusty fork, and skip the wait. Same experience, less hassle.
reviews.author: Lucas Svaren

reviews.text:
First of all, this is just a sketchy place
So many crackheads and is just terrible.
The employees were over worked and overwhelmed. I honestly felt bad for them. As well as the homeless which were swarming all around the place. Smokers galore. If u want to get high on the amount of drugs here, feel free. Overall not good at all just a bad place. Don’t take you kids here unless you want them a traumatic experience. Also very expensive. Manager argued with me about the 14 dollar big Mack. Wasn’t even a meal. They were “out of stock” Never come here.
reviews.author: Mrbast JimmyJohnson

reviews.text: Pretty sad that people can't come inside this McDonald's location anymore. 3rd Avenue has always been "animated" but I never had any issues. Just keep aware what's going on around you and don't leave your bag/purse open. My sister had her bag stolen at a bus stop at this location years ago because she wasn't hanging onto it well and it was pretty open. I don't mind walking in this area but I wouldn't stand around ordering from this McDonald's now. Must have gotten BAD cause this McDonald's was open to the public to go in for YEARS.
reviews.author: M W

reviews.text: This is by far the worst fast food in Seattle. The worst McDonalds I've EVER been to. Felt incredibly unsafe while there because of the drug use right next to the pick-up window. They don't even let you inside the lobby to pick up your order. Customer service is unacceptable. I hope the management can turn this place around soon. I'm sure it's hard to keep good employees at this location. They need security all hours they are open patrolling the pick-up windows to keep the drug use and crime away.
reviews.author: Tennessee Oiler

reviews.text:
Food was mediocre, even in comparison to other McDonald’s, but most of all, the McDonald’s was heavily barricaded, there was no dine in spot, and the environment outside was extremely bad because of the homelessness.

The service was also bad and they were spending time greeting to friends who for some reason got to sit inside the otherwise  deserted restaurant while we could only order from the outside. It took very long to get our food and it was overall not a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: James Wang

reviews.text: Expensive, compromised quality, and full of other impatient and rude customers. No wonder the people working here are so moody. Considering what they must be getting paid and the hours they work, I have to respect their brusk attitudes, but I have a hard time respecting anyone who allows themselves to be treated this way by both customers and management. McDonald's feels like the epitome of all things wrong with American Capitolism and I hope the people working there unionize soon.
reviews.author: Adam Woodworth

reviews.text: NOT THE FAMILY MCD. I’m strictly writing this so that any party with young children knows to avoid this location. An absolute shame that restaurants have to choose to permanently close their dining rooms because of the folks living on the street around the intersection. This location is outside walk up only. There are some folks doing light security, but you’re absolutely going to be seeing drug use up close and personal while waiting for your order. Wouldn’t advise sadly
reviews.author: Em Brumm

reviews.text: My app crashed after I paid for my order. Spent 5 minutes looking for the confirmation number in app and email. Went to the window, the guy was no help. When down go on the ST Link and 10 minutes later I had gotten an email. I called to store to cancel the order since the guy was to lazy to look on the order board to see if my order was placed or ready. Call manager and she wanted me to come back for a refund. Just sent an email to corporate office to let them handle it.
reviews.author: Amun-Ra Yahweh

reviews.text: If I was a secret shopper, you’d have FAILED!! Deborah is the best usually running food in common areas. She’s the only one who when she saw me (a customer), acknowledged me. Looked well staffed for such poor service. Customer Service from managers is POOR which means poor trainees.  Drive thru lines long, inside empty. Poor service, poor food, needs to be reviewed by corporate or franchisee. Also whoever answered the phone, hung up on me.
reviews.author: Charlsee Parker

reviews.text: Tourists BEWARE. Avoid this area, specifically 3rd Ave between Pine and Union, including the McDonald's here. Drug addicts, drug dealers, and homeless heartbreak are all over, and at night it is NOT safe. Don't go here unless you want to help or provide social services. I saw NO police of any kind here, at all. Only death and sadness. I feel awful for anyone working at this McDonald's or struggling to find food and shelter. Just awful.
reviews.author: Andrew Patteson

reviews.text: This is the first and LAST time I will ever be at this McDonald's on 3rd. The Homeless have taken over the street and the store was barricaded so you couldn't go inside. Having to stand out by the "Takeout Window" I kept getting haggled by the local residents. I'm glad I ordered on the app so I never had to take my wallet out. But if I had known how bad it was I would have never placed the order! I did not feel safe at all!!
reviews.author: Scott Landwehr

reviews.text: This was the rudest McDonald's I have ever been to. My order one item and took them 10 minutes. The whole time two workers kept staring at me asking me what my order was over and over again. I was the only person in line. And after I told them what my order was over and over, they just sat there looking at me with suspicion as an AA. I usually wouldn't right a review but it really stood out to me that I was singled out.
reviews.author: Bruce Johnson

reviews.text: Adding to the comments suggesting tourists don’t go to this. It’s so rough on this street corner that they literally used chairs and tables to barricade the doors like they’re in a zombie movie. Then someone will call you to the side door and open it just enough to shove the bag through before slamming and locking it again. You will see someone smoking crack, the smoke will probably be blown in your face. Not kidding
reviews.author: Ryker Roberts

reviews.text:
The restaurant told the Uber driver that everything was in the sealed bag. The driver then told me everything was in the bag. Opened it up, and all the mcflurries were not present. Guess my kids don't get ice cream today.
Thank goodness my refund for the ice cream will be here within 10 business days.
Knowing the refund was coming sure made my kids stop crying....not.
What a cruddy end to an already stressful day.
reviews.author: Ben Moline

reviews.text: When i went to order i was bombarded by a homeless man trying to intimidate me into buying him food. Then asked a male employee (im a female) to use the restroom and was locked in which was highly stressful. After banging on the door for a few minutes a female employee opened the door. Was given no apology and was stared at by another employee in the lobby. I definitely don't feel safe here and wont be back.
reviews.author: Elise L (Lettersfromelise)

reviews.text: Haven't Eatin at McDonald's in years, this reaffirms why. "Large" fries the same as a small ten years ago. Quality is absolutely garbage. You don't expect a lot from fast food, but $18 for a meal that's rotten and leaves you hungry; no thanks. Look at my photo of a "large" fry the same size as a small burger box. Please go out of business McDonald's, I hope you're not around in ten more years.
reviews.author: JS

reviews.text:
The cashier was very friendly and let me know it would be a wait for the food (it was 12 minutes). The down side is that the food was cold when I received it, which is weird because I assumed it was going to take that long due to the volume of orders.

Also waiting for your food gets a little tiring when you're constantly getting approached for money and hit on by impaired individuals.
reviews.author: A F

reviews.text:
Had a (Lil McDonald's) Happy Meal for pick-up and despite their app saying it was available it actually wasn't, so they just dumped a toy from...TWO years ago in a box from an unrelated movie in 2025.
Either way I wanted neither.

Not just a 1 star for that though, I've been going here since I was a child and fifteen years later I still don't have a single decent memory of this place.
reviews.author: Mark Reniel Zarsadias

reviews.text: I realize it was near closing time and all but none the less, I found myself waiting almost 30+ mins for the ice cream cone i had ordered and paid for.  Dude tried  to make up for it by making it HUGE!! Would've turned out alright if I had gotten a cup to put it in tho. Sadly I lost at least half of it unable to eat it B4 it melted and slid off my cone!! Lol B-/
reviews.author: Misz Sarah LeeAnn Clark-Shay

reviews.text: Forcing people to stand out in the rain and wait for their food is absolutely ridiculous. There’s an entire dry restaurant but you can’t sit and get out of the rain. I came to Seattle on business and my hotel was around the corner so I thought it would be an easy quick dinner. I’m freezing and sopping wet, and have completely lost my appetite.
reviews.author: Steven Rowe (Stevieplays)

reviews.text: First I ordered my food then when I got my son's slushy it was only filled up half way. Then I ordered my daughter apple juice and they didn't get her the juice then when I went to put my straw in my diet coke and it was sealed so I had to take the lid off and poke it through with my finger overall I recommend going to KFC.
reviews.author: Kyle Riggers

reviews.text:
If you enjoy the Fallout game/TV show, this will give you a good sense of how fast food restaurants will operate in the post-apocalyptic Seattle.

The main entrance to the restaurant is barricaded with large wooden boards. The majority of employees hide in the back while one person faces the onslaught from the outside.
reviews.author: Ziad I

reviews.text: Consistently delivers the wrong order with missing or incorrect items. I ordered a caramel sundae but received an M&M McFlurry instead, with barely any mix-ins and a random hint of Hershey’s syrup on top. If you want your order to be completely messed up, feel free to eat from here. Otherwise, don’t bother.
reviews.author: Abhiti Sachdeva

reviews.text: Placed an order here today just for a quick lunch pick up but the amount of homeless surrounding this place so I waited over 20 min and couldn't even approach the window. I had to reach out to McDonalds Corporate for a refund on my order. This location just needs to shut down it is not safe at all.
reviews.author: Elliott Borneman

reviews.text: If you’re a tourist DO NOT GO to this Mc Donald’s! It was one to the scariest experiences of my life! As a tourist I had no clue of all the problems of this area! I felt extremely unsafe, though thank God nothing happened to me I would like people to read this to avoid living that experience.
reviews.author: Karen S de C

reviews.text:
The customer service here is the RUDEST I’ve ever dealt with. I understand it’s not the greatest area but that is no excuse for their behaviour and language. A middle aged lady (45-50) wearing a purple McDonald’s shirt was so unbelievably rude. Do not recommend this location.
April 13th 2024.
reviews.author: Amanda A

reviews.text: Staff were a bit weird. We were from the UK and they sent us to another window to be served and served others and laughed about it. Think it was because we were tourists, but we left anyway. Lots of homeless people around,  so not sure if this was there way if making us feel uneasy.
reviews.author: Tom Anney

reviews.text: I ordered a combo meal and a 10-piece McNugget. Then, I went home and found that there was no burger inside. This is the first time I've encountered this situation. Although the employee could have made a mistake, they are not being professional, their training is bad.
reviews.author: Yuanheng Xie

reviews.text: Most of the time the food is good but extremely rude and unprofessional management. I understand they deal with riffraff all day but that shouldn't make them treat everyone like crap! Terrible employees! If they screw up your order they don't accept responsibility! 😠
reviews.author: Edward Bunker

reviews.text: I witnessed a very suspicious interaction outside this McDonald’s, an employee accepted a bag full of groceries and hygiene items from a stranger who appeared intoxicated. It didn’t look like a normal delivery or customer exchange. Management should look into this.
reviews.author: Mohannad Na’eem

reviews.text: So rampant with homeless and druggies, there is a full time security guard enforcing the loitering and bathroom for customers only policies. Quite an uncomfortable atmosphere unless you're used to that dark side of the city scene. The food and staff were fine.
reviews.author: Nathan Gayner

reviews.text: See anything wrong here? Burgers with no meat, drug central, no place to sit, orders are wrong, arguments over sauce. THIS IS WHERE ALL THE HOMELESS HANG OUT. Hence the cops everywhere and Se,purity to even JUST use the bathroom Do NOT recommend
reviews.author: Meghan Crager

reviews.text:
Worst McDonald’s in the USA so far.
You are not allowed to enter the restaurant. After waiting in line on the street you can order and take away your not really perfect tasting food. Ridiculous.
reviews.author: Torsten Weidemann

reviews.text: This McDonald’s location is in the worst spot of Seattle. Smells horrible outside garbage everywhere homeless people laying down literally in front almost.
reviews.author: Don V

reviews.text: This guy in photo is super sluggish no matter how busy store is he try to work as slow as possible, while other workers are very fast
reviews.author: jawwad bari

reviews.text: Stay away. Find one at a mall or something. Very unsafe with homeless and addicts roaming around
reviews.author: Oscar Crespo Madrid

reviews.text: One fry of my meal was missing, no sauce was provided, the toy was wrong. Totally terrible!
reviews.author: Purrr

reviews.text: Slowest McDonald in the world ! No one to help at the pick up window and bad place to wait
reviews.author: Abraham Ferreira

reviews.text: Run down neighborhood. Only takeaway. Slow service. The dining area was closed.
reviews.author: Sebastian Gabler

reviews.text: The lobby was closed before 10pm and we walked there to get food.
reviews.author: Andrew Harshman

reviews.text: God awful experience, terrible staff and the food is an insult.
reviews.author: Matt Harrison

reviews.text: No entry, messed up order TWICE, and we have to sit on street.
reviews.author: Rambler2920

reviews.text: Had waited 15 minutes and didn't get my order still
reviews.author: Egor

reviews.text: My first time here, and I am absolutely mortified at how I was treated, and how I saw others being treated before me. .My boys and I ordered on line, 30 mins later we walked the 10 mins to this location from our hotel. When we arrived I walked up to the counter and I asked the young lady in the picture do I come here to pick up an order. She did not reply. Then I asked a gentleman not picture here he said yes but still did not ask me a name or my order number. By my house I would walk in they would ask me the number and then they would let me know it would be a certain amount of time or it's not ready yet or it is ready. They pretty much just didn't acknowledge me anymore. While waiting a lady walked up and said she didn't get all of her dipping sauce. The young lady in the picture said I gave you enough flicked her nails at her and sent her on her way. I found that to be extremely rude however when they finally called my number I did not take it on the on this young lady. Said Thank you and then I said are the dipping sauces in there and she asked the gentleman he said yes they said yes it was so busy I took my bag and we left. We get back to the room I set the boys up I passed out all the food I look everywhere in the bags and there is not one sauce for my over 30 nuggets. One of my plain Burgers also had cheese on it. We peeled the cheese off but I had to walk the 10 minutes back because I can't eat the Nuggets without the dipping sauce. I walk in and the young lady who's in this picture is at the register I waved when I say hey I didn't have any dipping sauce I'm not even upset about it even though I should be I just want the dipping sauce. She literally says nothing and then this guy goes walking past me and he appears to be a manager so I'm expecting something great here right. I was wrong I said sir I got over 30 nuggets but I didn't get any dipping sauce earlier. He said okay what do you want. I asked for Buffalo and sweet and sour he gives me four. I said sir for 32 nuggets you get four and he looked at me disgusted and he was like yes. I said how many do you get for six nuggets he said one. So technically I should have gotten five he only gave me four however I think I should have gotten six cuz I had on the other two nuggets. He refused to give me one more sauce. And told me I needed to leave. I said sir I expect better treatment if I came here and y'all forgot to give me something and then I had to leave and walk back and you're treating me like I did something wrong. He just stared at me. I said sir what is your name and what is the corporate number. He said you can get it off the window. I said yes but what is your name because this is the worst treatment I have ever had. He refused so I took his picture because if they actually have a professional manager there I wanted them to know who I was talking about.  I took his picture and then the young lady pictured here who is standing there checking people out yelled over do you want to take my picture too and then she puts up those nails again. I said well I didn't really have a problem with you but since you've asked and then she posed for the picture. Crazy thing is I walked in and didn't even mention the burger I just wanted the sauces but they were awful they acted like I did something horrible. The way these two treated me it was very confusing I can't fathom what I did to deserve that. Due to these two employees I would never recommend this location to anyone. It was disgusting. Oh and then of course he had to take my picture. What I expected was oh sorry ma'am since you know she just saw me and they did tell me the sauces were in there. Oh sorry ma'am let me get you those sauces how many did you want sorry you had to walk back over here you have a great night.. that would have been great customer service not whatever that was that I experienced...DO NOT GO HERE....
reviews.author: Tee C

reviews.text: I came for breakfast at this location, ordered at the kiosk and sat down at one of the tables til my order was ready. I was on my way to work and I had my carry-all bag with me and I sat it on the table top. The manager, an older Hispanic woman told me to move my bag off the table and put it on the floor, which I thought was disrespectful because I've put my bag or personal items on the table before and it wasn't a problem. She didn't ask me nicely to move it nor did she say please or thank you. She just very rudely told me to move it and I did, no problem or attitude from me. But her tone with me was very nasty, she was staring and glaring at me and treating me like I came to make trouble, which I didn't or don't. No good morning or greeting of any kind...just getting snapped at early in the morning to move my bag. I understand they get a lot of homeless people and troublemakers in that particular area but I still don't appreciate the way that manager spoke to me. There's a right and a wrong way to talk to anybody, especially when they're spending money in that establishment. I would think with her being a manager and being older, she would know better than this. There's plenty of options to eat at around the area and I could have went with those options but I chose McDonald's because it's near my job and this what I encountered. I ordered a bacon, egg and cheese bagel sandwich meal with 2 extra bacon strips and ordered an extra hash brown and the hash browns and OJ was the only good items as far as the food is concerned. The bagel was cold and a little too firm and it's usually warm and softer when I've ordered it before. I didn't get the 2 extra bacon strips either. So basically bad customer service from the manager and a messed up order sums it all up. I could let it slide but she was wrong for that. My job is not that far from this location and when I'm in the area and craving McDonald's again, there's another location not too far and maybe I'll have a better experience there. It may be awhile before I even think about going back to that location. If I could give negative stars, I would. Please do better, especially management.
reviews.author: Candice Hastings

reviews.text: On Wednesday June 14th around 9’o clock my family and I visited this location and had an awful experience. After visiting several touristic places for 3 days, we decided to close the trip by visiting the river walk. As we were walking around we spotted this McDonald’s. Little did we know that we were about to have our worst experience ever in a fast food restaurant. First, my daughter stood there for a while before they helped her. Finally when they decided to help her The young lady that was taking orders was being rude and unfriendly the whole time. Second, we asked if we could use the restroom but they said no because we needed a receipt to prove that we were paying customers, all of this while my daughter is standing there placing an order. After, we begged them to open the bathroom they finally did. Third, after they were taking forever for just two frappes, my daughter was standing there waiting and waiting. Next thing we know is the young girl erased the order from the screen as she had made it already. The waiting continued. I went into the bathroom and come out to find out they the young girl behind the counter was creaming at my daughter,  after she asked if she could have her order made. She was screaming that she (my daughter) was nobody to tell her what to do  to which I say: “you don’t talk to a customer like that, you need a little training.” She replied that I need training raising my daughter raising her voice to me and using profanity. So now, not only did I endure mistreatment, but I got schooled how to raise my daughter by a teenager. Very disrespectful. After all that, an older lady came to the front (I assume it was the manager), but she never introduced herself or apologize in any way. After all this, our night and our trip was ruined. Many people were standing there in disbelief of what had transpired. One young man approached us and said that he was mistreated by this lady too. Thank you McDonald’s for ruining our trip.
reviews.author: Omar Hernandez

reviews.text: The manager that was working august 31st has a problem with confrontation or doesnt care about customers. Mobile order was late about 20 minutes. Lady walks put with shake as i walk in. manager tells me shake machine “is down” (of course they just closed it early to be able to close faster) but he left it out and was willing to let me leave without compensation for the item that was left out. i ask him for some cookies instead he says there are no more. cool. says i can get a frappe instead and even asks me what kind. i say a mocha frappe . he gives me a caramel frappe instead and gives no reason, benefit of the doubt he forgot , but is it really that hard to remember between two options? Get back to my hotel with the wife, unpack everything ready to eat, we have about 20 nuggets among other things, we ordered about 6 sauces and recieved 0. ok cool maybe i can use ketchup- oh ok none either. i understand wanting to close early on a busy night in a busy area, but be transparent and say this isnt available and offer alternatives. I was showing an out of towner this cool 2 floor mcdonalds and everything went wrong.
reviews.author: aticus ovalle

reviews.text: One of the worst McDonald s one of the worst customer servis ever. I made order it did send me receipt. It showed up in my bank. I guess they had some issue with connection they started telling me it was canceled but i had no email about cancellation. Lady wanted see my bank account that i made transaction even with me showing  an email with receipt that i paid she tried grab my phone when i said no cause this lady dont need my bank account information. She was fighting with me and arguing over two hashbrowns their servis is just horrible if you dont want work there then dont and instead apology for inconvenience had her telling me shit. It s not my faukt your app doesnt work right talk to your corporate even if order was canceled without me knowing she could of offer any other solution  or say ok can still try order or anything instead she wasnt doing nothing started ignoring me till another manager showed up and figure out whole order. But she wasnt i didnt recieve any canceletion email anything even of they cancel it it s not my fault for their issue
reviews.author: Klara Lamatova

reviews.text: The worst #Mcdonalds experience time after time...  Staff is rarely friendly they never smile, acknowledge or seem interested in helping others. The entire restaurant is always dirty , counters, vending, stairs, bathrooms, floors are always disgusting. Cashiers get orders wrong and then argue with you about orders every time. They treat you like your begging for the food. The vending area is also low on straws, lids and napkins and out of drink choices every time I've visited. Space is limited because they also close the upstairs area when theres no space downstairs during weekends and busy times. They seem to be extremely under staffed.  Managers seems to always be in the back or gossiping with other managers and security they see employees struggling and dont seem to lend a hand or manage their restaurant. This time I managed to snap some pictures .
reviews.author: L G

reviews.text: This morning,  around 1130am I ordered food at this location.  I went back again to use the restroom and the cashier said to me if your not buying you cannot use the restroom,  I explained to her that I just had bought food not long ago,  she replied that was this morning so you cannot go in. I also explained that I am one of the artisan showcasing here at the river yet she said no. I wasn't lying nor taking advance of anything, she was rude.   You know what you lost! a regular customer that also brings tourists here.. this is not the attitude towards your clients, very disappointed.  On the contrary, Lone Star greeted me and welcomed me, not as a customer but as an artisan to use their facilities.  Get a grip and do better with customers.
reviews.author: Eli Maldonado

reviews.text: This location has roaches. And management don't do anything about it. I had called and complained about my ice coffee because there was a roach floating around in it and I had already drank and some of that coffee and the manager that was in charge of tall light-skinned man asked me what I want him to do about it. I was upset and hung up. The other heavy set lady manager call me back and was only concerned about how big the roach was. I told her I was on my way back up there and All they did was call the cops on me. So my issue was NEVER resoulved and for all i know they are still serving up Ice roaches in there  iced coffees in their McCafe drinks. I have pictuers for proof but im sure they won't adress this issue.
reviews.author: Stephanie Marie

reviews.text: It's McDonald's, so you expect it to be bad - this one is especially bad. Slow service, filthy tables and floors, and their "self-serve" kiosk system was a disaster. Plus, they only give "two free water cups" - we were a group of five and didn't want to drink soda. On top of that, they offer "self-service" kiosks but don't have self-serve napkins, condiments, straws, etc. So when they gave us our order (the system said they'd bring it to our table - they didn't), they didn't include straws, napkins, or ketchup. So we had to return to the front and ask, which is fine except the lady at the counter seemed annoyed that I'd have the audacity to ask for napkins and straws. Oh, and the water didn't work on the bathroom.
reviews.author: Spencer Burton

reviews.text: This McDonald's is a unique location and building. Rare to see a McDonald's that is 2 stories. I don't recommend using the mobile app for this McDonald's. We ordered our food and it took over 30 minutes for them to start making it even after approaching the counter twice about it. One of the biggest reasons of why I ever eat McDonald's is because it's FAST food. We could have got a table at a sit down restaurant and received our food faster than this McDonald's. They told me they were behind on orders but it didn't look like they cared since all the employees come up to the front counter area to socialize with each other like they had nothing to do.
reviews.author: Austin Allen

reviews.text: Nasty location. Such a shame. It’s ALWAYS DIRTY! Being downtown is not an excuse. No matter the time or day, it’s always gross. There could be 6 employees standing around including what seems like managers due to their difference in shirts, and it never fails that the place is just DIRTY. Sticky tables, nasty floors, smelly soda machines with mold in the tea… the list goes on and on. The upstairs is always closed which doesn’t leave customers with very much seating, about 35 seats. It’s just sad to see a well known name have such a dirty place. No excuse because WHATABURGER DOWN THE STREET IS ALWAYS CLEAN AND STAFFED WITH FRIENDLY PEOPLE.
reviews.author: Monica Hernandez

reviews.text: Ratchet workers. Took ten minutes for a cold 6 piece nugget and a fry. I watched them let the nuggets sit in a bag for five of those minutes while they dawdled then eventually slowly scooped some fries. Worker made eye contact with me and called out my order and I nodded and she proceeded to yell my name out 5 more times and try to give it to someone else. Unprofessional and unsanitary. Touching cooked food with no gloves. Another worker came in in her coat and brushed her sleeve over several bags of orders including my own. Never going here ever again I don’t care how convenient the location is.

reviews.text: This is an ideal location across from Waikiki Beach, the tourist destination; however, is infested with homeless protected by the local police. Our drinks were stolen from our table as my children sat and waited for my wife and I to retrieve our order. We called a manager to pull video surveillance, which showed exactly which homeless person stole our drinks and called the police to file a theft report. The local police were completely useless, did not press any charges despite video footage, sided with the homeless thief and said if they arrested him that a thousand more would do the same thing. Really!? I received zero apologies or compensation from McDonald’s, the police I called, or the thief in the photo. In fact, the police apologized to the homeless thief for bothering him prior to leaving. The homeless thief remained in the restaurant. We will never eat here again despite the fact that we live 3 blocks away. Completely sad what some businesses do to loyal customers.

I tried contacting customer service twice and was told someone from the store would follow up. No one ever did. I even spent a good amount of time trying to fix this while I was on vacation, which just added to the frustration.

It’s not about the 99 cents — it’s about the complete lack of follow-through. After all this, I was basically told to go back to the same location that ignored me in the first place. I’ve wasted hours over something that should’ve been resolved with a quick refund and an apology.

reviews.text:
I’ll never forget the day I ordered a Dr Pepper at McDonald’s, expecting the usual burst of that unique blend of 23 flavors. Instead, what I received was a watery, diluted mess. The first sip hit me like a wave of disappointment, a shadow of what Dr Pepper is supposed to be. It felt like a betrayal, as if all the joy and energy I was counting on to get through the rest of my day had been drained away along with the syrup. What was supposed to be a quick pick-me-up turned into the start of a downward spiral.

From that moment, everything seemed to go wrong. My productivity plummeted, my mood soured, and my ability to focus on work slipped away with every diluted sip. The frustration lingered long after the taste faded. I began questioning my decisions, starting with the small ones like trusting McDonald’s to deliver a decent soft drink, then slowly spiraling into deeper thoughts about my life choices. Something as simple as a poorly mixed Dr Pepper shouldn’t have had that much power over me, yet here I was, feeling as though my life had been derailed by a disappointing beverage.

In the weeks that followed, I found myself avoiding fast food restaurants altogether, fearing another run-in with a watery soda. It became a symbol of everything that had gone wrong—small disappointments building into larger issues. Relationships seemed to strain, deadlines became more overwhelming, and even the smallest of inconveniences felt magnified. That one watered-down Dr Pepper had planted a seed of dissatisfaction that grew and festered, leaving me with a bitter reminder of how even the smallest things can throw life completely off balance.

reviews.text: I recently visited the 526 ponce de leon ave mcdonald's location on 12/6/22 at 3:28 AM. I placed a mobile order and proceeded to the speaker to give my code. When I got there, I said "Hello!" and heard a very loud yell "HOLD UP."  I told her "Why are you yelling at me?" and she said "why are you saying Hello?" I then told her (very appalled that this was why this woman was yelling), "to let you know that I'm at the window." I then gave her my order number and when I approached the 1st window, I asked what her name was. She then looked at me straight in the face and closed the window and walked away to the 2nd window. At the second window she told me "Quisha, my name is Quisha!" and just stood there. I asked her if she had taken my order and she confirmed she did. There were 3 other workers around her. I then told her "That's all I need to know." She then responded "Oh, I know." I then asked to speak to a manager and with all the 4 staff there, the same woman who yelled at me at the speaker, said she was the manager. I was in disbelief. I live 3 minutes away and always come to this McDonalds and had never been treated so poorly by staff here. I truly hope that this message reaches a management that actually cares about their customers because the "management" I supposedly encountered, clearly did not. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone I know given what I experienced here on behalf of "management." NOTE: the receipt says "SIDEL" took my order.  Please let me know if there is any more information, I can provide you. Also, find attached the receipt of purchase.

reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal customer at this location for over 30 years, coming in almost daily. Most of the staff, including James and Lupita, are always polite and professional. Unfortunately, one manager, Cora, is consistently rude and makes my visits unpleasant.

Every time she’s working, she goes out of her way to harass me. Most recently, I ordered a drink through the drive-thru, parked, went inside to buy food, and refilled my soda while waiting. She refused to hand me my bag, stared at my cup, and then told me drive-thru customers aren’t allowed refills. In 30 years of visiting, I’ve never heard of that rule.

This isn’t the first problem. She once personally asked me for $40, which I gave her out of kindness, and ever since then she’s treated me with hostility. I’ve even filed several complaints (at least four over the last two years). After each one she pretends to be pleasant for a short time, then goes right back to the same behavior.

It’s gotten to the point where I avoid the store if I see her car outside. No customer should feel that unwelcome, especially someone who has supported this location for decades. Corporate really needs to step in and address this manager before more loyal customers are driven away.

reviews.text:
visited this McDonald’s on 11/5 with my daughter, who wanted the 2-sandwich meal. When we pulled off and opened the bag, one of the sandwiches was just bread — no meat at all. I had to turn all the way back around to get it corrected, which was already inconvenient since we live in Acworth.

When we arrived, I politely explained what happened and simply asked if we could get two cookies for the inconvenience. The young lady at the first window was kind and apologetic, and she said that would be fine. However, when we got to the second window, an employee named James told me he didn’t believe there was “only bread” in the wrapper and that my kids had probably dropped the sandwich.

That comment was completely uncalled for. To accuse me — and especially my children — of lying over a missing sandwich was disrespectful and unnecessary. I would have been honest if that were the case, but it wasn’t. His attitude and assumptions made me feel completely disrespected.

This kind of behavior is unacceptable, and it shows a serious lack of customer service and professionalism. It’s especially disappointing because it felt like we were being judged simply because I’m a Black mother with children. Do better, McDonald’s.

Previous visit(s) complaints:

The atmosphere inside is never comfortable to say the least its normally dark inside especially in the mornings. 95% of the negative opinions I have about this Mcdonalds, comes from the woman security guard that usually works in the mornings.

I've thought about working here and immediately decided it was a bad idea due to this woman.

I do not wish to talk ill of her, she does her job well, but she also takes things a step way too far. Mind you, the area this mcdonalds is in is a bit dodgy, one cross street is colfax and the other is literally littered with trash and people who have no problem walking up to your car and asking if you want to buy drugs, so I understand the level of security that might be needed to uphold standards here.

That being said, i gave it a few visits to actually make my opinion on the woman security guard to give the benefit of the doubt before posting to let the world know.

First, she is very negative from my perspective, she doesnt make any effort to be friendly, even to the customers. She way she talks to people, is demands, not polite requests.

I've seen a woman park in the curbside spot, walk inside to where i was currently at, and the security guard immediately told her she cannot park there, and the woman let her know that her order was originally curbside but it wasnt working on the app so she came inside. And she scolded her, and said that she needed to move immediately because it was impeding their work area. Even though there were other curbside spots open and she was still trying to place an order and be a paying customer. The customer even responded by asking why she was so angry with her for parking there for a few minutes.

A simple solution would have been to politely ask her to move the car as soon as possible. Not to scold the customer or demand her to do things.

Another instance, a man was parked next to me, it seemed to me he was scrolling on the app getting his order together, when the security guard walked up to his car and told him to leave immediately because he had not walked inside yet. She didn't even ask him why he was there or anything. The man left and she followed his car and made sure he left.

Shes also stared out the windows to the parking lot to the point ive felt very uncomfortable before.

These are just a few things. By all means, she does a good job at her job, but needs to treat customers with more respect.

I hope if she sees what i have to say she can take it as constructive criticism. Because if she could learn to have more respect towards people i would come inside more often, and feel comfortable enough to even apply for a job at this location. Even my roommates and neighbors all agree about the atmosphere because of this woman.

Thanks for reading.
