reviews.text: I woke up in an alleyway after being drugged and assaulted this weekend. This McDonald’s was the first open place I could find after walking down colfax barefoot in the freezing cold. All of my possessions were gone, my clothes were ripped and I was covered in scratches and bruises. I asked if they had a phone I could use, the worker looked me up and down and gave me a dirty look then laughed and said no. A security guard approached me and stupid me felt relieved because I mistakenly believed his job was to keep people safe. He told me to leave, I asked him if he could at least please call the police for me and I would go wait down the block or something, or if he could direct me where I to go to use a phone or get any sort of help. I was terrified, in a lot of pain, freezing, and completely traumatized. He did not care in the slightest and his only concern was physically forcing a vulnerable girl back out onto colfax before the sun had even risen. I wouldn’t have even been able to keep warm on a summer night, let alone in that weather. He had a heavy jacket on and zipped up while sitting inside. Can someone tell me what exactly his job is then?? What is it that this “man” (I hesitate to even use that word, because he is incredibly far from it) is getting paid to do? I was not causing a scene or anything like that. I quietly begged him to contact the police. Trust me, last thing I wanted was any attention drawn to me. Maybe I’m being naive, but I don’t see any reason why these employees treated me so poorly or refused to do even the bare minimum by calling the cops and having me wait for them down the block…I have no faith in humanity anymore.

reviews.text: I come here often for coffee on my way to work. The service is fast and efficient, and the employees are mostly friendly even though it looks frantically busy back there! However, this morning I saw the most awful display by someone I can only assume is a manager. In Vancouver, a city with a higher than average street homeless population and currently facing a massive public health emergency that is especially affecting these marginalized people, this manager bullied and condescended to a homeless man in a way that was absolutely shocking. After speaking loudly right at the man and actually getting an answer, he decided to speak over his head to the employees, who were also visibly embarrassed at his actions. "Did he buy something?", he asked. When told that yes, he had ordered a coffee just like hundreds of other people that morning, he continued: "Okay well can we get it so that I can get him out of here?". I had no words at the time for how shocked and disappointed I am. For someone in a leadership position and working for a company that claims to take its role in the community so seriously, this was an unbelievable lack of compassion. And not that this even matters, but the homeless man in question had been quiet, polite, and not bothering or even speaking to any other customers or staff. I'm still shaking my head about this.
reviews.author: Stephanie Plourde

reviews.text:
The staff does not wear gloves whole preparing food. And when asked why, they said Mcd only has a policy of washing hands before handling food and gloves are not allowed.
Under the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations (SFCR) food workers in all kinds of food industry should not only wash hands but also wear Clear/white gloves for assembling or handling ready to eat food along with other extra protective coverings. How would I know the person who is making food is not touching the dirty parts of the counter. In between making the breakfast wraps, the staff touched many other parts, left the station, touched non food surfaces which I can assure are not cleaned or changed at proper interval of time.
I work in healthcare and I know that even after handwashing, there are still bacteria that remain on skin. Handwashing reduces viruses, but does not remove or kill them all. Even clean hands can contaminate food if the worker has Cuts, Dry skin, Wounds, Fingernail bacteria.
What would happen in busy hours of the day, if they can forget to put my customized items in the wrap then they can obviously prevent hand washing to handle the food orders during busy time. This is really unhygienic way of preparing food. And if really Mcd has a policy of not wearing gloves then it should definitely be implemented.
reviews.author: Kashish Kumar

reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointed — Still No Refund After 4 Months

I placed an order through your app the day before my visit. However, when I arrived at the store, the app completely crashed and said the order could not be retrieved. Left with no choice, I placed a second order in-store and paid again.

Since then, I have contacted your team multiple times requesting a refund for the original order that I never received. The manager promised the refund would be issued, but here we are — four months later, and nothing has happened. No update, no refund, no responsibility taken.

This level of disorganization and poor customer service is beyond frustrating. It’s just $9.96, but the principle matters. Since you clearly don’t care, consider it a donation — may it bring you some good karma, and hopefully, some common sense.

Absolutely unacceptable.

reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY AVOID: A Disgusting, Unsafe, and Overpriced Disaster
This is not a functioning McDonald's; it is a public safety hazard and an absolute disgrace to the brand. The location at 7th Ave & Van Buren is, without hyperbole, one of the worst dining experiences I have ever endured. I would give it zero stars if possible.
Environment and Safety: Unacceptable
The setting is immediately hostile and uncomfortable. The exterior and the interior dining area are filthy. The seating area reeked of an unmistakable stench of homelessness and pervasive funk, making it impossible to sit down comfortably. Outside, the property is overrun by groups of drug addicts and junkies, creating a profoundly unsafe atmosphere. The automated "no loitering" message playing endlessly over the loudspeaker was a pathetic, ineffectual attempt at control that only highlighted the total lack of actual management.
Service and Food Quality: Failures on All Counts
The service was glacial, suggesting zero interest from the staff in serving customers. Several employees appeared to be impaired or completely disinterested. When the food finally arrived, it was cold—the fries were stale, and the burger felt like it had been sitting for an hour, not prepared fresh. For an establishment that continually raises its prices, serving cold, subpar food is an insult to the customer.
The Bottom Line
The price gouging, the cold food, the rude staff, and the utterly disgusting and unsafe environment make this location unconscionable. I strongly urge the franchisee and corporate management to address this immediate crisis of quality and safety.
Future Customers: Drive Past!
Do yourself a huge favor and drive the extra distance to the McDonald’s at 35th Ave & Van Buren or 7th St & Durango. Not only are those locations clean and offer better customer service, but their prices are often slightly cheaper. This 7th Ave location is actively driving customers away. AVOID.
reviews.author: Ashantis Payne

reviews.text:
⚠️ Decline in Experience (Post-1AM):

Barricades & Forced Ejections: Multiple reviews now confirm that after 1 AM, the staff begins to clear out customers, even though it still claims to be open 24 hours. People are often ushered out or denied indoor access, especially if they’re not actively ordering food.

Hostile Staff Behavior: Late-night employees are reportedly hostile, with some customers saying they were rushed, yelled at, or refused service after certain hours without explanation.

Change in Atmosphere: It used to be bustling 24/7, but now it's often quiet, restricted, and less inviting, especially in the overnight hours.

🚫 Features That Are Gone:

Aquarium: Removed.

Custom Pizza & Pasta Stations: Removed or closed early.

Arcade Area: Still present in some form, but Disney and themed features feel limited or outdated.

Charging Stations: No longer accessible or removed entirely.

Elevator Restrictions: “Drinks Only Available First Level” shows how access is now limited, possibly to discourage loitering or overnight lounging.

📉 Why It Matters:

This location was once a flagship of 24/7 customer experience, drawing in tourists and locals alike for the novelty and size.

Now, it feels more like a standard McDonald’s with security measures, and less of a family attraction or late-night hub.

Real Review Themes (Summarized):

⭐ "Used to be fun—now it’s sterile and overly controlled."

⚠️ "Kicked out at 1:30 AM even though it's 24/7."

🚫 "Arcade is tiny, no more aquarium."

😠 "Staff were extremely rude and unwelcoming after midnight."

❌ "Don’t go late expecting the full experience—it’s a ghost of what it was."

I was very disappointed by the behavior of the manager, Tiffany, during my visit. The way she spoke to employees was rude, antagonizing, and completely unprofessional. If an employee made a simple mistake, there was no need for her to speak to them in a nasty or demeaning manner—especially in front of customers.

Mistakes happen, and a manager should lead with patience, respect, and proper coaching. Instead, her tone and attitude created an uncomfortable environment for both staff and customers. This type of behavior reflects poorly on the restaurant and the brand as a whole.

If you go to this location DO NOT BRING CASH. Because you will not be helped...

reviews.text:
I usually order through the McDonald’s mobile app because it is convenient, lets me use rewards points, and makes pickup fast. This time, I placed my order as always, confirmed the location, and went to the drive-thru. At the first window, the worker asked for my code, confirmed my name, and said “Gotchu.” Everything seemed normal.
When I got to the second window, things completely fell apart. I waited a long time, saw employees looking around for my order, and eventually someone asked me what I ordered. I showed them my app with the confirmed order and location. After more waiting, the manager came and told me she did not see my order in their system and refused to give me my food, even though my app clearly showed the order placed at that exact McDonald’s with the correct address.
I explained that if my order was not there, how did the person in the first window know my name after providing the code, since you never provide your name when ordering. Instead of resolving the issue, the manager just kept insisting I cancel the order, told me to leave, and even threatened to call the cops when I pushed back and showed proof of purchase. The app itself says to talk to the manager if there is a problem, which is what I was doing, but she was dismissive and unprofessional.
This location needs better training and accountability. The customer service was extremely poor and the way the situation was handled was unacceptable. I would strongly recommend avoiding this McDonald’s location.

reviews.text:
I’m a normal 30yo guy. Writing reviews for fast food spots or any spots for that matter isn’t my deal. But…this is different. This is one of the most poorly run fast food locations I have ever been to in my life.

It’s baffling just how incompetent the people who work here are. They have this system where one person floats up front asking for Uber Eats / Doordash numbers. They also have to cashier. What ends of happing every…single…time is a crowd forms at both the counter and cashier line. Everyone is pissed and at least one group is neglected. I’ve seen people wait in line for minutes on end with not a single word said to them. Mainly because the person floating is a young kid who doesn’t have the best social : professional skills. They just blankly look at people and ask for numbers. It ticks me off so much which is alarming because nothing bothers me.

And this location is notorious for forgetting food items. On my last visit I ordered four items. One item was missing so I asked for it. 20 mins went by before I got it. I asked if I could have me entire order remade obviously. Management came out with bug eyes like I was the crazy one. My “new” food came out but it was the same cold food but this time another item was missing! I waited 10 minutes for this item. I asked if I could have my order remade. 10 minutes go by. When I tell you another item was missing along with all my sauces I wanted to go in the back and make my food myself.

What is going on in the back. The manager at this place needs to seriously lock in and figure something out. I’m a Senior Full Stack Developer. I have to manage and maintain architecture for massive corporations. We’re talking milllions of dollars on the line. 24 developers under me. It’s like dude….this is a Mcdonalds. Make sure the people who were hired to make food read their tickets. Revamp your Uber Eats / Doordash / Cashier mess up front.

There should be a person superglued to the front who is professional and likeable. It’s a barren wasteland upfront as is. The lack of anyone being upfront makes your blood boil. You can feel the anxiety from people waiting upfront. You go to Chick Fil A and the staff are so nice. They have people in their designated spots who are extremely competent. I never have to check my food there because they know how to manage and hire kids. I’m never going to this Mcdonald’s ever again. It is a blight on downtown San Diego.

This is all the managers fault 1000%

I would be so embarrassed to go to work to do the absolute worst job day in and day out. Having worked in the food industry, I’m very compassionate towards everyone who decides to do this type of work. But it’s places like these that make you want to bash on these people. It’s like oh yeah, whoever’s in the back dropping fries…I wouldn’t trust them with a damn thing. I’m convinced everyone who works at this location has the mind of a ladybug. Absolutely nothing going on in the frontal cortex.
reviews.author: Joshua Tillman

reviews.text: This has got to be by far the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The staff here are very rude, especially the manager. I stopped by this location because my father who eats there quite often, was there, and went to say "Hi". My father told me it was ok to bring my ebike inside, because he had personally seen people bring in their bikes, and never once has the manager said anything to anyone. He also said he's witnessed homeless people bring their dogs in the restaurant and they be laying on the tables! Gross! This restaurant allows homeless people to bathe and hang out all day. Anyway, the manager approached me, telling me to take my bike from in front of the door, which i did, since it was in the doorway. I moved to where it was not interfering with anyone, and she still had a problem. Now several customers are saying she NEVER  said that to anyone. By now my order was being prepared. I told her I'm waiting on my order, and she tells her staff to never take my order again. She claimed it was a store rule. So why did they take my order in the first place? After she said that, I took out my phone and began recording. Two customers entered with bikes. A homeless lady with a stroller full of stuff parked it in the same doorway my bike was at, and no one said a word. Both customers that brought in bikes were not harassed either. Then another homeless guy entered with a dirty dog, I watched employees walk past and not say a word! Even though there is a sign saying pets not allowed. The manager,  Anastasia, is HORRIBLE, and she obviously trained her staff, because they are just as horrible! If I could give ZERO stars, I would! Throw the whole restaurant away!

reviews.text:
Dear McDonald’s Management,

I have always appreciated your chain for its standards of service and the speed of order fulfillment. However, my recent visit on December 29, 2024, at 11:05 AM to your location at [insert address here] left me deeply disappointed.

Despite the promise of quick service, I had to wait over 20 minutes for my order. For a fast-food restaurant, this is unacceptable, as it undermines the core concept of “fast food,” which is fundamental to your brand.

Furthermore, I witnessed a situation that caused even greater concern. Some employees appeared distracted from their duties and were feeding homeless individuals instead of focusing on customer service. While assisting those in need is commendable, such behavior during peak hours in a busy restaurant comes across as unprofessional and negatively impacts the experience for other guests.

I urge you to address the organization of the staff at this location, provide appropriate training to ensure professionalism, and implement measures to maintain your service standards. As your customer, I trust that my concerns will not go unnoticed and that steps will be taken to prevent such incidents from occurring in the future.

I would appreciate your feedback and information on the actions that will be implemented to rectify this situation.
reviews.author: Serhii Krus

reviews.text: I had very poor service this evening at store 3181 on 1280 Park Blvd, San Diego, Ca 92101. I did a mobile order because it's usually faster and pulled up to the window at 7pm this evening. I was asked to pull forward to the second pickup window at the restaurant. I waited there for 20 minutes. I've knocked on the window and no one answered. I had to leave my car,  with my wife and kids, at the drive thur window and walk in the restaurant. I stood there for another 5 minutes with none of the employees acknowledging that i was there. I had to partially walk in the kitchen to get service. I've asked one of the associates closest to me, where my order was and that I've been waiting at the second pickup window for 20 minutes. He reached around the corner and pulled the happy meal and threw it on the counter and left. The food has been sitting there and is cold. I couldn't get service after that so i just the threw the food away and left. This is the worst experience i ever had. No apologies no nothing. You need to train your employees better customer service, if they don't like working there, they need to be terminated.  You will loose a lot of customers that way.
reviews.author: Peter Ma

reviews.text:
The location itself is pretty good, but the cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired. The tables and seats are always covered in the last customers' crumbs, so I wouldn't call it clean.
My main issue is with management and the employees, who are frankly incompetent. I ordered for three people (the same order for all three) and the wait time wasn't bad—it was actually fairly good. Just be warned there's no self-serve station for refills outside; you have to ask an employee, though it could be worse.
The real problem was how they called my order. Someone from the kitchen was yelling out order numbers with what sounded like an angry tone. When I went to pick up my order, I couldn't figure out who was calling my number because there was no one at the front counter. Turns out the employee was hiding behind a corner with my order—I couldn't even see her. It was incredibly confusing.
And for a dine-in order, they didn't bring the food to my table, which is also poor service.
The food itself was fine. It's just hard to understand why you'd call out order numbers sounding angry while hiding where customers can't see you.
reviews.author: Jesus Hernandez

reviews.text: The wait for delivery drivers is too long...at night they make us wait 40mins to 1 hour+ once their lobby closes.  You will see them prioritizing the drive-thru even though they don't understand that delivery drivers are also delivering food orders so they have to go out by a certain time or else they get cold or worse. We get orders canceled and we waste our time. It's just a mess at this McDonald's there's no organization and the managers don't help either. There's only one manager that's good and that's during the daytime but the night manager sucks. Don't expect to get your food quickly. If you're a delivery driver, they treat us like trash. And while I get it, some delivery drivers are really rude. There are some of us that actually do our job really well and our whole job is dependent on time.

As a secret shopper this is terrible for the business and a coworker for the BBB you guys messed up big time. The overall ranking will be lowered extremely. Horrible mistake. Yall sounded and looked silly. This job is y'all's exact level of education. Imagine being a mad employee at McDonalds thats embarrassing.

I have never experienced customer service this bad in my life—at ANY McDonald’s, anywhere. I came through the drive-thru for a DoorDash pickup and it turned into the most ridiculous, chaotic mess I’ve ever seen.

First, the employee at the window didn’t give me my order… because it wasn’t even READY. Then when they finally handed me a bag, it was completely the WRONG order—like not even close. When I politely told them it wasn’t mine, the employee acted like I was trying to steal food I didn’t even want. The attitude was unbelievable. Eye-rolling, huffing, talking under their breath… the whole thing felt like a bad comedy skit.

They said they were going to cancel the order so I could move on, but of course… they didn’t. Instead they just stood there arguing and holding up the window like everyone else’s time didn’t matter. They kept the entire drive-thru line frozen for over 10 minutes with cars wrapping around the building. People behind me were literally sticking their heads out of their windows wondering what on EARTH was going on.

I’ve never seen a line move that slow at ANY fast-food place. It was beyond frustrating—it was horrendous, outrageous, and honestly embarrassing for the store. If this is the level of customer service they think is acceptable, I can’t imagine how they stay open.

Absolutely the worst experience I’ve ever had. Avoid this location if you value your time, your sanity, or even just basic human respect.
reviews.author: Erika Gonzales

reviews.text: The male staff by the window accepting payment for orders was very rude. I stayed in that window and no one opens the window to take my card/payment and the staff inside has it's back facing us and was talking for awhile to someone. After waiting I thought maybe I'll have to pay in the second window since this no one is assisting us in the first one. How would I know right? If you have long line you should pay attention to who is in your window. so I moved pass the first window but not too far yet, since the line was so long. The staff finally open the window and didn't even apologize that they were not even in the window attending to the customer, got upset and told me "you I didn't pay" in a tone like I'm running away. I said I didn't know if I'll pay here bec the window is close and he said they always keep the window close. I handed him my card and instead of apologizing for their mistake, told me I should always stop and pay in that window.. I understand that but to argue with me and told me I should always stop in that window is not nice. It's okay if I moved forward without stopping in the first window waiting for someone to get my payment but none.so  This person is very rude, impolite and needs to learn good customer service. Your shop will not benefit if you have people who are like that. Treat your customer nicely no matter what and don't always assumed that someone is running away without paying their food. reviews.text:

and he simply moved on like he didn’t ask me anything
At that point I knew my order was going to be messed up. I’ve worked at fast food, so I am usually very emphatic when it comes to other fast food workers.
Once I reached the window, I noticed on my receipt they did not charge me for one of the items.
I let them know that the guy didn’t get my whole order and asked if I could get it and I would happily pay.
2 minutes pass and the women at the window stares at me for a few seconds before telling to look at the bottom of my bag
I inform her that I have not received any bag, and she laughs nervously and goes to get it

I’m still calm at this point, until we check the bag and I confuse my McRib for nuggets and inform them. They tell me to check again, so I do and I then notice that it’s actually the McRib and I still haven’t gotten the Nuggets.

Another women in the back is rolling her eyes and this is where I no longer have my empathy.

This was a terrible experience and know that they can do better because they’ve done it before. This was disappointing and just time consuming for no reason.

reviews.text:
I am writing to share my recent experience at the McDonald's located at 1000 Commerce St, Dallas, TX 75202. I visited onSunday, July 6 2025
Unfortunately, the service I received was significantly below the standards I normally expect from McDonald's.
My primary concern was the extremely slow service. After placing my order at the counter, I waited for over 20 minutes for a simple 2 coffee and an ice cream. During this time, I noticed that the staff seemed disorganized, and several other customers who ordered after me received their food first. This long and frustrating delay was very inconvenient as I was on a tight lunch break.
In addition to the wait, the interaction with the staff was not pleasant. When I politely inquired about the status of my order after 15 minutes, the employee I spoke with was dismissive and did not provide a clear update, simply saying it was "coming." The general atmosphere felt stressed, and there was no apology or acknowledgment of the significant delay from anyone on the team.
I understand that the downtown location can be busy, but the lack of efficiency and the impersonal service were very disappointing. I hope this feedback can be used to improve staff coordination and customer service training at this specific restaurant. I have always valued McDonald's for its speed and reliability, and I sincerely hope this location can make the necessary improvements.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.

reviews.text:
Well, during our recent visit to Paris we dined at this place, it was on 25th of Dec, there were a lot of people and the staff were really stressed and impatient. We faced multiple issues, we had ordered Large fries, the fries provided were broken (pic) and were poorly cooked. Instead of Cappuccino, we had been given Espresso (pic), ofcourse the exchange was provided without any excuse. And the level of stench that was emanating from the toilet was unbearable. Certainly the worst experience we had with the McD till date and that too on one of the most well known streets. Being a vegetarian, found '0' options for veg burger also.
This experience sealed it for me, no more McDs!

Additional text (added on 2nd Jan 23), called to the contact provided of the store, not sure if the person understood what I spoke, got the call cut. The better I can do is to drop an email as there are language constraints. Let me know.
reviews.author: Vishwas Nagaraju

reviews.text:
Food quality: below criticism (photo attached).
Humanity: zero.

There was strong, cold wind blowing, so our group of 8 people + 1 dog wanted to step inside. Since there was no pictogram and no written sign stating that dogs are not allowed, we entered with my shivering dog — only into the entrance area — so we wouldn’t disturb anyone while the rest of the family was ordering.

After half a minute, the security guard forced us out. I repeatedly pointed out that there was no sign prohibiting dogs. Despite this, he became louder and louder, shouting “OUT!”

We then sat outside in the freezing cold and waited for the others.

Later, I received something that could barely be called food.

The only positive thing was that the hot chocolate was perfectly made and the barista was very nice.

I honestly hope the place goes bankrupt and gets replaced by an O’tacos or another more decent food chain.
reviews.author: Zsolt Kiss

reviews.text:
I actually love Mcdonald’s but this is the worst I have ever been. Self service down, dirty on every inch. They check you at entrance like a terrorist. Burned, dry, tasteless burgers with old cold fries. The only thing I was expecting from this place was a simple cheeseburger with some crispy fries, the same flavor I have tasted on every other Mcdonalds in Europe, but nope, not even that.

They charge you .50 euro cents for nasty bathrooms with no separation for men and women so you might see some guy waving his penis as he finishes peeing. No hand soap. I only had 5 .10 coins so I asked the cashier for a .50 but she told me she had none so as a customer my options were just to pee myself there or wait for some other customers to help me.

I hated this place. This place damages Mcdonalds brand.
reviews.author: Denisse Miranda

reviews.text: This was the worst experience at a McDonald’s we’ve ever had. They messed up order and then tried to blame us for them giving us someone else’s order but the correct drink order. Chicken nuggets are not a hamburger and fish sandwiches aren’t cheeseburgers plus cold fries. They took our receipt and then once we sat down we realized they didn’t give us cheese fries. So we went back up and they wanted to argue again. Since we didn’t have receipt that they took we couldn’t prove and apparently they are unable to look up the order that we memorized the code since we had to go up there so many times. Maybe this is the French way but I’m confident it’s not McDonalds Corp a trusted American brand.  Managers were even rude we attempted to talk to them politely.
reviews.author: Scouts BSA

reviews.text: The token system for the bathroom is the dumbest system I have ever seen and an embarrassment for the international McDonalds brand. I asked the lady behind the counter for a token, as it says on the receipt, for her to tell me to present my receipt in the bathroom. Present it to who? There was no one posted in the men’s for the entire time I was at the McDonalds. I checked a few times over the 45 minutes I was there. My partner got a token from a lady working in the women’s bathroom for me to use. Then there is the more concerning issue that someone else with a token can open the toilet stall door when you are in there, which happened to me. Get rid of the stupid system and just have someone clean the toilets more often if that’s the issue.
reviews.author: James Middleton

reviews.text:
Very poor practice, maybe discriminatory. Women have to pay to use the toilet or show a receipt, men just walk straight in. Why is it different for men and women? Shouldn't it be the same?
I do not agree with the reply from the owner. On the day we visited, men and women were being treated differently. Only access to the ladies toilets was restricted. A member of staff was only asking for proof of purchase from women. Men just simply skipped the queue and walked straight in the gents toilets, no token or showing a receipt needed for men.
Visited in June 2025 and exactly the same thing again.  Only women being asked,  men just walk straight in the toilets.

Food was really good from the McCafe.
reviews.author: Ian

reviews.text:
Visited the McDonald's on the Champs-Élysées and it was honestly a terrible experience. We waited 45 minutes just to order at the self-service display – completely disorganized. Even though there were free tables, there were no table numbers available, which made things even more frustrating.

The food quality has really gone downhill. I know it's fast food and expectations should be realistic, but the gap between the photos and what you actually get is almost laughable.

I only went because of my kids, but honestly, there are other fast-food chains doing a much better job these days – both in quality and service.

reviews.text: Ordered an m&m McFlurry using a kiosk with English selected as the language. At no point did it indicate that there would be peanuts in the McFlurry as the title of the item was 'Regular McFlurry - M&M'. Upon getting the order, my girlfriend took the first bite of the McFlurry and noticed it had peanuts, which is very fortunate as if I had taken the first bite or she had not noticed I would have gone into anaphylactic shock. We returned to the McDonalds asking for them to make us an Oreo one and that they should really ensure that an item containing peanuts is clear about that allergen - especially something that normally would not like M&Ms. Both the worker at the register and the manager who she went and got gave us attitude as though we were fools for not knowing that all McFlurries in the Netherlands have peanuts and they very begrudgingly made us a terrible Oreo mcflurry which they did not attempt to mix at all. I would highly advice against going to this McDonalds and instead spend your money somewhere will they will at least treat you with a bit of respect in the event that you're trying to avoid death.
reviews.author: Jonah Fairweather

reviews.text:
Visited two nights in a row and had issues both times. First night, I wanted to dine in, but was told no trays are given out in the evening, only a paper bag — awkward and messy for dine-in.
Second night, I tried to return a reusable cup to get my €1 deposit back, but they refused because I hadn’t bought it that same evening. I explained another McDonald’s told me returns are accepted at any location since you ordered to-go, but the manager insisted it’s their policy to prevent “homeless people cashing in cups.” He said as a private franchise, they can make their own rules.
Not only was the reasoning off-putting, but the attitude was dismissive and unhelpful, I dropped it and left since it is only one euro but at the same time is only one euro why did they feel the need to fight me on this.
I read other reviews that report similar issues here — poor service, dine-in orders in bags, and confusion around cup deposits. Policies feel made up on the spot.
Would not recommend McDonalds in Amsterdam.
reviews.author: Brian Sanchez

reviews.text:
I am reaching out to share a recent experience at the McDonald's branch in Amsterdam's city center, which I believe highlights areas for improvement in customer service. During my visit, I ordered a Happy Meal but found no option for a cheeseburger. Upon addressing this at the counter, the staff mentioned it was not possible to modify the sandwich, which I understand is within policy. However, when I placed a new order for a sandwich with added lettuce, the employee's behavior was notably unprofessional. She left abruptly, returned to complete the order, but did not include the requested lettuce.

The interaction was disappointing, as I do not expect to pay for a second sandwich, wait again, and experience unkind treatment. Such behavior does not align with the standards I associate with McDonald's and reflects poorly on the brand.

I kindly suggest reviewing this branch's customer service practices to ensure a more positive experience for future patrons.

Looking forward to your response.
reviews.author: Abdullah Al-Habib

reviews.text:
I ordered a hamburger based on its shape, and didn’t check which was its name since I was in hurry.
The printer of self order did not work, and it did not give me receipt.
When I explained them that there is problem in the printer and i showed my payment in my Dutch bank account, they hesitate to give me my order. They waisted my time a lot to give me my order, I never and never order from this brand. After my order the manager ( an Indian man put new paper in printer ). Is this correct behaviour on the condition that your printer has problem and I am showing my bank transaction with its time that prove I had order this branch of Mac Donald ?????
I will send a complaint to McDonald, since your behaviour was fully impolite just for 8 euros!
reviews.author: Alireza Soltani Nezhad

reviews.text:
We were very tired from visiting Amsterdam, and sat down to eat. We had to order on consoles, only two men working in the kitchen. No time to answer questions.
When we wanted to go to the toilet, there was not any. That is forbidden by law for such an establishment!!
We were directed to Mc Donalds in the Nieuwstraat, and there we had to pay. The foreign cleaner said everybody had to pay 1,5 Euro for the toilet. As I protested that is is against the law, the foreigner working there admitted us without us having to pay.

Mc Donald's is a tourist trap, and a scam. To be avoided!
It seems that you can avoid  having to offer a toilet to your customers just by asking an exaggerated amount of money!
reviews.author: Paula V

reviews.text:
Absolutely filthy.

This was one of the worst McDonald’s experiences I’ve ever had. On a typical Sunday afternoon, trash was overflowing from the bins and scattered around them. There was spilled Coke across the floor, and food littered the kitchen area.

The food itself was dry and tasted like it had been sitting out for a while.

Worst of all, the food preparation area was a mess. Lettuce and other toppings were scattered across the counter, and I watched as one staff member gathered it all with his bare hands, threw it in the trash, wiped his hands on his pants, and then continued making food without washing them.

This location is in serious need of attention and improvement.

reviews.text:
Das Personal war sehr unhöflich. Meine Freundin und ich bestellten das Smart Menu und das Spezialmenü mit einem „Friends“-Becher und Matcha mit Hafermilch. Alles war an der Selbstbedienungskasse verfügbar. Wir bezahlten und warteten an einem Tisch auf unsere Bestellung. Dann kamen sie zu uns und sagten, es gäbe keine Hafermilch. Das war zwar ärgerlich, aber kein großes Problem. Anschließend hieß es, es gäbe auch keinen „Friends“-Becher. Ich war empört und fragte nach, da wir ja für dieses Menü bezahlt hatten. Das Personal war jedoch sehr unhöflich und schrie mich an: „Was sollen wir denn machen? Es ist bezahlt, und bei McDonald’s gibt es keine Becher mehr.“ Unter dem Druck brach ich in Tränen aus, nahm Matcha mit normaler Milch und ging zu meinem Tisch. Niemand vom Personal beachtete mich danach noch. Ich bin sehr enttäuscht von diesem McDonald’s, da dieser Standort mein Lieblingsrestaurant war.

Update:

Gestern, nach dem Essen, kam die Managerin auf mich zu und schlug vor, ich solle am nächsten Tag mit dem Kassenbon vorbeikommen und nach einem Becher fragen. Vielleicht wären sie bis dahin schon da. Ich tat das, und heute erinnerte sie sich noch an die gestrige Situation. Sie war sehr höflich und nett. Ehrlich gesagt war sie die einzig nette und freundliche Mitarbeiterin im ganzen Restaurant. Sie muss die Managerin sein, denn sie trägt ein gelbes T-Shirt mit dem McDonald's-Logo, das sich von der Kleidung der anderen Angestellten unterscheidet. Vielen Dank an sie und dafür, dass sie mir geholfen hat, die Situation zu klären!
reviews.author: Nadia Kamalova

reviews.text:
I order a "Big Tasty Bacon Chili Cheese", for €6.59, but they give me a burger without bacon (just "Tasty Chili Cheese").
Sadly, it's not the first time McDonald's forgets to put bacon in a bacon burger.
Before leaving I go to the bathroom and I bump into a McDonald's employee on the stairs who asks me 1€ (without a receipt) to use the bathroom. Basically extortion. It is absolutely not a McDonald's behavior and standard.
In un'altra occasione ho preso un burger da 3,59€ abbastanza misero, come da foto.
Tornato nell'aprile 2025, al desk sono bruschi: mi presento col mio numero in attesa di conferma per portare via il panino, la commessa nemmeno verifica la corrispondenza del numero e mi dice di andarmene. Chiunque poteva andare lì a prendersi il mio pasto senza conferme. Al tavolino scarto l'involto e trovo una cosa orrenda, con l'hamburger staccato dal panino: non sono nemmeno capaci di assemblare i componenti.
reviews.author: V Castellana

reviews.text:
Servus,

Dieser McDonald’s ist leider nicht zu empfehlen.

Sehr dreckig und nicht gepflegt. Wenn man reinkommt, liegt sehr viel Müll am Boden, ja mehr reinigen wäre wohl angesagt.

Zum Empfang wird man von paramilitärisch angezogen Security Personen angehaucht, sich nicht falsch zu verhalten. Lustige Tatsache, wenn man bedenkt, dass man hier einfach nur was essen will.

Danach habe ich beobachtet, wie zwei Securitys grundlos auf eine Person zugegangen sind und diese auf gut bayrisch zur Sau gemacht haben.

Ich habe darauf das Gespräch mit einem Mitarbeiter von McDonald’s gesucht.
Diese Person war sehr verständnisvoll und nett, jedoch hatte sie wohl kein Einfluss auf die aggressiven Security Mitarbeiter.

Sehr schade, solche aggressiven Security Personen sollten eigentlich keinen Zutritt haben, auf einem Bereich mit normalen Menschen!
reviews.author: Cloude Ruomand

reviews.text:
We know McDonald's for the taste of its hamburgers, the variety of its menus, and the constant ordering errors. But at McDonald's im Tal, they've taken it to another level: putting the customer's word in doubt and insinuating that a 10-year-old child lied. This is intolerable.
I could write about the evening in detail, but I'll save that for later...
I suggest removing the reference to "restaurant" in the description of Mcdonald's. It's not a restaurant, it's fast food, and that's fine. A restaurant is something else: more professionalism, respect and culture.
Yesterday you showed me that you have none of these qualities.
I'm waiting for a sincere apology, because I'll definitely be coming back and this time I'll be extremely vigilant about your "service"...
reviews.author: Yann Henry

reviews.text: Una stella perché zero non ne posso dare. Due donne, urgenza di andare in bagno, toilette stazione Termini non alla mano e oltretutto assenza di posti a sedere, uno schifo di stazione con persone sedute per terra sui bagagli, nonostante siamo nella nostra capitale, come i barboni , e già qui stendiamo  un velo pietoso. Decidiamo di andare appena fuori difronte c'è il Mc, giusto per andare in bagno e sederci. Prendiamo due cose, mia figlia patatine io un milk shake, premetto che non entro più in un Mc Donald's da parecchi anni non frequentando più nessun fast food ma quello che ho visto è stato vergognoso e schifoso  in tutto. Patatine scadute (significa che avevano superato di gran lunga i 5 minuti dalla cottura ) oscene, sia l'aspetto che la quantità, non so come abbia fatto a mangiarle mia figlia. Milk shake sporcato di cioccolato, era tutto surrogato latte, a livello metà bicchiere e senza coperchio!!! Bagno con serratura rotta e indefinibile dalla puzza e sporco che c'era!!! Una vergogna!!! Soprattutto per donne e bambini!!! Io e altre donne turiste abbiamo dovuto fare a turni per tenerci la porta!!! Ma scherziamo???? Dov'è andato a finire il ristorante per famiglie?????? Strapieno di turisti, extracomunitari, e gente di passaggio, prendo il biglietto per velocizzare il servizio cassa e poi vanno avanti quelli senza biglietto facendo prima di me!!! Il caos totale. Pessimo. Sporco. Una vergognosa copia di quello che dovrebbe essere un vero Mc Donald's. Adesso parlo da ex dipendente responsabile sala  Mc Donald's apertura  Vr. La formazione rigidissima ricevuta e che ribadivo a sua volta ai nuovi crew comprendeva le 3 famose iniziali Q. S. P. : qualità, servizio, pulizia. Dove sono andate a finire qui dentro??? Saranno anche cambiati i tempi ma il successo e la filosofia di questo fast food è racchiuso tutto in queste tre iniziali seguite  in ogni parte del mondo. Io qui  ho visto solo  la feccia di tutto ciò che dovrebbe essere il contrario di un Mc,  mi auguro che qualcuno intervenga su questa filiale per ripristinare tutto, e che si prendano  delle responsabilità in merito.

reviews.text:
One of the worst staff I've come across. I was looking for seat four, and I found them on the ground floor. I stood there while waiting for my parents to come over (my sister was bringing them from the entrance of the train station), and there came another old couple who was looking for seats as well. Somehow, I think the staff (maybe the manager, with blond shoulder-length hair) came over and told me to vacate the seats for the old couple and said I should not be there if I didn't order food. I told her I would order the food once my parents were here and if I left, there would not be seats for my parents. I also explained that my parents are old and cannot climb stairs because their legs and knees will hurt. But she insisted I leave and kept pointing upstairs. At the same time, I pointed over to the seats beside me where Italians were occupied with their luggage. I said why not ask them to vacate their luggage but insist that I, a customer bringing business to your store, go away? The staff again said no and that I had to move.

So the old couples slide into the seats and sit while the staff leaves. Then my parents came, and I and my sisters were without a seat. That is when another guy staff came out and asked the Italians who occupied the seats with their luggage to move their luggage so customers could sit and eat. The lady staff could have done that earlier and caused less fuss.

That lady staff is acting like the boss so I assume she is the place's manager and I hope she still is the manager. But her attitude will one day take a toll on herself.
reviews.author: ks 92

reviews.text:
We ordered three sets of hot breakfast with omelettes and bacon at 0600 am CET 21 Dec 2024  Despite our order being displayed on the serving board, it was inexplicably cancelled.

Despite multiple inquiries with staff, including a suspected supervisor, we were met with dismissive responses and assurances that our food would arrive soon. We observed numerous orders for the same hot breakfast being served while ours remained delayed.

Despite informing staff that we had a train to catch at 0715 and had been waiting since 0600, our concerns were disregarded. When our food finally arrived at approximately 0640, it was cold.

The staff member, instead of acknowledging the significant delay and offering a sincere apology, requested me to remain calm, implying that the cooking time for eggs was the reason for the delay.
This was unacceptable, especially considering that we had already waited for over 40 minutes.

McDonald's is classified as a fast-food restaurant. A 40-minute wait for breakfast is completely unacceptable, especially when coupled with the dismissive and unhelpful attitude of the staff.

I am extremely disappointed with this experience and will not be returning to this particular McDonald's location in the future.
reviews.author: Nicole Tse

reviews.text:
I visited McDonald’s at Roma Termini and had a disappointing experience. While the food delivery was fast, the staff’s behavior left much to be desired. After finishing my meal, I politely asked a staff member in the dining area about the restroom location. Her response was dismissive, stating that McDonald’s doesn’t provide toilet facilities and directing me to use the terminal’s public toilets instead.

However, what I observed was shocking. The dining area is partitioned with the adjacent Roadhouse restaurant, and from McDonald’s seating area, I could clearly see a restroom accessible to Roadhouse customers. This suggests that McDonald’s likely has restroom facilities but chooses to deny them to their own customers, reserving them exclusively for Roadhouse patrons.

This lack of basic amenities and the rude attitude of the staff made for an unpleasant visit. Such a well-known brand should ensure better facilities and customer service.

Orbene, recatomi presso il bancone inferiore, ho cortesemente ordinato la specialità della casa, il 'Menu 1955', premurandomi di specificare con fermezza la mia avversione per la lattuga. Con mio sommo sdegno, e con sprezzo della mia richiesta, mi è stato invece servito un pasticcio croccante di dubbia natura, inondato di salse biancastre e guarnito — ahimè — proprio con quell'insalata che avevo espressamente ripudiato.

reviews.text:
McDonald’s used to be known for consistency and convenience, but after the recent scandal, it is impossible to see the brand with the same eyes. What should have been a simple meal now feels like a gamble with quality and safety.

The real problem is trust. Once customers start questioning what is really in the food, the entire foundation of the brand collapses. Instead of clear answers and transparent accountability, McDonald’s has responded with silence, vague statements, and corporate spin. For a company of this size, with millions of families relying on it every day, that is simply unacceptable.

Visiting the restaurants only reinforces this disappointment. Food quality is inconsistent, often served lukewarm or poorly prepared. Service is rushed and impersonal. Cleanliness in several locations falls below even basic standards. Combined with the shadow of the scandal, every bite now feels tainted with doubt.

It is shocking that a global leader would allow itself to fall so low. McDonald’s has the resources to set the highest standards in the industry, but instead it has chosen shortcuts, cost-cutting, and damage control. The scandal made one thing clear: the brand’s priorities are not the customers, but the profits.

For me, McDonald’s no longer represents safety, trust, or value. Until the company makes real, visible changes, starting with honesty, I cannot recommend it to anyone.
The golden arches are supposed to symbolize happiness, but now they only remind us of what happens when trust is broken.
reviews.author: Ivan

reviews.text:
I received extremely poor service at this McDonald’s, which is completely different from my past experiences. It’s not surprising given the number of similar comments on this site.

When I need a quick meal with good air conditioning and a decent atmosphere, I usually choose McDonald’s. However, the behavior of the "security guards" at this location was unacceptable.

I wanted to sit at a table while my friend ordered our meals (the table was not even cleaned after the last customer). A man approached me, stating that I couldn’t sit without ordering. I explained that my friend was ordering and the store was crowded, which might take some time. Despite this, he repeatedly approached me, demanding proof that my friend was actually ordering and even mimicking my actions with my phone. Trying to cooperate, I showed him my friend.

After finishing my meal, I couldn’t rest or wait for my friend to return from the restroom. Another "security guard" insisted I leave immediately. This is the first time I’ve experienced such terrible service at McDonald’s, where it felt like they were rushing to kick me out to serve new customers.

I’ve seen many similar comments requesting re-training, but it seems clear: "THEY ARE TRAINED FOR THIS MANNER" since nothing has changed in the past year.

I paid for my food and I want to sit in this restaurant until I finish it. What kind of service is this? I understand that during the Christmas holidays there are a lot of people and tourists, and this is the problem of the RESTAURANT , that there are not enough places to sit…. reviews.text:
**MUST READ BEFORE ORDERING**

This visit was BRUTAL! Where do I start. I
placed my order at the kiosk, and when waiting for the order to be made, the counter staff delivered my order to another customer. I approached the counter and asked if that order was mine and I was told to wait because mine was being made so I stepped aside to wait for my order. After waiting a few more minutes, the customer who took my order then brought back the bag with two burger wrappers opened and said his order was incorrect. The staff re-wrapped the burgers and attempted to pass it to me, before I said that I’d like the order to be remade as the previous customer had just touched two of the five items in the order. Reluctantly, the counter staff asked the order to be remade when they passed the opened bag to the assembly line where they took apart the already made burgers, threw out the buns, and reused the inside ingredients. Once assembled, the counter staff passed me two burgers and a wrap, which was three of five items I had ordered. I asked if the assembly line could please remake the order as I just had watched them tear apart the bag that had been passed to another customer and reused the ingredients for my re-made order. The on shift supervisors, Sumeet, said I was being difficult as the burgers were still warm so that meant they were fresh. After sharing my perspective on how the line crew had just thrown out the buns/wrap and reused the inside burger and wrap ingredients to remake the order, they again, reluctantly, remade the burgers/wrap. The order then was passed to me without the drink and fries. I asked the counter staff for the drink and fries, where they poured the drink, passed it to me and said that’s everything. At this point I knew this was intentional neglect. I asked if I could please have my fries, when Summet  approached me and asked what my problem was. I told him how I was still missing my fries, so he personally went and assembled my fries for me. Attached are the photos after I took my first bite of one of the burgers and noticed the fries and drink seemed to be intentionally underserved. Once I fished my meal, I looked for a garbage to dispose of my waste throughout the entire first floor. I approached the counter and asked if they had a garbage when I was told the only garbage can was on the second floor. I asked the counter staff if they had a garbage to dispose of my bag, when the male counter attendant grabbed my bag, threw out the waste, and said “it’s gone, now get out”. I honestly cannot believe the experience I had here. From counter staff, to line cooks to shift supervisors, no one seemed to take any accountability. The drink had not been poured until full, the fries were not full within the medium sized box, with a few random assortment of fries were thrown in, likewise, the chicken wrap had been made without guacamole. To add to the terrible experience, attached is a photo of the bathroom requirements, which mentioned the bathroom is free of charge to McDonalds guests only, as long as you insert 0.50 to use these facilities. Honestly, if I could rate this experience lower than a 1/5 I would. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a quick bite.
reviews.author: Will

reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ If I could give zero stars, I would.

Only if there were a rating for terrible staff, terrible service, terrible everything. Save yourself the time — this McDonald’s is a masterclass in how not to run a fast-food restaurant.

I wasn’t expecting royal treatment — it’s McDonald’s after all — but you do expect a certain basic standard across the world. Apparently, this branch missed that memo. I ordered a Big Tasty, which is supposed to come with a generous amount of Big Tasty sauce. What I got instead was a dry burger with barely a trace of it.

When I politely pointed it out, the staff member’s response was unbelievably rude. He literally pointed at the sauce smeared inside the box and told me I could dip my burger in it if I wasn’t happy — as if that was an acceptable solution. For anyone with common sense, the sauce belongs inside the burger, not painted on the cardboard like a toddler’s art project.

Instead of simply adding more sauce (a two-second job that costs them a few cents - 0.0000000001c - to be precise), they refused, argued, and I requested a refund. Brilliant business acumen — they’d rather lose a paying customer and a whole meal over a dab of sauce. Even cat food would’ve been a better option, and the pet shop staff nearby would treat you with more courtesy and intelligence than this lot.

To make things worse, my partner ordered a vanilla milkshake and asked for a straw — the staff smugly announced that they “care too much about the environment and animals” to provide one. Yet they’re perfectly fine handing out paper receipts and processed meat. The hypocrisy would be hilarious if it weren’t so pathetic.

Overall, just awful service and arrogant staff, right up to the manager who thought arguing with customers over a missing sauce was a smart move. I’d recommend literally any café or restaurant in Vienna over this McDonald’s. At least elsewhere, you’ll get your food served with some dignity — and maybe even a straw.

The manager (middle aged glasses short bald, seems like there’s a ton of negative reviews on him here lol) then asked if I had a receipt I told him no and told him what I ordered he looked at me and blatantly said “I don’t know what you want me to do with that,” I asked him if I could get a refund and he responded “refund for what.” Didn’t even let me get a word in and hid in the back blatantly ignoring us. I asked him if I could politely speak to him and he said “I don’t have time for you.” It was really just his agressive tone on top of it all that made it much worse.

I kindly asked another employee if there was anyone else around who I could speak to and told him that the manager was ignoring us not even letting me show him the transaction. The manager came back out with the same attitude.

Restaurants are absolutely allowed to turn away business, but never in my life have I seen such disregard for customers.  At first it was only myself talking to him, my friends appeared and with a large group he kicked us all out and found other reasons to ask us to leave to avoid speaking with us.

It’s McDonald’s , it’s really not that serious but interactions like this regardless of the environment are unacceptable.
reviews.author: Savanah Agas

reviews.text:
Dobrý den,

dne 11. 2. 2026 přibližně ve 13:30 jsem si spolu s kamarádem objednal menu Big Mac ve vaší restauraci. Po převzetí objednávky jsme šli do restaurace, jídlo jsme zkonzumovali a v danou chvíli se vše zdálo být v pořádku. Po návštěvě vaší restaurace jsme již nikde jinde nebyli a nekonzumovali jsme žádné jiné jídlo ani nápoje.

V 18:20, po návratu domů (bydlím mimo Prahu), se u mě náhle objevily vážné zdravotní potíže – silná bolest břicha, horečka 38,5 °C, silná nevolnost, třes celého těla a opakované zvracení. Zkonzumované jídlo z vaší restaurace jsem následně vyzvracel.

Tento stav vážně ohrozil mé zdraví a považuji jej za velmi závažné selhání v oblasti hygieny a bezpečnosti potravin.

Žádám vás tímto o okamžité prošetření celé události, kontrolu dodržování hygienických postupů na dané pobočce a odpovídající kompenzaci za způsobené zdravotní komplikace.

V případě, že neobdržím uspokojivou odpověď, budu nucen obrátit se na Státní zemědělskou a potravinářskou inspekci (SZPI) a Českou obchodní inspekci (ČOI).

Očekávám vaši brzkou odpověď.
reviews.author: Luibomyr Hendych

reviews.text:
Navštívila som pobočku McDonald’s, kde som si objednala jedlo aj nápoje – teda som bola riadnym zákazníkom. Napriek tomu som bola nepríjemne prekvapená, keď som musela za použitie toalety zaplatiť. Považujem za úplne neprimerané, že aj po zaplatení v podniku nie je prístup na WC voľný.

Okrem toho sa mi takýto prístup zdá z hygienického hľadiska problematický. Keď konzumujete jedlo rukami – napríklad hranolky alebo burger – a nemáte si kde umyť ruky bez ďalšieho poplatku, je to nielen nepohodlné, ale aj nehygienické.

Neviem, či je takýto systém v súlade s českými predpismi, ale minimálne by malo byť samozrejmé, že ak zákazník u vás míňa peniaze, mal by mať bezplatný prístup k základným hygienickým zariadeniam. Celý zážitok mi pokazil dojem z návštevy.
reviews.author: Darlin

reviews.text:
Sunday the 19 October around 16h45. The waiter at the entrance door was extremely rude and very aggressive when he approached my wife and I 2 minutes after entering the premises. He was very threatening and made us feel extremely uncomfortable. No manners when talking to us as Customers, especially when he could see we were foreigner, seen that this is a safe space and a place to experience a little bit of home when abroad. He needs to be trained on how to assist Customers with EQ and IQ and be an ambassador for the brand.
Enough said. Everything would have been better had he just been polite. Would definitely not be visiting and would definitely not advise foreigners to visit this specific McDonalds.
reviews.author: Malcolm Johnson

reviews.text:
Chtěla bych se vyjádřit k dnešní situaci,

Po tom, co jsme si s přáteli sedli a začali konzumovat objednané jídlo, neustále k našemu stolu přicházela paní, která kontrolovala vstup na toalety. Bylo to nejen rušivé, ale zároveň i neuctivé, protože po dobu, co jsme jedli, stála otočená zády přímo u našeho stolu.

Nejvíce mě ale šokovalo, že poplatky za použití toalety byly vyžadovány i od malých dětí, které měly kolem 10 let. Děti musely hledat drobné v peněženkách, aby si vůbec mohly dojít na toaletu. Takové jednání mi přijde naprosto nevhodné a neetické, obzvlášť když se jedná o zákazníky, kteří si v restauraci zakoupili jídlo a hlavně malé děti bože!
reviews.author: Veronika Řeháková

reviews.text: Dobrý den,dnes sem navštívil restauraci a zažil sem hrozně chování obsluhu,při odchodu z restaurace vzal sem tác a dal sem ho na stojan,má což proběhla paní uklízečka a začala mě chytat za ruce přej to ne dávám správně,nevím jestli to bylo správně nebo ne nejsem zaměstnanec MC ,ale  takový chování sem ne zažil v životě!to už je omezení svobody!!!dal paní uklízečka mi řekla že ten tác MUSÍM  dat správně!!!řekl sem ji ze takové chování se nedá tolerovat a že mě nemůže obtěžovat!co což vedla stala paní která byla svědkem a řekla mi že je manager restauraci a že mě vykazuje z restauraci!moc prosím o zaškolení personálu,děkuji za pochopení.
reviews.author: Stepan Lisicky

reviews.text: My husband went to the paid bathroom and I waited for him. As a woman in her seventh month of pregnancy, it was difficult for me to stand and I sat down on the edge of the stairs in the corner, so as not to disturb anyone. The restaurant employee came to me immediately and told me in Czech to get up (I didn't understand him of course), then he gestured with his hand for me to get up as if I were a dog, and finally told me in English to get up and that I couldn't sit here, even though he could clearly see my belly and that I was pregnant! Disgraceful service and complete disrespect for pregnant women!!!
reviews.author: tsip_97

reviews.text: Vítejte v devadesátých letech. Bohužel ani to, že obsluha se usmívá, je tu relativně čisto a jídlo je připravené opravdu rychle nemůže vynahradit celkový vibe tohoto místa. Zřejmě kvůli lokaci je tato pobočka dražší než ty ostatní, sendvič tasty cheese byl spíše tasteless cheese, navíc dost zmuchlaný a vrchol všemu nasazují toalety zpoplatněné i pro strávníky, navíc pouze v hotovosti. Na případnou vrátku upozorňuje jen malá tabulka u pokladen. Považuji to za zcela nepřístojné a nedůstojné a patřící nejen do jiného století, ale i tisíciletí. Rozhodně se této restauraci vyhněte.
reviews.author: Oldřich Olaf Poděbradský

reviews.text:
Byly jsme v tomto podniku, a chtěli na požadavek, samozřejmě za stejnou cenu jako je v menu, udělat Big .Mac bez prostřední housky. Bohužel, obsluha nám to nedovolila. I když v jiných místech po Praze to vždy šlo. Přičemž pan manažerů říkal, ze nám to udělá třeba bez salátu. Otázkou je, čím se liší podle jeho názoru salát v burgeru nebo Houška navíc. 😓 Obsluha vůbec nevyšla vstříc.  Hodně velké zklamání. A nepříjemné chování. Určitě tuto pobočku nedoporučuji, i když Mekac máme rádi.

Přičemž o kilometr dal, v jenem McDonalds nám burger udělat jak jsme chtěli. Via fotky.
reviews.author: Maria Skalkina

reviews.text: It is so embarrassing that McDonald's added menu in Ukrainian language with mistakes, russian letters :( it is so humiliating. Guys, we have McDonald's in Ukraine with Ukrainian menu. Call them and ask to share the code, template etc with you. I'm sure they will find the way to help you. Another thing is the toilet. In Ukraine, in Germany, in France for free. In Poland, you have it for free if you buy food in McDonald's. But not in Prague!!! You need to pay for the toilet additionally
reviews.author: Khrystyna Druzhynina

reviews.text: Оказывается, что публичном месте в конкретном Mc’donalds нужно платить сверху своего заказа , чтобы сходить в туалет. Мое личное мнение , что фраза « для вашего комфорта» неуместна , когда за публичный туалет с посетителей взимают дополнительную плату. Попросил бы них стаканчик , чтобы выдать весь мой потенциал перед входом в туалет , рядом с кассой , почему-то отказали , ссылаясь на то, что должен и здесь оплатить. Крайняя степень неуважения.
reviews.author: Денис Кучко

reviews.text: Krásný zážitek projít si noční Prahu a skončit v místě u kterého víte co za jídlo můžete očekávat ale zaplatit 10korun za záchod který je ve stavu že by za jeho použití měl platit McDonald’s mě to jsem nečekal kdyby záchod byl na vstup s učtenkou neřeknu ani popel když to člověk řekne manažerovi restaurace tak na mě kouká jako by slyšel poprvé že ty záchody jsou v katastrofickem stavu. Příště až budu v Praze McDonald’s se vyhnu obřím obloukem
reviews.author: Radek Knybel

reviews.text: Jedzenie jak jedzenie....wszedzie tak samo pyszne. Jedna gwiazdka za koniecznosc placenia za toalete....20 koron razy 3 bo bylem z dziecmi, wydajac 600 koron na jedzenie. Taka firma na swiatowym poziomie, a taki syf z tym platnym kiblem. Jestem czestym klientem tej firmy zarowno w PL, DE i SK, ale z takim hamstwem jak platna toaleta sie nie spotkalem. Wiecej nie odwiedze Mc w Czechach, a PL tez sie zastanowie czy nie lepieh do KFC jezdzic.

reviews.text:
Kiosky téměř nereagují na dotyk, u výdeje obsluha svou prací nanejvýš otrávená. Hranolky jsem dostal gumové.

Své hodnocení upravuji po zakončení návštěvy. Dejte si pozor na tohoto "muže" z jejich security firmy. V klidu si jím jídlo, když ke mně přistoupí se slovy:  "Jdi si to jíst ven, tady to zavírám." Když jsem mu řekl, že se pouze sbalím věci, začal mi nadávat do buzeranta a že si na mě počká. Tohle mi přijde naprosto odporný.

reviews.text: Chtel jsem si dojít na záchod nove mají nove stroje na to abych prošel stoji absolutne nelidskou cenu ne 10 ne 15 ale 20 korun a i pres to ze to maji vymakané tak u stroje na záchod STOJI 2 LIDI pro jistotu. tak si rikam ze za tu cenu a kontrolu ty záchody budou luxusní ale ono ani ň všechny záchody kromě jednoho byly počůraný mokry a totálně od hovinek. proč kdyz to kontroluji 2 lidi tak to nejde ani jeden uklidit???

reviews.text:
We spent over 800 CZK here, (just to be clear: we were paying customers, not random people off the street), and when we wanted to use the toilet, they said it’s paid separately. Are you kidding me?! We already spent plenty of money in this place — and they still have the nerve to charge extra just to use the bathroom. Never seen anything like this at any other McDonald’s!
Pure greed and zero respect for customers.

reviews.text: Absolutně toto  místo nedoporučuji neochotný, nepříjemný personál a za WC se platí 20 Kč i když tam necháte spousta peněz a jste host.... reviews.text:
Heute wieder einmal bei einem MC Donalds gespeist.
Im Bestellautomat leider nur Tschechisch Englisch und , oho Russisch da greifen keine Sanktionen gegen Russland, aber kein Deutsch, obwohl die Nachbarn Deutschland und Österreich ja sehr nahe sind, bei Nachfrage beim Filialchef, ist der eher unfreundlich und genervt, vielleicht könnte er sich auch einmal die Hose richten wenn er im Restaurant umherstolziert.

reviews.text:
Pozor, WC je za 20 korun, ty si pak teprv můžete nechat strhnout z ceny jídla. Nefunguje to tu jako obvykle, že byste po nákupu jídla mohli jít na toaletu jen tak.

Warning! If you want to use the toilet, you have to pay 20 czech crowns for it first and then you can get the 20 Kč out of the price of your order. It doesn’t work here as per usual, when you can enter the WC when you buy something.

reviews.text:
Éramos 4 personas.
Dos entramos a pedir y dos se quedaron fuera en la terraza en una mesa con 4 sillas.
Apareció un trabajador  del McDonald’s, repeinado hacia atrás, de muy malas maneras a decir que no se podían sentar 4 personas y retiró una de las sillas con muy mala educación, cuando en la mesa de al lado habían 5 chicas, pero claro….., las chicas eran locales y nosotros extranjeros.

reviews.text:
Всем привет , мало того что туалеты платные . Так бургеры очень маленькие . Биг тейсти в маленькой булочке !

reviews.text: Vzduchotechniku tady asi nikdo z vedení nezná. Při využití toalety po vytvoření objednávky si musí člověk zaplatit další poplatek, který bude moci využít na další objednávku. Ovšem pouze v případě, že objednávka bude minimálně za dvojnásobnou hodnotu poplatku za toalety. Zjednušeně…….totální selhání vedení této restaurace.

reviews.text:
Achtung Scammer!!!
Die Dame die die ganze zeit UNNÖTIGER WEISE beim WC-Schranken steht, stiehlt einem den Gutschein. Auch als ich die Dame darauf angesprochen habe, tat sie so als wüsste sie von nichts und versuchte schnell den Cupon in ihrer Hosentasche verschwinden zu lassen.
Eine absolute FRECHHEIT!!!
NICHT ZU EMPFEHLEN
reviews.author: Knaller Richard

reviews.text: Staff at door were rude and obnoxious, the manager and staff seemed to be more interested in guarding the bathrooms like airport security than making sure the food was well prepared and served… the complete opposite of the McDonald’s experience you should expect all over the world and they’re a disgrace to the brand
reviews.author: mark buckley

reviews.text:
I při nákupu a jídle zde musíte zaplatit za toaletu 10 Kč.

Nevadilo by mi těch 10 Kč dat, s tím nemám problém - kdyby to alespoň vypadalo jako ze to někdo uklidil alespoň 1x za měsíc.

Odpornost. Špína a smrad.

Plus jim nefunguje klimatizace a venku je 40 stupňů. Takže to tu smrdí jako v olejový sauně.

Super.

reviews.text: We spent over 500 KC just to staff informed us during picking up the order that we have to pay additionaly for the toilet. Luke seriously? If this information has been given upfront - fine, but we were informed about it after order. How is it possible to spent money and cannot use the toilet. Not recommend
reviews.author: Nekyoo

reviews.text:
Visited here for a quick stop. Members of my party used the machines to order food and wanted to use the toilet and were told they couldn’t unless they paid extra, despite a sign on the wall saying when you pay for food you are provided with a toilet voucher.
Very disappointing and won’t be back

reviews.text: Nedostal jsem velké hranolky a místo 3 omáček v 20 nuggetkam mám 2. Objednávka byla sebou a měl jsem to pro sebe a přítelkyni, kterou jsem vyzvedával po práci. Tak děkuji pěkně hlavně, že na výdeji je 5 lidí na 1 objednávku (žádná jiná nebyla v tu dobu) a stejně vydají bez hranolek......

reviews.text: The waiters are extremly arrogant and rude. If they do not want to work don't hire them! no one has to see their unpleasant faces and loud noises! If you have a choice do not come to this mcdonals go somewhere else. Also, it is very ridiculous that we have to pay for the toilet!

reviews.text: Una verdadera verguenza. Comprando comida en el local ademas te hacen pagar para hacer uso del baño. No comprendo como funciona el sistema de habilitaciones municipales. Pero me parece que es una falta total a las reglas de higiene .  Ademas de los malos modos de sus empleados .
reviews.author: Carina Taboada

reviews.text:
Also ok ein MC ist halt was es ist.
Aber wenn man hier auf das WC möchte kommst du mit deinen Beleg und dann sagt man dir nein nur Karte oder Cash... Ok wir haben soeben für 4 Personen gegessen aber das WC ist nicht inklusive. Das erste mal das ich so etwas erlebe.

reviews.text: Nedoporučuji. Objednal jsem si dvě menu a hranolky za přibližně 300 Kč. Hranolky byly studené a bez chuti, burger suchý a nevýrazný. I když byla provozovna ve špičce a plná lidí, kvalita jídla tomu vůbec neodpovídala. Celkově slabý dojem.

reviews.text: Objednali jsme si zmrzlinu, ale porce byla velmi malá – asi jako polovina běžné. Šli jsme se zeptat, jestli nejde o chybu, ale obsluha byla nepříjemná a neochotná. Řekli nám, že to je normální porce a odmítli cokoli řešit nebo vyměnit.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: Acceso al baño de pago para los clientes. Después te puedes descontar el coste pero es tienes que usarlo primero. La comida bien pero hay que pagar por complementos que en otros McDonalds van incluidos

reviews.text: Standard McDonald’s but there is a very short very angry man who works here who will yell at you for no reason. Don’t go alone as a solo female very intimidating until my friends arrived.

reviews.text:
Туалет платный (20 крон), но если ты заплатил, а потом из заказа можно вычесть стоимость прохода.
Попросила стакан горячей воды- тоже надо заплатить. С каких пор вода в стакане платная?

reviews.text: Pokud si nejdřív objednáte, musíte za koupelnu zaplatit až potom! Koupelna je otřesná, jedna skládka, špinavá a neuklízená často! Totéž můžu říct o hlavní hale!

reviews.text: Dobrý den, nová receptura Chicken Junior se sýrem je hrozná. Prosím, vraťte zpět klasickou verzi bez sýra, na kterou jsme byli zvyklí. Tohle se nedá jíst!!!

reviews.text: Jamás habíamos entrado a un local, consumido algo y aun así tener que pagar para usar el baño. Qué auténtica locura ¿Cómo puede ser legal?

reviews.text: Naprostá tragédie, kterou zjistíte až po objednání a sejití dolu, přeplněno, dlouhá doba čekání, nefunkční wc. Nedoporučuji

reviews.text: Вперше зустріла Мак із платним туалетом. Навіть руки помити безплатно неможливо. Брєд!

reviews.text: Voor meer dan 30 euro betaald, maar je moet extra betalen voor de wc. Belachelijk.
reviews.author: Tom Verdenius

reviews.text: Burgery jsou skoro bez omáček, hodně suchý.., obsluha česky nerozumí.

reviews.text: 消费了还要付费上厕所，差评！大家避雷吧。20捷克币还是去买点别的吃的！
reviews.author: Qian Wang

reviews.text:
If you’ve ever wondered what it’s like to dine in a parallel universe where burgers are rubbery, fries are soggy, and time stands still, then this McDonald’s is your dream destination!

First, let's talk about the ambiance. Ever wanted to eat in a place that looks like it was decorated by a toddler with a crayon obsession? Congratulations, you’ve found it. The flickering fluorescent lights give you that lovely interrogation room vibe, and the sticky tables ensure you’ll leave with a new texture on your elbows.

The service? Imagine waiting for an eternity, only to be greeted by someone who looks like they’d rather be in an actual dungeon than serving you. I think I saw a snail speed-walk past me while I was waiting for my order.

Now, onto the food. Ah, the pièce de résistance. My Big Mac looked like it had been assembled by someone blindfolded and mid-tornado. The lettuce was attempting a jailbreak, the patty was more cardboard than beef, and the bun was so stale I considered using it as a hockey puck.

The fries, usually the saving grace of any McDonald’s visit, arrived cold and limp, as if they had just come back from a failed audition for a fry commercial. I would have complained, but by the time I got my order, I felt like I had aged a decade and couldn’t muster the energy.

In summary, if you’re looking for a dining experience that makes you question your life choices and wonder if you’ve somehow angered the food gods, then this McDonald’s is your perfect pick. Bon appétit

reviews.text:
Bu yorumu artık sistematik bir sorunu kayıt altına almak için yazıyorum. Restorana yalnızca 2 dakika yürüme mesafesinde oturuyorum. Buna rağmen siparişlerim düzenli olarak geç, soğuk ve eksik teslim ediliyor. Bu artık istisna değil, tekrar eden bir durum.

Sorunun teslimat kaynaklı olduğunu düşünerek iki kez siparişimi restorandan bizzat kendim teslim aldım. Ancak eve geldiğimde ürünlerin yine eksik olduğunu gördüm. Bu, operasyonel bir dikkatsizlik değil; şube genelinde ciddi bir kontrol ve yönetim problemi olduğunu gösteriyor.

Çalışanlar oldukça dağınık ve sipariş kontrol mekanizması neredeyse yok. Aynı hataların sürekli tekrar etmesi, denetim ve sorumluluk zincirinde problem olduğunu düşündürüyor. Bu şubenin yönetimi tarafından temel kalite standartlarının sağlanamadığı açıkça görülüyor.

Müşteri hizmetleri hattı ise ayrı bir sorun. Şikâyet oluşturmak son derece zor. Restoran telefonuna yönlendiriliyorsunuz, ancak çoğu zaman telefon açılmıyor. Eksik ürün için “gidip kendiniz almanız gerekiyor” gibi kabul edilemez bir yaklaşım sergileniyor. Para iadesi talep edildiğinde ise iade yerine tekrar ürün gönderme öneriliyor. Müşterinin talebi yerine işletmenin tercihinin dayatıldığı bir sistem var.

Bu şube özelinde ciddi bir kalite ve yönetim sorunu olduğunu düşünüyorum. Sorunun sistematik olarak ele alınmasını ve denetlenmesini bekliyorum.

reviews.text:

2. No air conditioning. Makes one worry if the food could go bad before getting cooked

3. No hygiene standards. No cap to avoid hair falling into the food

4. Poor communication and language barrier. Not acceptable at a branch in one of the most touristy places in turkey

5. Ordering counter on 2nd floor. Definitely not meant to be accessible

I know that the food options are limited and somehow one has to fall back on the known food joints but avoid this branch at all costs.

There is a Burger King and even another branch of McDonald's on the same road.

I'll try those in next few days and comment if they're any better.

This one, is a BIG No !

reviews.text:
Once again, disappointed by the service in Belgium. McDonald’s might be at the bottom of the food chain, but sometimes you just want to relax and have some junk food. Then you go to McDonald’s, where they either mess up your order or hand you the lowest-quality food possible. After a long week, you want a simple moment to unwind, but even here, you can’t get it because these people, doing the easiest job imaginable, still manage to mess it up.

The CBO looked as trashy as possible. In the US, at least the food somewhat resembles the photos. In Belgium, despite all the bragging about food standards, it’s just gross and barely edible. The sandwich tasted bitter, like something was expired. And, of course, they couldn’t even get the salad in there—seven ingredients is apparently too much to handle.
