reviews.text: Heute Abend war ich mit einer Kollegin in diesem McDonald’s. Da wir etwas warten mussten, sind wir kurz abgesessen auf den Treppen. Nach ein paar Minuten kam ein ziemlich unfreundlicher Mitarbeiter namens Jesus die Treppen heruntergelaufen und statt uns normal darauf aufmerksam zu machen, dass wir wegsollen, hat er mit seinen Händen so Handzeichen gegeben zum Aufstehen und nicht mal was gesagt. Ich verstehe ja, dass es von unserer Seite aus auch nicht ideal war, aber nicht mal freundlich etwas sagen können, sondern Handzeichen zu geben, als wären die Kunden Hunde, geht gar nicht. Hier geht es mehr um die Umsetzung des Umgangs mit der Kundschaft als um irgendetwas anderes. Etwas später standen eine Mutter und ihre Tochter vor dem hinter der Treppe verstauten „Achtung Ausrutschgefahr“-Schild und hier hat Jesus wieder, statt sie kurz darauf aufmerksam zu machen, dass er das hinter ihnen versteckte Schild bräuchte, einfach zwischen ihnen durchgegriffen, ohne etwas zu sagen. Hier zeigt sich wieder, wie unanständig dieser Mitarbeiter war. Kurz freundlich etwas zu sagen, wäre mehr als genügend gewesen. Sein Umgang mit den Leuten ist aber komplett fehl am Platz und geht absolut gar nicht! (Not very Jesus of him, aber abgesehen von ihm gabs nichts auszusetzen.)
reviews.author: Leticia Silva

reviews.text: I was there about 9.05am the 28.01.2026 and had about 40min to eat before an appointment. The restaurant was almost empty but still took about 20-30min to cook my food (it wasn’t a menu). The bathroom door is broken so u can’t lock the door. The lady brought my food, then proceeded to ask me to open my McDonalds app without telling me for what, took my phone out of my hands to give herself a perfect review with the QR Code of the receipt, after that told me that I get a free drink for doing that, I had no time since I was going to be late to my appointment, so I didn’t have time to react. She then forgot my free drink so I had to wait about other 10min until I had to go down to remind her about the drink, while she was having a chat and mopping the floor. I arrived late to my appointment. At least the food never disappointed me.

reviews.text:
Ich weiss wirklich nicht, was hier schiefgelaufen ist, aber dieser McDonald’s schafft es, alle Erwartungen gleichzeitig zu unterbieten. Die Inderin, die uns bedient hat, war von Anfang an extrem unhöflich, sie begrüsste uns auf Indisch, SOGAR TANZ.

Unsere Bestellung wurde aufgenommen, dann… einfach ignoriert. Lange… als wäre das in Indien normal. wir standen da wie Deko, naja wenigstens geben wir was her, nicht so wie die inderin. Spoiler: Unsere Bestellung kam gar nicht.

Dazu der Hygieneeindruck: absolut widerlich. Unaufgeräumte Theke, schmierige Oberflächen, und das Gefühl, dass hier seit Stunden niemand mehr auch nur ans Putzen gedacht hat. Appetit? Komplett tot. Wir sind nicht in Indien!!!

Nie wieder. Wirklich. Nie. Wieder. Indisch überlagert. Indisch! Das geht garnicht!

reviews.text:
Absolutely disgusting! I’m actually in disbelief to have come across a McDonalds branch that is so badly kept. I’ve never needed to review a Mcdonalds in my life, because I’ve had the assumption that they all delivered a consistent level of service. Boy was I wrong! From the moment we walked it, you could tell that something was wrong. Seats were ripped up and there was chaos around the whole store.

I managed to grab a table for my family after a group had just left; however, they left the table dirty. I went to the counter to ask if someone could give it a wipe down, and the lady at the till just handed me some tissues and cleaning spray. I basically became a cleaner for 2 minutes at this branch. I am not a stuck up person, but how can you expect customers to clean up after other customers mess? Poor level of customer service and awareness.

I then went and ordered our meal using the digital screens, and took up the option to have the food delivered to our table. After 30 minutes it never came. Lo and behold, when I went to the front counter, our food was there on a tray with our table number on top. Why didn’t someone bring it over!? We then had an uncomfortable experience of other customers bringing their pets inside, so I had to fight off these dogs from eating my lunch. Why isn’t there a policy to make pet owners eat on the tables outside?!

Also couldn’t find French fries on the menu, so had to settle for these awful wedges. However, hidden in my wife’s wedges was a random French fry that managed to sneak its way in. If chips are being cross contaminated, then I wonder what else is….

When I went to the counter to ask where to find the toilets, nobody seemed interested in talking to me when they saw me approaching. It’s clear that there isn’t a manager at this branch.

Also, don’t order to ‘eat in’ if you care about hygiene. They bring your food in these recycled containers that feel like something from a child’s nursery. How do they even wash those containers properly? Yuck - put me off my food!
reviews.author: E Aca

reviews.text: While we were eating there, we felt like we were part of a social experiment. We waited 30 minutes without our order being processed. When we asked what was going on, a half-interested clerk told us that our order would be ‘remade’ and that we could wait at our table. After another 20 minutes, a woman arrived with our tray, which was full of water and Coke, and our food was floating in it. See the picture below for proof. When we asked her what had happened, she replied, "Don't you want it?" I thought we were in a simulation because the scene I was witnessing couldn't be real. Not at McDonald's. When we said the food was not edible that way, she replied the order would be remade. Then she vanished. Twenty minutes later, I went to the counter and told them I wouldn't leave until my food was ready. About 10 minutes later, our order was served. For some reason, the hamburgers were cold when they arrived. We ate our food and left in disbelief. We've never seen anything even close to this at the busiest McDonald's we've ever visited. The parent company needs to intervene immediately. This place is ruining their reputation. Thousands of people visit this location every day. All staff should be retrained. The manager should be fired.
reviews.author: Riccardo Valboni

reviews.text: Probably one of the best views you could ever hope for from a Maccies, sat on the French Riviera in Nice. Stunning. Unfortunately McDonald's can't take much credit for the view, although they did choose the location. Back to the McDonald's - service was polite and friendly, although a little slow. This is something I have found in France - they are generally not in a rush to get on with service in any cafe or restaurant (fair enough). It had been quite busy and as a result there were plenty of dirty tables and packaging left around the place. The food was decent enough, no complaints there - different menu options from the UK McDonald's, so that was good.* Just revised the review after a second visit, where unfortunately food was missed of the order and what did come was stone cold. THE worst McDonald's I have ever had. We weren't even going to be told there was no beer available and given an alternative choice.

reviews.text:
Nicely renovated McDonald's but so slow.
I was waiting 25 min for bigmac and two mochas. I had to approach an employee and ask why is it taking forever to make a bigmac when the store is empty, 80% of tables are not occupied and all people are just standing in front of the counter waiting for the orders endlessly. Guy told me to move on the side and keep waiting, after what he went across the store to closed  McCafe counter, grabbed two cups for my mocha and brought them through the entire store to the main counter, touching all people jackets and contaminating them. Finally 15 minutes after I got my bag. Total 40 min for one bigmac and two mochas.
Also they charge you a McCafe price for special crafted drinks but in fact everything is poured out of automatic Melita machine , no craft
And chocolate syrup wasn't even stired properly

reviews.text: I went here in early July 2025 around 4:30 pm and this is by far the worst mcdonalds I have been to worldwide. Upon entering it stank, there was a congestion of people waiting for their food and it was extremely hot due to the air conditioning not being on or present. After waiting 33 minutes, we saw our full order ready behind the counter (4 simple burgers) and asked if we could have our food. The person behind the counter told us to wait until our order was called. We ended up having to wait another 13 minutes for our order to be called and to our great surprise :) the food was cold. The thought was to grab a quick lunch and then continue exploring the beautiful city of Nice, but what a letdown this was. So definitely skip this mcdonalds!!!

The floors are dirty and full of trash, spilled juices are just smeared across the floor instead of cleaned, toiletes are clogged, everything was covered in urine around the urinal, you had to step in all of that because it was at least half a cm deep, sink was full of blood and clogged and the pipes for water were not working, there was no toilet seat and no toilet paper, heating is turned up so high it's impossible to sit on the top floor, we had to clean the table we were sitting at ourselves because nobody cared enough to clean them... All in all this place is such a mess it's probably breaking every single public health and safety regulation ever...

reviews.text:
Difficult to put into words how shockingly poor my experience at this McDonald’s was. The absence of urgency, care or competence was nothing short of astonishing.

Ordered 1x cheeseburger, 1x double cheeseburger and 1x medium fries to takeaway on the digital screens inside, and waited for 45 MINUTES at the counter for them to serve our order. In that time the pace of serving orders was the worst I’ve ever witnessed in a McDonald’s. No one in charge, ~30 people waiting for their order at any one time, no communication from staff and barely any movement in the kitchen.

Would be hard pushed to find a worse McDonald’s in France, possibly Europe.

reviews.text:

Also the pipes were leaking, and there were 3 buckets on the ground nearly full of water. I ordered my food and expected it to be ready in 5-10 minutes due to the place being a fast food restaurant. After 10 minutes I've seen my order ready and on the counter but after that I had to wait another 15 minutes for them to give me my food. Overall a very bad experience.

reviews.text:
Først begynne jeg med det positive. Andre etasjen på denne mccdonalden er helt nydelig, veldig rent. Ble veldig imponert, pluss man kan bestille maten levert til borde.

Så det negativ. Bestillingen til borde fungerte desverre ikke på maskinen jeg brukte. Så måtte gå ned en etasje og betale for varene. ( Slik kan jo alltid skje). Og fikk beskjed at maten blir servert til borde.

Maten ble servert til borde vårt. ( Da vi er 3 stykker som har bestilt på samme regning).
Nuggets er varm, og mcflavour fries er varm, cappucino er varm,  brusen er kald. Perfekt.

Men så var de burgerene. Big tasty bacon og big Mac. Begge er kalde. Og vanlige pommfriten er også kald.

Vi river også av en liten bit for og virkelig kjenne at den er kald innvendig.

Går ned en etasje for å si ifra. Og en daglig leder/eller sjef blir kontaktet og snakker med meg. Og beklager det og skal fikse ny.
Hun løper in og jeg ser hun kjenner på burgeren med fingeren . Så hun er nok enig at dette var veldig kald.

Så jeg spørr om de bærer maten til borde. Daa vi har jo varm drikke der.
Får beskjed at det er ikke nødvendig da de ordner kjøttet nå. Tar bare maks et minutt.
Og på maks et minutt eller kortere tid. Får jeg begge burgerene og friesen levert. Må være ikke bare Norges rekord i hurtighet på å lage burger , men må være nærme verdens rekord. Men klager jo ikke på at de er effektive.

Tar maten med til borde. Pakker ut og vi ser at det er samme burgeren vi fikk. Da den lille biten vi hadde revet av var borte.
Pluss den andre burgeren så hadde dressingen oppført seg rart/ nesten skilt seg og brødet er jo helt rart.

Gidder man å klage på nytt og må gå ned  trappen enda en gang.
Svaret er nei, så bestemmer oss for å spise opp og si ifra på vei ut.

Spørr om og få snakke med samme jenta igjen. Spurte henne om de hadde brukt micro på og varme burgeren opp.
Fikk beskjed om at de ikke har micro der ( stemmer det er det jo kjempe positivt).
Men fortalte henne at det var samme burger som ble varmet opp. Fikk beskjed nei. Og da at samme biten manglet på burgeren og fikk beskjed om at det beklager hun og skulle ta det videre.

Men alt i alt har jeg mistet all tiltro til dette stedet. Både på kundebehandling og at de tydlig bare oppvarmer maten som da har blitt kald.

Iallefall når man legger igjen  over  500 kr forventer man mer. Spesielt når vi også måtte kaste deler av den en burgeren da det hadde jo dressingen og alt slått seg feil. Legger ved bilde av den vakre retten vi fikk levert etter den var blitt oppvarmet igjen.

Men man ser hva som skjedde med brødet i midten. Var bare å kaste. Pluss burgeren var knusk tørr begge to.
Hadde forventet meg litt mer beklagelse eller annet.

Men er ikke sikkert kundene er fokuset her, og kanskje ikke mat kvalitet, eller ønske om å gi kunden det de har betalt for. Hadde iallefall forventet at de lagde ny burger og ikke varmet opp den man hadde fått.

reviews.text:
I am writing this complaint about a shift leader in  McDonald's storgata. I have had multiple unpleasant experiences with her and I believe her behavior towards both customers and employees is unacceptable.

Firstly, I have witnessed her disrespecting customers on multiple occasions. She speaks to them rudely and with contempt, which is extremely unprofessional and creates a hostile environment for customers.

Secondly, she insults the workers in front of customers. This is not only inappropriate but also unproductive and demotivating for the workers. It creates a negative atmosphere and can harm team morale.

Lastly, she loses control and becomes angry over the large number of orders. This has led to mistakes being made and customers waiting excessively long periods of time for their food. This behavior is not only unacceptable but also unprofessional and can lead to customer dissatisfaction.

I hope that you will take this complaint seriously and address the behavior of this shift leader. It is important that employees and customers are treated with respect and professionalism, and that orders are handled efficiently and accurately.

reviews.text: This place is sorely lacking in efficiency and proper management. reviews.text:
I recently ordered food online and requested delivery. When the food arrived, it was delivered by a cyclist. Unfortunately, everything was stone cold when we got it, and the bag was not wet but felt damp. I would like to have the option to choose that my food is delivered by car or at least have the option to chose. If I wasn't feeling so lazy and just wanted to stay home on Christmas day, I would have just picked it up myself. I could have driven there and picked it up in half the time that it took to have it delivered on a bicycle. I ordered two regular Cokes, but both of them were Diet Coke, which is disgusting. Also, why does the app divert the order to a McDonald's that is further away? There are two McDonald's within a half a kilometer of my location, but the app chose to deliver from one that is 5 km away???

The burger looked like it had been sat on, the Mcnuggets were stone cold, and the fries were not fresh. I was surprised because I have driven to this McDonald's many times and always gotten home with hot fries.

Deliver fee $3.99
Service Fee $2.66
Courier Tip $ 4.79

Payed a premium for this type of service, $11.44 in fees ????
reviews.author: rwpow

reviews.text: I grew up in Vancouver and would regularly go to this McDonald's as it was one of the best. At a time in which you could get a meal deal for $2.99 on Tuesday's. Who'd ever guessed that the cost for a lesser meal would be five times higher. This was my first visit to this McDonald's in over twenty-five years and I will never go back. Myself and my two sons placed a large order at the drive-thru and we were asked to pull ahead while they put our order together. After waiting over ten minutes, half the order was cold and missing several items. My son took the order and went into the restaurant to get everything sorted out, but encountered an employee that couldn't understand what he was trying to explain. He gave up and we were still shorted two burgers. We all know that drive-thrus make mistakes, but you shouldn't have to explain yourself three times in order to get what you paid for. This is very common at every fast food restaurant nowadays which is why I've boycotted every one of them. Hire Canadians first for Canadian jobs because the labor that you're hiring doesn't understand nor do they care about customer service.
reviews.author: Darcy Padgham

reviews.text: Horrible service here. I ordered 20 nuggets, 3 honey sauce, spicy habanero sauce, quarter pounder with NO onions and EXTRA pickles, and a medium root beer. First of all my friends and I have to wait nearly 40 minutes for our order and when I kept asking them whether or not they're making it the staff kept saying they were working on it but we wouldn't get our food. Then I find out that they gave SOMEONE ELSE our order without double checking the other person's receipt on whether or not it was the correct order. Then after asking them 5 times to make ours they only give us 17 nuggets, 2 honey sauce, spicy habanero sauce, and did not take out the onions from the burger. Also did not receive our root beer and the staff would just ignore us when we would ask politely. My friend is deathly allergic to onions too so she wasn't able to have her burger. I understand it was crowded but that is no way to go about our order. Horrible customer service and I'm very disappointed by this location. They also refused us a refund for not giving us our full order. Terrible place and I will never come back here.

Not saying I do or don’t have a disability but let’s just say not all disabilities are visible and is definitely not their business!!! I asked to speak to the manager... instead of coming and dealing with the issues she sent the employee to the front telling me that all of a sudden it was out of order.. reviews.text:
I usually enjoy visiting McDonald’s, but my recent experience was quite disappointing. The service was slow, and the staff seemed unorganized. My order took much longer than expected, and when it finally arrived, it was incorrect and not fresh — the fries were cold, and the burger was poorly assembled.

When I tried to speak with a staff member, they didn’t seem very interested in resolving the issue, which made the experience even more frustrating. Cleanliness was also not up to the usual standard; tables were messy, and no one seemed to be attending to the dining area.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves customer service, food quality, and cleanliness. I’ve had good experiences at other McDonald’s locations, but this one definitely needs attention.
Note:There is a manager name kawal do not know how to talk with customers. Always use headphones during the work. And also have very bad behaviour.

reviews.text:
Order a Triple Thick Strawberry Milk Shake yesterday in the afternoon through the App and pickup at the last window.
I Double check with the Staff if I am getting a Strawberry Shake before stepping in the Acceclator to keep hitting the road, because the Shake in the cup didn't look pink like a Strawberry Shake, the Staff at the window told me Yes, Strawberry. So I trusted her and left. After 5 minutes while I'm 2 km away from there, I told a sip, Oh.... it is not Strawberry, instead Chocolate, the taste I dislike the most. I open the lid and find that the color is light brown, that's why it's not Strawberry. And the Shake is not thick at all, it's like regular thin Shake.
Can't really trust what they said, next time I will try it first before I leave for sure.

reviews.text:
General recommendation - try to avoid this place.

This is the worst McDonald's I have ever visited, and I have probably been to more than 100 all around the world.
- It is always dirty; I have never seen it clean.

- The food is average, but they often get your order wrong.

- Even if you choose the option to eat in, they give you a to-go bag.

- The waiting time is around 15 minutes, but on several occasions, I have waited for more than 20. This is unacceptable for fast food.

- The staff almost always marks your order as ready very quickly, but when you follow the information on the screen and approach them, they tell you to wait and that they will call your number when it’s ready.

reviews.text: Well well well, where do I begin. I don’t normally write reviews but when I have an experience like this I can’t help but put pen to paper. I entered McDonald’s a boy, by the time I came out I was due to collect my pension. Had about 15 minutes before my train and thought I would treat myself to a McDonalds, it is Halloween after all and I was dealt a nasty trick instead. 15 minutes went by and that gorm behind the till still hadn’t moved an inch. Bye bye train, don’t worry I’ll just get the next one. Hahahaah how wrong was I. 30 minutes goes by and I’m still waiting for one measly wrap, I don’t even want it anymore. At least the two girls behind the bar were having a good chinwag while the rest of us common folk waited in purgatory. After 35 minutes pass, I finally hear something unusual, the sound of a McDonald’s worker calling out a number!!! My number to be exact. Giving me just enough time to sprint for the third train and eat my McDonalds nursing a stitch and a sweaty brow. And to top it off, when I finally took a bite, of course my food was colder than Santa Claus during a power cut. Alas! A pube in my wrap! I don’t know which erchin placed it there, but I know it was no mistake. So to wrap it up, probably wouldn’t go again.
reviews.author: Joe Lee

reviews.text:
I am a delivery rider and was prevented from collecting orders that were fully available on both my Uber Eats and Deliveroo apps.

As a self-employed rider, the contractual rules clearly state that I am allowed to work with multiple apps simultaneously. However, the McDonald’s team refused to release the orders, forcing me to cancel them.

I even asked the shift manager to show me any document stating that I was not allowed to do this. None was presented, because no such rule exists. Deliveroo support was contacted, but Uber Eats support was ignored.

This incident not only caused me financial loss but also showed a lack of respect for riders who work hard and professionally. Riders already wait up to 20 minutes for orders in this branch while staff show little urgency.

A very disappointing and unprofessional experience.

reviews.text: Absolutely one of the worst experiences in my life! I went there while vacationing with my family tonight. There was a backed up line so my daughter in law and I decided to order in the kiosk. Both of our orders malfunctioned by not providing us with our order numbers. We both went up to the register and told the manager what had happened. He asked y ur s both if the transaction had gone through our bank and we both said yes. I showed him my phone as verification and he said that because my transaction stated that it was pending that it would not clear my bank and he would need to run my card again. I disagreed and called my bank from the car. My bank verified the transaction and that it would hard post overnight if they didn’t refund or cancel the transaction is n their end. All the while my daughter in law stayed inside. They prepared her order, didn’t charge her card again and she got to leave with all of her food! I went back in the restaurant with my daughter in law with me and asked why the gave her food when the same thing happened to me and we are together. The guy said that he didn’t know that we were together and that if I didn’t leave he was going to call the police. I asked him for something showing that he didn’t give me my food and he refused. I asked him who the manager was and he said that he was the manager. I asked him for his bosses name and he refused. When I get back home I will be turning this into fraud with my bank. Never have I ever been treated so poorly!

reviews.text: Very annoyed at my experience here, particularly with the young woman named Fatimah, not the right type of job for people like her. To start with we didn’t get a receipt with our food and ended up waiting 50 minutes for our food(it was midnight on a Sunday so was busy but still waited far too long) after waiting about 25 mins we asked Fatimah what the situation was and she just scoffed at us and told us it will be ready when it’s ready, even though we weren’t even sure what our number was so didn’t know if our food had been sent out already. She snapped at my girlfriend to get out the way saying she couldn’t serve people if she was standing in the way(she could). I also watched her call out various numbers and if they hadn’t been collected within about 10 seconds then she would just throw them in the bin which is ridiculous. After about 40 minutes a young lad noticed we had been waiting ages and took it upon himself to write down our order and make it himself, which was great, shame I didn’t catch his name. All in all a bad experience and to any managers reading this I would get rid of Fatimah asap as she comes across as very rude and unprofessional-not the type to be working in a customer based job.

reviews.text:
As a regular customer, I was really disappointed by the way paying customers were treated by the so-called “security” staff. This is not a criticism of the hardworking McDonald’s employees, who were absolutely fine, and provided great service.

After collecting my order I briefly checked all items ordered were present in the bag which is something any reasonable person would do. I was told this was not allowed, as it was “policy” for customers to leave immediately after collecting food. This was in an extremely patronising manner by “security” as if I had done something wrong. I was then herded out of the establishment like cattle.

I noted security swearing and threatening physical violence against other paying customers to get them vacate despite still waiting for food. These people had also done absolutely nothing wrong and I felt the environment was extremely hostile and unnecessary.

I think it’s clear these “security” enjoy their power trip and it’s frankly embarrassing for the establishment to allow it to continue.

reviews.text: I gave you 1 star because I couldn’t give you 0 for service. I rang up to ask for advice because the order was missing half the phone. He answered the phone quickly the first time and then didn’t respond to multiple calls made after it. The phone sounds like it’s being ignored. I understand business but it was plainly rude. All the remaining food became cold. It was under the name sinead on uber eats and was made today at 12. Very unhappy customer.

I understand the need to close the toilets on busy evenings however I am surprised to see such little compassion and discretion towards those with disabilities.

reviews.text:
I only buy a McDonalds once a year just to see if the quality had gotten better or at least back to how it once was and it's no surprise that's it's gotten worse.

- Quarter Pounder with Cheese: Burger meat was dry and burnt, the onion tasted raw, the ketchup and mustard was caked on, probably to try to cover up the burnt burger taste (it didn't work)
- Double cheese burger: so much sauce it was dripping out the bun, more sauce than anything else and even worse more mustard than ketchup, barely any onions, a sprinkle at best.

Fries were hot, I was shocked. I thought they was light at the end of this dark depressing meal, however turns out every single fry was caked in salt. Overly salted to the point it was unbearable to even eat them. Couldn't even eat them.

Milkshake was the only good part but you have to have a better suction rate that a Dyson vacuum because it's like sucking up ice-cream through a tiny, quickly disintegrating straw

Thanks for reminding me what utter trash fast food in the UK is and why I don't bother with this places anymore. Go support your local independent restaurants, you will pay same price or a tiny bit more and get good quality, fresh tasty food and won't feel like you will have a health condition after eating it.

McDonald's is an absolute shambles

reviews.text: if i could, i would put 0 stars but i cant. me and 3 other friends waited 2 HOURS for a burger and fries each and they cancelled one of our orders and when we asked where the food was, all we got back was “it’s in the kitchen being made” which is absolutely ridiculous. the bathrooms are genuinely disgusting and there was opened and used feminine hygiene products on the floor, it stunk of waste and there was faeces smeared on the walls in one of the stalls. a child came out the stall carrying a used tampon they had found on the floor and this is a hazard in so many ways. It was absolutely jam packed with people and the upstairs was closed off. there was crying kids screaming and running around everywhere and the floor was covered in rubbish. once one of my friends got their food, it was cold, soggy, and had a pube in it, never mind the fact she only got the fries and drink and not the rest of her meal. me and one of my friends went up to the counter to cancel our order because the waiting time was appalling and some old woman with a beard shoulder barged my friend to get to the front. i am absolutely fuming and i am never coming hear again. 🤬

This place needs to do something to prevent pigeons coming in the door and being where food is being eaten by people. I had to hurry to eat what I had ordered and take the rest out to finish even though I had paid to eat in. There are ways of keeping out pigeons so why hasn't this place put anything in place to stop them. Also people just queueing anywhere and everywhere because they can't be bothered to queue up properly,, but most people should know how to form a queue in this country because it's what people do so often, don't just stand anywhere, fgs get in a proper queue so people can also get past after they have collected their order.

reviews.text:
The worst McDonald’s experience I’ve ever had.
Our order took 32 minutes to be ready. Because the kitchen was faster than the serving counter, all the food ended up cold by the time we got it. The fries were completely inedible. The milkshake was the wrong flavor (strawberry instead of vanilla), and when we unpacked the bag, one hamburger was missing. To make things worse, they had run out of sauce for the fries, and the tables were so dirty that cola was dripping off some of them.

None of this is exaggerated , it was truly a disappointing experience. I won’t be visiting McDonald’s again anytime soon.

Despite everything, the staff remained very patient and helpful.

reviews.text: The worst McDonald experience I ever had. We had to wait more than 35 minutes before we got our order. The fries were cold, a hamburger was missing and one of our milkshakes was the wrong flavour. On top of all this, the place was dirty and not cleaned. Rubbish bins poured over. And one of the sauces to go with the fries, was gone. They just couldn’t handle the crowd. Fortunately, when we went back for the missing burger and the wrong flavor of milkshake, we were helped quickly and friendly. I think the staff works hard, but something has to be done to that place to smoothen the processes.

Some employees behave aggressively and do not communicate in a normal or respectful way. At times, it feels unprofessional, as if certain individuals are trying to act like they are in charge instead of working together as a team.

I believe a professional and respectful work environment is important, and unfortunately, that is not how I currently experience it.

I hope this can be taken seriously and addressed appropriately.

reviews.text:
Dirty place with rude staff. I try to visit McDonald’s in every country I travel to — and I travel a lot — but I’ve never seen such a low level of hygiene. All the tables were dirty and covered with crumbs.

I ordered takeaway, and the food was packed carelessly. I got two bags — one with drinks — and an additional ice cream was just handed to me. I stopped by a table near the counter to adjust the drinks in the bag so they wouldn’t spill, and suddenly a staff member started shouting, “Don’t eat here!” No “please,” no checking what I was doing.

If he had looked, he would have seen I was just fixing the drinks to avoid spills. I felt completely disrespected and treated like someone who doesn’t know how to behave in public. Definitely the worst McDonald’s experience I’ve ever had. I’ve never expected to see such service level in Japan.

reviews.text: Day 2 and I'm still in my hotel sick from a Big Mac BEWARE. Service was excellent, the staff upfront was friendly, patient and kind;  love Japan. The location is clean and orderly. I wanted to test out if a big mac tastes any different from the U.S. version. Sadly, it's no different taste wise or end results are the same. The establishment looks very clean and kept but obviously something is not right.
reviews.author: Oscar007

reviews.text:
ポテナゲ大を、頼んだのにも関わらず何回も番号を飛ばされ提供に30分もかかったうえに、4回ほど声をかけても確認しに行ってこちらには何も言わないという対応を取られました。
元々マクドナルドクルーだったので忙しい時の気持ちは分かりますが、ランナーとプレゼンの連携不足、商品の管理不足が酷かったです。
黒いベストを着ている者もいなかったのでマネージャーが居ないということでしょうか？
モバイルオーダーの導入で注文に制限が効かないのは大変だと思いますが、それならばウーバーを止めるなりできるはずです。
やっと対応できるようになったと思ったら過去の注文を遡らずに注文内容を聞かれ確認もせずに提供されました。
私が嘘をついていたらどうするのでしょうか。
こんなことが頻繁にあるのは店としてヤバイと思います。
1度マニュアルを見直した方がいいのではないでしょうか。
reviews.author: 一檎みるく

reviews.text:
モバイルオーダーで注文して、ポテトが塩なしを選べないので、日本の店員に塩なしが欲しいと言った後、日本の店員は態度が悪くて食事を私の前に投げました、超酷いです。

毎回このマクドナルドを利用するたびに、衛生面にとても不安を感じています。特に本日は、注文の列に並んでいたにもかかわらず、またしても割り込みをされました。これで二度目になります。外国人スタッフの方がその様子をはっきり見ていたのに、割り込んだお客さんを先に案内していたのは非常に不愉快でした。

また、この店舗のスタッフの接客態度もあまり良くありません。さらに、食品の衛生管理にも疑問があります。以前、スタッフが素手でハンバーガーを扱っているのを目撃しました。

このような状況では、安心して利用することができません。ぜひ改善していただきたいと思います。

The hours clearly stated that they close at 3:00 am and it was about 1:00 am. They closed early just because they wanted to go home probably. Very unprofessional.

reviews.text:
2024/7/14
画像が全てを物語っています。

汚い、飲食店なのにとにかく汚い。
客の民度が低いのと、店員がゴミ回収しかせず客席を全く見ていないせい。
テーブルは食べこぼし飲みこぼしだらけ、床にはポテトがポロポロ落ちてるし、何ならトレーまで床に転がってる。
近隣のマックが閉店したのもあって外まで並ぶほどの盛況ぶりだけど、それは店内が汚い言い訳には全くならない。
店内での食事だけは止めた方が良いマック。
ちなみに客席は携帯電波の入りも悪く、wifiも繋がらなくて、お店的にはさっさと帰って欲しいんでしょうね。

reviews.text:
日本人の女性スタッフの態度がとても悪かったです。理由も聞かずに、私が注文を間違えて取った人だと一方的に決めつけられました。

今朝、私は3点注文し、男性スタッフから袋を3つ渡されました。
家に持ち帰ってから、1袋が余分であることに気づき、すぐに返しに行きました。

説明する時間がなかったため、「私のものではありません」とだけ伝えたところ、

I had a very disappointing experience with the service provided by Bersha. Despite being in a group of three, she attended to us very slowly. She served one person, then waited five minutes before attending to the next, effectively separating our group. This made the entire process frustrating and inefficient. I would not recommend her service to anyone looking for prompt and cohesive service.

reviews.text:
ゴミ分別や環境配慮を誇るマクドナルドですが、実際の運用には疑いを持ちました。

先日、甲州街道沿いの店舗でマイボトルを持参しコーヒーを注文するも、ご自身で移し替えてくださいとのこと。

衛生面で特に問題があるとは思えないにもかかわらず、紙カップとプラスチック製の蓋を使用し、そのまま廃棄することになります。

スターバックスではマイボットル持ち込みでの注文は数年前から実施。　真似てみたら世の中ももっと綺麗になるでしょう。

このままだと資源の無駄遣いであり、環境負荷を減らす取り組みとは言い難いのではないでしょうか。

環境に配慮した事業を掲げるのであれば、その意義を徹底しなければなりません。
reviews.author: Павел

reviews.text:

いや、そっちの連携ミスやん？
商品注文のスタッフは新人ぽかったから忙しくて連携ミスしたのはまだ目潰れるとして、すみません、次回からは注文の際にお願いします。とか言い方を少し工夫するだけで気持ちの良い接客ができるのに勿体ないなと思った。

reviews.text:
Today in the afternoon, my couple and I entered to get a coke and a shake. We used the machines on display and , when we withdrew the ticket, it was stuck to another previously ordered; however we didn’t give it any notice since we had our ticket and this was what we showed the employee.

Afterwards, the waitress tried to give us a different order based on the wrong ticket but we didn’t accept it because it didn’t belong to us; nevertheless she kept saying that it was our order despite the fact our drinks had already been served and were waiting for us to take them.

Some minutes later she stopped insisting but she gave us the correct order with such bad manners and rudeness that we left the place really upset.

I am afraid, she is not prepared to deal with clients according to her stubbornness in a disagreement which was not that complicated.

その2人のスタッフがレシートを確認したあと、大声でその場にいた外国人スタッフ全員に向けて「誰が渡したの！💢」と店内に響き渡るような大声で何度も何度も叫び始めました。

外国人女性スタッフが男性スタッフに、何かを話そうとしているのも「だ、れ、が、わ、た、し、た、の！💢」と遮り何度も叫び続け、私含め周りのお客さんもびっくりして心配で振り向く程です。
外国人女性スタッフは、恐らく話を聞いて貰えない事、大声を出される事にブチ切れ、何かを叫んでカウンターから飛び出してどこかに行ってしまいました。

その後日本人男性スタッフが足りなかった商品を渡しお客さんが帰られた後、残された他の外国人スタッフに対し、変わらず大声でその時のミスについて長々と原因や理由（犯人探しのような内容）を大声で話しており、待っている客である他の方も数人を放置されました。
5分程でしょうか、それからようやく他のお客さんの商品が提供され始めて、受け取ることが出来ました。

部外者なのでその時の詳細は客である私には分かりかねますが、その男性スタッフには接客方法、他スタッフへの指導方法、をもう一度学び直していただきたいです。
少なくとも、突然怒鳴り声をあげ、お客様に見えるところでスタッフを叱りつけるのはどうかと思います。

reviews.text: Visiting Osaka and shopping at Shinsaibashi was an exciting experience, but it was also quite tiring with the large crowds around. I decided to take a quick break at McDonald’s to try their food. I sampled the Japanese versions of the Big Mac and Chicken Sandwich meals. While the food was served quickly, I was a bit disappointed with the quality— the meat was dry and lacked flavor. The dining area felt chaotic, and many tables weren't clean. The worst part was the bathroom, which was very dirty and had a strong odor. I lost my appetite and decided to leave without eating, as I wasn't confident about the cleanliness of the food.

reviews.text:
8月9日にマクドナルド心斎橋南店で、チキンマックハッピーセット（ポケモンカード）を購入しました。
しかし、店員から「カードがない」と言われましたので、「違うおもちゃでも構いません」と答えました。
すると「ナゲットもない」と言われ、何度も「別の商品に変更してください」と言われました。

そこで「返金してください」とお願いしましたが、返金には応じてもらえませんでした。
さらに、「商品は翌日に取りに来てください」と言われたため、翌日の朝9時に来店しましたが、渡されたのはナゲットとりんごジュースだけで、ソースや枝豆、コーンはもらえませんでした。

そのうえ、私の顔に指を指して「出て行って、もう来ないで」と言われました。
店長の名札には「河野」と書かれていました。

大手チェーン店で、このような態度や接客の悪さ、そして注文した商品をすべて渡さない対応は非常に残念です。
返金と、河野店長の処分を求めます。

Ali hrana nije bila jednako kvalitetna kao i u drugim poslovnica. Nije bila po standardu. Nadalje sam ugođaj je bio vrlo loš zato jer je na pola sjedećih mjesta bilo ljudi koji su spavali. They served us at about 9:52pm and tell us that they close at 2200.

We continue eating our meal and at 10pm sharp, the staff come and chase us out of the store and tell us that cannot eat inside anymore and not even provide us with the takeaway cup and paper bag for bringing our 2/3 left meal. We have to go take ourselves the takeaway cup to pour out drink into the cup as the serve plastic cup cannot take out of the store.

I would like to ask McDonald what kind of service is this?

In my country (Singapore), if we cannot finish our meal in time if reaches the closure time, the staff will ask you politely to finish your meal as they are closing. They will wait till you finish your meal and not chase you out of the store.

reviews.text:
Déception importante au McDonald’s Myeongdong le 24 février 2026

Nous avons passé une commande d’environ 150 €. À la réception des plateaux, près de la moitié des produits manquaient. Nous l’avons signalé à un employé (grand monsieur en chemise blanche). Malheureusement, son attitude a été marquée par de l’agacement visible, des soupirs et des remarques peu professionnelles.

Les éléments manquants nous ont été apportés progressivement après plusieurs demandes. Face à l’inconfort de la situation, nous avons finalement renoncé à récupérer l’intégralité de la commande pour éviter davantage de tensions.

De plus, plusieurs plats étaient froids.

Cette expérience a gâché ce qui devait être notre principal repas de la semaine. Au vu du montant dépensé, nous attendions un service plus rigoureux et respectueux. Nous ne pensons pas revenir.

When I politely asked which mayonnaise was used in the burger, the staff seemed unwilling to explain. Earlier, I had also asked if I could charge my phone, and the response was quite rude and impolite.

I understand they may be busy, but a little more kindness and patience would make the experience much better for customers, especially for foreigners. I hope the staff can be more courteous and helpful in the future.

reviews.text: Since Khao San road is mostly a nightlife destination this location opens super late in the day and has no breakfast.  For that reason alone I refuse to patronize this location and will never visit again. There's a 24 hr McDonald's with breakfast just up the road from Khao San road and in front of a major roundabout (circle).  Go there instead; the atmosphere is much nicer and it's a much bigger, brighter and modern McDonald's. By the way, McDonald's in Thailand is not super cheap like in Malaysia and Indonesia. McDonald's is significantly more expensive in  Thailand. A breakfast combo egg McMuffin with sausage and cheese, hash brown, small coffee, a second sausage egg McMuffin (not in combo) and a large coke cost three hundred and fifty baht. The sausage egg McMuffin with cheese alone is like one hundred baht (three USD!!!) without drink or hash brown.  Super expensive if compared to Indonesia and Malaysia!

當下告知是購買網路上電子券於此次消費，我（當班劉姓女主管）一樣可以退給妳@#$&（這是真正在處理客戶反應餐點問題嗎？）

I’ve lived in Taiwan for five years and haven’t left the country in a year. Would the same staff member ask about a Taiwanese person? Perhaps they’d been out of the country recently? reviews.text:
1-Star Review for McDonald's - Makati, Philippines

Nine months ago, McDonald's in Makati near AirResidence was our go-to spot for late-night meals. The food was decent, and it was a reliable choice for us during our stay. However, our recent visit has been nothing short of a nightmare.

Fast forward to now, we returned to AirResidence for our vacation and decided to visit this branch again, expecting the same quality. To our utter disappointment, the food was absolutely terrible. The meals we ordered were burnt and completely tasteless. It felt like we were being served inedible garbage.

To make matters worse, our meal cost over 600 pesos. Imagine in a context for a family earning around 15,000 pesos a month, McDonald's used to be a place where you could treat themselves without breaking the bank. Now, it feels like throwing money away for a treat, only to be served such awful food. It's incredibly disheartening and frustrating, knowing it will take another month to afford such an outing again.

This McDonald's branch has truly gone downhill. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone looking for a decent meal, let alone a pleasant dining experience. Save your money and your stomach—avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.text:
Visited July 8, 2025 - day 5 in India

My kids were craving something familiar so I was excited to find McDonald’s. My daughters, ages 5 and 7, walked in and stood in line, really looking forward to trying McDonald’s in India. Then my 5 year old needed to use the bathroom.

There were only two very small bathroom stalls, one for males and one for females, sharing a tiny sink with no soap, which was really unpleasant. When I went into the female stall, I saw that the toilet had no seat cover. Because of that, I had to take my little girl to the male bathroom since it had a seat cover. Right away I felt disgusted, but since my kids were so excited, I stayed and went down with them to order.

While we were waiting in line, a group of people cut right in front of my daughters and me. The cashier saw it but did not say anything. Since it was just me with my girls, I did not want to cause a scene.

When it was finally our turn, my 5 year old wanted the kids meal with chicken nuggets and a bobaaa blast drink. I told the cashier I would pay extra for the drink but wanted her to have Fanta with the kids meal. After seeing the bathroom situation, I asked for no ice in their drinks because I did not want my girls to get sick. I also asked for ketchup.

My 7 year old ordered a chicken burger with the same drink. I chose the filet o fish with the mango ras drink and also requested ketchup. We were told to go upstairs and that the food would be brought to us.

We found a table, but the lady nearby did not clean it before we sat down. When the food arrived, there was no ketchup or Fanta. The kids were happy to eat, but as a mom, I kept thinking about how poorly maintained this place must be based on the state of the bathrooms.

Overall I can only give this place one star for hygiene and service.

reviews.text:
I visited this outlet few months ago.
The staff was not at all courteous. It was crowded and packed. The place is very small and seating area is on the first floor. I had a flight to catch so asked one the staff if there is place available upstairs so I can sit and eat quickly, he said you have to go and check sir. It was least I could expect from them, is to tell me if there’s a table available or if it’s not I could just sit in my car and take away the food rather than standing and eating holding tray with one hand how uncomfortable and inconvenient it was. The AC wasn’t working properly may be because it was crowded and it was humid. I was sweating. I asked for extra paper napkins so they gave me 2. Why do the restaurants behave so cheap when asked for extra ketchup or paper napkins? Don’t they calculate the cost of these in their profit margins? One tray mat costs less than a rupee which is made of 70/80 GSM paper and food grade ink. The french fries cartons cost not more than ₹2. I have don’t the math. The amount they charge for burger, fries and a drink is anywhere between ₹250-300 approx. Least they can offer some extra tissues and sachets without having that sad look on their face.
Or why don’t they charge us ₹10 extra & then give us as many sachets as we want and tissue paper napkins.
2 sachets for medium fries and a burger is less and without a ketchup it becomes difficult to digest because it becomes too dry. There is a reason we are asking for this, it’s not we have to open a shop of this.
Also the cleanliness & upkeep of the place was very very bad.
I really don’t know what managers and area managers do?

reviews.text:
This is the worst experience I've had at not just mcdonalds, but any restaurant. They had us wait over 20 minutes for our order only to tell us the grill was broken. They didn't speak English so it took 5 minutes to explain that we wanted a refund. Then, we bought a "premium strawberry milkshake." It took 18 minutes. We asked LITERALLY 12 times why they weren't making it. They would understand enough to start making it and then just leave and go help other people. In the end, it wasn't even a milkshake. They added some strawberries in syrup to ice cream and mixed it with the mcflurry machine. I had to send it back three times because they didn't even mix it. Then, it took another 3 minutes to get a spoon, since it was undrinkable through a straw. When I complained to someone that finally spoke English, they said "okay. What do you want me to do?"
I said "uhhh, well I waited over 20 minutes for a milkshake...so something?"
They said "No, sorry."
Worst experience. Was excited to try mcdonalds in Israel but now I don't want to whatsoever.
reviews.author: Chase L

reviews.text: Wow, what a mess. There are, like, 2 or 3 employees, and they couldn't care less. It was morning, and I was the only one waiting for my order at that time, and it took them 10 (!) minutes to make a meal. TEN! I understand when this happens during busy time, but literally when no one is around? Zero effort. Moreover, the burger I ordered was cooked ahead of the fries, so it went cold while the fries were being made, it just sat there for 4 minutes. By McDonalds standart you should be served everything at once, or the item that goes cold is replaced. But not here. Beware, totally not worth the price - BK on the ground floor's way better and has more vegan options.

reviews.text:
I am writing to formally complain about extremely poor service we received at McDonald’s Waterfront on Christmas Day.

A staff member named Udi, who was working behind the counter, initially refused to assist us at the till when we attempted to order five ice-cream sundaes. The order was eventually processed by another cashier and paid in two separate transactions (one sundae and four sundaes).

Udi was later responsible for preparing drinks and ice creams. The single sundae was received within approximately two minutes, however the remaining four sundaes took over 20 minutes to be prepared.

Due to the excessive delay, I asked another lady behind the counter if she could please assist us. She kindly stepped in to help. When Udi approached her, he stated that the sundaes were “the ones I didn’t want to make,” which strongly suggested that our order had been deliberately delayed. This comment made us feel uncomfortable and hesitant about consuming the ice cream.

Additionally, when we first entered the restaurant, I witnessed the same staff member being rude to an elderly gentleman who was enquiring about milk. Instead of explaining the situation calmly, he raised his voice at the customer, which was completely inappropriate.

This behaviour was unprofessional, disrespectful, and unacceptable—especially on Christmas Day, when customers are simply trying to enjoy a meal with their families. I believe this matter warrants investigation and appropriate corrective action.

I trust that McDonald’s values customer service and will address this issue accordingly.
reviews.author: Veruschka May

reviews.text:
⭐ 1-Star Review ⭐
Absolutely unacceptable treatment from staff tonight.

I went to this McDonald’s with my boyfriend and a friend. They were closing up, so we quietly asked if we could use the bathroom while our friend was speaking to one of the staff about ice cream. Instead of a simple, polite “Sorry, we’re closed” or “The bathrooms aren’t available right now,” one of the employees yelled at us for walking toward the back.

We immediately apologized and turned around to leave, but he carried on loudly, repeating that they “don’t have a bathroom” and that it was “their time, not customers’ time.” The attitude was completely unnecessary. We weren’t rude, demanding, or causing trouble — we simply didn’t know, and we apologized right away.

I told him he didn’t need to treat us like that, because honestly, he didn’t. If he had spoken to us respectfully from the start, this situation would have gone very differently. No one deserves to be yelled at or spoken down to for a misunderstanding.

Very disappointed with the customer service. Even at closing time, basic respect is not optional.

reviews.text:
I was the victim of a 900 rand scam in that Mc Donald. Avoid this place! I went to the McDonald's Drive-Thru on February 18th for an order of 84 rand, which I paid by credit card (and no one else ever had the card in their hands). Two days later, I had the unpleasant surprise of seeing that 25 minutes after my payment, I had been charged 900 rand at that same McDonald's.

Since then, I've filed three complaints. Someone called me the first time and told me the manager would get in touch. The complaint was then closed as "resolved," but no one ever contacted me.

I have since gone to McDonald's eight times to try to sort the situation out, but nothing has changed. I contacted McDonald’s South Africa, and they told me to go to the Sandton McDonald’s for compensation. I went there yesterday, and the manager told me she wasn’t aware of anything and that she couldn’t do anything for me.

So not only was I robbed of 900 rand at your store, but I also feel like I’m being mocked, and what’s certain is that I’m wasting my time.

The worst branch I have ever tried. We encountered significant issues with the self-service kiosk, leading to confusion and overpayment.

When we approached a staff member, presented our credit card payment records, and requested clarification on whether the kiosk had successfully charged us, his response was highly unprofessional. He laughed off our concerns and even demanded that I switch my banking app to Arabic, claiming he could not understand English, and bizarrely suggested we communicate in Chinese—despite clearly not speaking the language himself.

After we repeatedly explained our concerns using a translation tool, another staff member was called over, who firmly assured us that no charge had been deducted from the credit card via the kiosk. However, upon the completion of our trip and after the transactions posted, I discovered that my credit card had been charged twice—once for the kiosk attempt and once for the counter order.

reviews.text:
Sadly a massive disappointment.

First of all it’s a very busy location so up to 10-15 minutes just to order then the food can take up to 20 minutes (if they don’t forget about you, which they have done before). I’ve visited here multiple times and every time I visit Marrakesh. I go because it’s often quicker than some places and relatively cheap. However the food isn’t the same and has a slight unusual taste compared to the UK.

I visited two occasions on my last trip and on my first I had missing items which I didn’t realise until I got back to my apartment, and second time it was that busy down stairs I went to the first and second floor as it was quieter. I chose to sit on the second floor as the top floor was dirty with many trays and tables not cleaned.

When sitting on the second floor you routinely see staff just laying about with their legs up blasting music. I decided to move further round a corner only for the ignorant member of staff to move and sit next to them which was near me. It made me feel very uncomfortable and certainly the staff’s professionalism was not good.

I decided to walk out and I will not be returning.

Highly unprofessional, unclean and unorganised.

Returned today (6 months since m last encounter). Only just arrived and thought I’d get a coffee as I seen people walk out. Only to be yelled at by security saying it’s not open. There’s a way to talk to people and his attitude stinks. Only come for convenience but the past occasions has made me want to stay way clear and never want to give them my custom again.
reviews.author: Gregory James

reviews.text: Tous les mcdos a travers le monde sont connus pour leur bon service surtout de la part des employés et leur rapidité! Mais ce que j'ai vu dans ce mcdo hier le 12 janvier 2026 a 19h était hors du commun. Tous dabord 2 machines de commandes qui ne marchent pas (aucun ticket de commende ne sort)! Puis quand je vais à la caisse pour payer il n y a personne à la caisse et les employés (de la caisse + ceux qui se chargent de la cuisine frites glaces et boissons) sont en train de rigoler entre eux devant tout le monde a haute voie alors qu'il y avait une grande queue et beaucoup de monde était en train d'attendre. Ce n'est qu'après 2 minutes que quelqu'un (je pense que c'était le manager qui était en avec eux tout le temps et regarder sans rien faire) a demandé à une employée (vulgaire moche et impolie) de s'occuper la caisse pour prendre l'argent et activer les commandes. Quand c'est à mon tour de payer je lui montre le ticket je paie mon cornet de glace et elle dit à une autre employée: un cornet de glace pour "celui-là". Je fais la remarque que "celui-là" ne se dit pas pour adresser quelqu'un car c'est impoli. puis elle se tourne vers son collegue qui etait chargé du menage et lui dit à haute voie "apparemment celui-la n'apprecie pas qu'on l'adresse par celui-la". Je pense qu'il faut de l'ordre dans cet endroit.
reviews.author: Younes

reviews.text:
Commande passée chez McDo via Glovo : résultat, il manque littéralement la moitié de la commande. Pas une frite oubliée hein, la MOITIÉ.

Le pire ? Aucune solution. Ni remboursement, ni geste commercial, ( 7dh de dédommagement ) ni même un vrai “désolé”. On te balade, on te répond à moitié, et au final tu paies pour du vent.

C’est simple : tu commandes, tu paies, et tu croises les doigts pour recevoir ce que tu as payé. Sinon, tant pis pour toi. Zéro respect du client, zéro professionnalisme, zéro suivi.

Franchement, si vous n’êtes pas capables de préparer une commande complète ou d’assumer vos erreurs, autant fermer le service livraison. Parce que là, c’est juste du foutage de gueule.

The fries? Soggy and barely salted. Not the crispy, golden fries they advertise. To make things worse.

Service was good!! For the price, I expected at least something decent, but it was a complete waste of money. Definitely not coming back.

Je fais ce post pour dénoncer ce qui se passe au Mc Donald's de la gare de Marrakech en espérant que le siège Marocain réagisse car c'est inacceptable, récurent et visiblement pas prêt de changer!!!
J'ai régulièrement des soucis de commande dans ce point de vente de la gare et je n'ai jamais donner mon avis mais là trop c'est trop...
J'ai joint quelques photos entre le filet o fish balancé façon boomerang et les grandes portions à moitié pleine c'est la goutte qui fait déborder le vase!!!
Vous faites honte à cette franchise internationale!!!
reviews.author: Mus 26

reviews.text: Chaotic, only one machine of 6 worked and there was queue for it. Counter tills were not opened, with at least half of the staff standing and chatting or 2 or three completing one order. Our order was prepared and left on the counter and no one shouted the order number leaving us to wait for more than 25 mins. Only Moroccans were  getting the attention and being served as VIPs, because we appeared as non locals we were ignored and given bad attitude for asking if the order was ours. Very poor customer service. I wouldn’t not recommend
reviews.author: Adel Sedrati

reviews.text:
Pure chaos. Instead of using the actual receipt/order numbers system, the numbers are bumped from the screen immediately when they show up before they're actually served, so instead they have employees walking from a customer to a customer asking for their receipts to find their orders.
Place is dirty, their stereo system is broken, speakers just buzzing on the 3rd floor.
We've ordered a couple of items including their deluxe coffee - see a photo attached for a good laugh.
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.text: Ordered a meal with a Coke Zero — the first came flat, warm, and with no ice. Asked for another and it was still flat. When I complained, the manager kept insisting that because the first one was warm it wasn’t possible to “feel the fizz.” That makes no sense — Coke Zero should be carbonated no matter the temperature. In the end I was offered bottled sparkling water, but honestly, what’s a McDonald’s meal without a proper cold fizzy drink? The whole thing ruined the meal.
reviews.author: N G

reviews.text:
Zero stars there's no air con or it wasn't working today.  Waited ages for the food, it's ok nothing special.  There's better food that's much cheaper available locally.  Avoid at all costs, I only went for the kids sake.
There was a bunch of teenage boys messing about, then one by one sat Infront of us watching us eat??!!  Felt uncomfortable & then a lady warned me to be careful as they also decided to leave when we did.  V odd

reviews.text: I had a bad experience this morning. I didnt get all of my order and had to wait for more than 20 minutes knowing that there was no queue. Too much chatting between the crew members and i observed people preparing meals touching it with naked hands. When i told them that i got incomplete parts of my order they were sceptical about it. Weak and bad service. I think they need supervising because they harm the image of the company.

reviews.text: Usual fast food and unhelpful staff. The quicker you remove unhappy employees and use more digital ordering that works...the better. Once ordered there was nothing 'fast' about this place...waited forever... 20 mins for our food to arrive!

reviews.text: Absolute mess, both the food and the staff. First of all, the order was incomplete. When it finally arrived, the food was cold. Complete garbage.

reviews.text:
Es increíble el DEPLORABLE estado en el que operan en este restaurante.
Ayer fui a comer como a las 5 p.m. y noté muchas inconsistencias en lo que esperaba mi pedido.
1. La estación de papas tenía un empleado que estaba sacando papas a diestra y siniestra. Sin limpiar la estación y sin llevar un orden del tiempo de vida del producto. El trapo que tenía para la limpieza estaba entre los empaques para papás.
2. Otro empleado que se supone estaba corriendo las órdenes, las estaba armando en la zona donde salen las hamburguesas calientes y tiro los refrescos por poner ahí la charola, en lugar de armarlos sobre el mostrador.
3. Los gerentes de turno que en estaban viendo la situación no estaban controlando las funciones de sus empleados, parece que cada quien hacía lo que quería, pero realmente NADIE estaba atendiendo el mostrador al 100% ni las órdenes que en pantalla ya aparecían listas pero no estaban en mostrador aún.

Así que realmente no volvería a este restaurante que tiene tan mala logística. E invito a las personas que leen esto a no acudir a éste establecimiento que ahora luce tan INSALUBRE. Ojalá vuelvan a auditar estos restaurantes para que vuelvan a aplicar el control de producto y calidad estándar que hace unos años aún tenían.
reviews.author: Alejandra Pineda

reviews.text: @McDonald’s sucursal zócalo Fui ayer jueves  y es increíble lo insalubre del lugar , las escaleras al subir a los baños se me pegaban los tenis de la mugre que tenían, los baños vomitados y extremadamente sucios, la comida súper fría , las papas y hamburguesas sabían feo y la mesa donde comí toda pegajosa de mugre y llena de catsup , salí con un asco de ahí, no sin antes hacer mi reclamo correspondiente, como es posible que una cadena así no tenga supervisión y no me salgan con que hay que ser pacientes por la ubicación en la que se encuentra el lugar por qué nada justifica la situación, he ido a lugares con más gente y no están así de insalubres ,eso es completo abandono por parte de los empleados de limpieza no tienen quien los supervise para que hagan su trabajo. @McDonald’s

reviews.text:
Muy poco atentos, se andan paseando, vi a muy pocas personas haciendo lo suyo otras más solo dando vuentas y en su teléfono, no vi en algún momento que mínimos se colocaran gel antibacterial antes de tocar los alimentos (muy poca higiene) no te dan servilletas ni condimentos, tampoco te los ofrecen, no te preguntan el sabor de tu bebida y suponen que quieres Coca-Cola, no le quisieron quitar los hielos a mi bebida ni cambiar el sabor porque "así lo pedí"
Las papas sabían muy mal, la limpieza en general pésima.
Cabe destacar que aunque se que por la zona es un lugar bastante concurrido asisti en un horario en donde no tenían ni gente esperando pedido ni gente formada a realizar su pedido.

reviews.text: My husband and I are traveling in CDMX and enjoying this wonderful city. We purchased food, sat down, and ate inside. There were almost no other customers in the restaurant. A bathroom was visibly available but was locked. When we inquired, we were told it was closed and then we were told it was only for people with disabilities. With no one else there, as paying customers, needing to use the facilities, I am shocked. Do they really not allow any customers eating and drinking at their restaurant to use the bathroom? We will not be returning to this horribly uncomfortable part of town and will take our money elsewhere.
reviews.author: Darci Pauser

reviews.text: La commande était incorrecte, elle était correcte sur le reçu mais pas en réalité, j'ai demandé sans fromage et il y en avait. Mon ami a demandé avec fromage, ils ont chargé un extra pour lui et il n'en a pas eu. le temps d'attente était interminable, mon numéro s'est affiché à l'écran comme étant prête mais ce n'était pas vrai, ils faussent les commandes prêtes pour améliorer leur statistiques, 2 commandes sont passées après. À éviter à tout prix. Service pourri. N'y allez pas.

reviews.text:
Un mal servicio por parte de los empleados, decían pedir ticket para poder "pasar al baño"( el cual el de hombres estaba asqueroso y fuera de servicio cuando acudí), la muchacha con una actitud antipática y nefasta no dio señalización o aviso cuando lo limpiaba. Comimos en el piso de arriba y al momento de bajar por las escaleras vemos que están cerradas con unas cadenas, cerraron el acceso siendo que mi novia y yo seguíamos comiendo ahí.
No recomendado 👎

reviews.text: Was at a nearby hotel and walked to nearby store to pick up bottled water and sundries.  Always make it a point to go to McD's on vacation because they still make apple pies by deep frying compared to US where apple pies are now baked.  This particular location seems like a smaller McD's because I believe there was an abbreviated menu. This place was filthy!  At least the downstairs lobby was...(there is a larger seating area on the second floor which was moderately clean).  What was a total turn off was walking in there; getting apple pies; then looking for a place to sit down only to see a bunch of trays of food with uneaten burgers and fries on them.  Despite the filth I went back here out of sheer cost and convenience.  Stopped back here at breakfast one time on the way to an excursion - still dirty.  Then another night because we couldn't find ice cream at the nearby store so I took the kids to get McFlurries.  Of course I ordered an apple pie too.  After paying for the order and waiting for the apple pies to be cooked they informed me the ice cream machine was broken.  I think this place knows they have a captive audience via the weekly flow of new tourists.  They staff the place with minimally qualified people who keep the lights on and do the bare minimum...
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: Horrible presentation of burgers. Fries were thrown on the tray and spread all over the tray.  Premium signature burger came wrapped in papper like a small cheeseburger would be presented.  Here's the worst part, they had no soda and said the machine was broken and they couldn't take credit cards.  So after waiting ten minutes in line and ordering our food when we saw the presentation we asked for a refund.  Very strange McDonald's experience for anywhere in the world especially somewhere like Cancun which is a mega tourist destination and has multiple McDonald's locations.  It's not like this McDonald's is in the middle of nowhere in Chiapas or some rural location. There is obviously some type of issues with management or even the owners of this location because they didn't even take credit cards.
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.text: The worst McDonald's in the Whole Wide World, restrooms are extremely dirty, and broken and they smell awful, stairs are about to  fall off, the roof has leakings when it rains, yesterday I went there by car, the guy on the drive thru took my order, he repeated the order and when I got the next window they told me they did not understood that I ordered,  and it took them 28 minutes to make 2 hamburgers, french fries who by the way they were cold, they forgot to add ketchup, straws and napkins. When I went down and told them they forgot everything they just did not know what to do.  ( And the prize for the worst McDonald's in the world goes for this one).

reviews.text:
La atención para turistas es realmente pésima. El personal no entiende español, tiene muy mala actitud, miradas desagradables y cero predisposición. A pesar de que el pedido figura claramente en pantalla en su idioma nativo, entregan cualquier cosa.

En varias ocasiones se burlaron o rieron. Cuando reclamás o pedís un cambio en tu comida, no respetan los estándares internacionales de McDonald’s, donde normalmente rehacen el producto. En mi caso, simplemente colocaron las mismas papas que había reclamado en otro recipiente y les agregaron cheddar y bacon. Vi claramente cómo, al notar que yo estaba observando, la empleada se fue al fondo de la cocina con las papas y el cheddar, demorando en regresar, lo cual fue muy incómodo y poco transparente.

Durante mi estadía fui tres veces y ninguna experiencia fue normal: siempre hubo algún problema. En una de esas ocasiones pedí un helado que habíamos seleccionado y confirmado claramente en la pantalla, por lo que el idioma no fue el problema. Además, era de madrugada y no había más clientes con los que pudieran confundirse. Aun así, me entregaron un helado completamente distinto y tuvimos que señalar nuevamente en la pantalla cuál era el correcto.

Además, había niños y adolescentes que no eran empleados junto a una trabajadora, haciendo comentarios desubicados, asumiendo que por hablar español no entendía lo que decían.

Si quieren comer tranquilos, recomiendo elegir otro lugar. En Brasil hay muchos restaurantes donde el personal sí quiere trabajar bien y hacerte sentir cómodo, incluso siendo extranjero.

🇺🇸
The service for tourists is truly terrible. The staff does not understand spanish or english, shows a very poor attitude, gives unpleasant looks, and has no willingness to help. Even though the order is clearly displayed on the screen in their native language, they deliver completely wrong items.

On several occasions, they laughed or mocked customers. When you complain or request a change to your food, they do not follow McDonald’s international standards, where the item is usually remade. In my case, they simply placed the same fries I had complained about into another container and added cheddar and bacon. I clearly saw that when the employee noticed I was watching, she went to the back of the kitchen with the fries and the cheddar, taking a long time to return, which felt uncomfortable and very unprofessional.

During my stay, I went there three times and not a single experience was normal — there was always an issue. On one of those occasions, I ordered an ice cream that we had clearly selected and confirmed on the screen, so the language was not the problem. It was late at night and there were no other customers, leaving no room for confusion. Despite this, we were given a completely different ice cream and had to point at the screen again to show which one we had actually ordered.

Additionally, there were children and teenagers who were not employees standing with an employee, making inappropriate comments and assuming that because I was speaking Spanish, I could not understand what they were saying.

If you want to eat in peace, choose another place. There are many restaurants in Brazil with staff who actually want to work properly and make you feel welcome, even if you are a foreigner.
