reviews.text: Fui a este fast food pois não tinha nenhum outro local que eu conhecesse que pudesse estar aberto depois 0:00. Já tinha ido outras vezes e em todas as vezes é nítido perceber a falta de respeito por parte de todos os que frequentam aquele ambiente, não respeitam as pessoas que limpam,  que são as únicas que eu vou elogiar aqui. Pois os seguranças, atendentes de caixas, balconistas e gerentes são uma vergonha para a rede McDonald's. Estava numa situação que ao invés deles me tratarem feito gente, mesmo pagando minha comida, eles foram desrespeitosos, como se porque eu estivesse fedendo ou suja, mesmo pagando não tivesse o direito de fazer minha refeição em um lugar dentro do fast food em paz. Sendo quem por mais que estivesse chovendo eu fiquei na área externa e os bancos molhados sequei com minha própria roupa, para sentar. Os piores olhares não são os dos clientes, mas sim o da equipe de atendimento. Apenas uma operadora de caixa no meu último pedido se desculpou pela forma desumana que fui tratada.
reviews.author: Francisca Cristiane Peronico

reviews.text:
Boa noite.

Minha experiência foi péssima. Ao chegar ao local, as máquinas para realizar pedidos não estavam funcionando; apenas uma ou duas estavam em operação, causando muita demora.

Fiz o pedido de dois sorvetes, uma casquinha e uma batata frita grande. Nossa senha era 379, porém chamaram senhas até 430 e, mesmo após eu questionar várias vezes, ninguém resolveu a situação. Minha filha, de 11 anos, ficou esperando em pé, extremamente desconfortável.

Quando finalmente pedimos para verificar nosso pedido, depois de quase 1 horas e 30 , ele veio todo errado. Os atendentes não conferem o sistema nem a nota fiscal. Voltei para reclamar e, ainda assim, o sorvete foi preparado errado novamente, demonstrando total falta de atenção e cuidado. Parece que fazem os pedidos de qualquer forma.

Além do atendimento péssimo, o ambiente estava sujo, tanto na parte de baixo quanto na de cima.

Não indico este local e nunca mais voltarei com minha família.
Uma experiência realmente horrível.
reviews.author: Ivandro Torres

reviews.text:
IMUNDO • DEMORADO • PÉSSIMO

Nunca vi um McDonald’s tão sujo em toda a minha vida!!! Fomos domingo à noite e o ambiente deu NOJO! Chão muito sujo, cheio de guardanapos de papel usados, batatas e resto de lanches pisoteados, escada com cabelo e poeira, mesas com restos de comida, um HORROR! Não tivemos nem coragem de ir ao banheiro lavar as mãos! Não achamos UM local para sentar que estivesse limpo e só não fomos embora porque já havíamos pago o lanche.

O lanche demorou 30 minutos para ficar pronto, além de vários totens de autoatendimento estarem sem funcionar!!! Os funcionários do atendimento estavam sobrecarregados, nitidamente faltando atendentes, pois havia cartaz de recrutamento.

Notoriamente só querem lucrar com essa unidade… porque contratar mais auxiliares de serviços gerais e ofertar salário competitivo para os atendentes quererem trabalhar ali, parece não ser uma opção para eles, pois há diversas reclamações sobre isso.

Se você for turista: NÃO RECOMENDO!
reviews.author: Alessandra Mey Huber

reviews.text:
Estive presente no dia 29/11 por volta das 22h. Ambiente super lotado, com vários totem de atendimento desligados, e os que estava ligados sempre dando problemas na hora do pagamento. Filas super enormes para realizar o pedido, e depois tendo que pegar outra fila para efetuar o pagamento.
Não lançaram meu pedido no painel de retirada, tive que cobrar os atendentes várias vezes. Porém pegaram nossa nota fiscal para agilizar o atendimento, porém sumiram com a nota, pois era troca de turno. As novas pessoas chegando não sabia de nada, não viu nada. Tiveram que anotar nosso pedido em um pedaço de papelão, tudo isso depois de quase 1h esperando após o pagamento. Gerente super mal educado, zero paciência com clientes e funcionários.
Experiência horrível, por ser em um ambiente turístico, o atendimento deveria ser muito melhor.
Só tem propaganda, pois o que salva é o nome da marca McDonald's.
reviews.author: Gustavo Anhas

reviews.text:
Refrigerante (Spirit )estava pura água e um gosto ruim do pó usado para dar sabor, suco de uva tava horrivel, qualquer um de saquinho estaria mais saboroso!

Uma bagunça pra liberar os pedidos, no painel diz está pronto, (dependendo de como estiver cheio, leva mais de 1h) mas só é liberado mais de 10 minutos depois, deixando os lanches frios.

Os atendentes não tem muito o que fazer, porque a bagunça começa na clientela sem bom senso que fica encima atrapalhando os funcionários, na minha opinião deveria ter alguns funcionários para organizar a retirada dos pedidos.

Os caixas de auto atendimento tem filas que levam 2h kkkkk.

Recomendo pegar para viagem, assim fica mais fácil de procurar lugar, ou alguém já vai procurando enquanto uma pessoa fica aguardando ser chamado pelo número.

Dia de DOMINGO!
reviews.author: M A I C O N XXIII

reviews.text: Vim de Goiânia pra conhecer e saio frustrada com o atendimento péssimo gerente sem educação nenhuma pra atender as pessoas grita com os cliente com os funcionários, arrogante e sem experiência nenhum pra trabalhar com o público. Não sabe conduzir uma e equipe  apenas grita precisa de um treinamento urgente. Ambiente legal muito lotado mais infelizmente não sabem controlar o fluxo de pessoas. Meu lanche veio frio pq ficou horas parada na bandeja na  parte de dentro do balcão eles não anunciam o lanche no painel, você pergunta do seu lanche eles nem te dão moral , isso é pq eu fiz o pedido e fiquei lá no balcão mais de uma hora e meio esperando  uma verdadeira confusão.  Tive que trazer o lanche pra esquenta em casa.Péssima experiência. única pessoa educada do lugar é o segurança.
reviews.author: Emanuelle Paulino

reviews.text: Nothing special just extremely crowded and you have to wait for seat. On top no consistency in food. Each time I ordered same sandwich it came different. And today Big Tasty Queijo was poorly made and I ordered extra tomato, it came without any tomato. They removed even the one that was there in default. But they attached to burger grill slip that clearly said Extra tomato. No attention to details and not reading even kitchen tickets properly. They need to be retrained! When told staff about missing ingredients they gave me back sandwich with one little slice of tomato and I had to ask them again! They just throw there extra tomato and that was it for them! Poor customer service! Won’t come here again. McDonald’s in USA and Europe are much higher standards and quality.
reviews.author: Mil Habala (livingwithmil)

reviews.text: Entre pra tirei fotos e lanche em outro lugar, na madrugada a bella paulista é uma opção melhor. Na madrugada pelo menos 2/3 dos totens desligados sem opcao de compra com atendente. Você pode ter a experiência de ter  que lidar com extremo mau humor e a grosseria dos funcionários no atendimento, alem de saborear um "delicioso" lanche feito com os pés e jogados numa caixa, além de fast que não tem nada. Além disso, você pode optar por pegar as filas novamente pra comprar a sobremesa separado ou ter um sorvete derretendo na sua bandeja pois ao contrario de outras unidades não pode pegar depois. Pelo menos não pedi um mclanche feliz porque de felicidade nesse local não há nada.
reviews.author: Bruno Sepulveda

reviews.text: O Méqui 1000 é um verdadeiro caos. Para quem é turista, não recomendo a visita. O local estava extremamente lotado, com total falta de organização e evidente despreparo para atender a grande demanda. O atendimento foi demorado e o ambiente apresentava sinais de sujeira. Havia camelôs na entrada do prédio vendendo de tudo, o que já causa desordem, e, para piorar, havia um morador de rua circulando dentro do estabelecimento, pedindo dinheiro aos clientes, evidenciando a completa ausência de controle e segurança no local. Em meio a tudo isso, encontramos até uma barata, algo totalmente inadmissível. Fomos esperando uma boa experiência, mas foi extremamente decepcionante.
reviews.author: Paty Santana

reviews.text:
O lugar só vale a pena pela beleza do prédio e espaços instagramáveis.
O atendimento é muito ruim. Nosso primeiro pedido veio faltando 4 itens e demoraram muito pra resolver. No segundo pedido da sobremesa enviaram a casquinha derretida no copo, pedi pra trocar e entregaram a casquinha sem caramelo dentro. Quando fui reclamar minha casquinha passou de mão em mão, deram uma borrifada de caramelo e devolveram pra eu comer. Quando falei que não ia aceitar, a atendente das sobremesas foi desagradável comigo nas palavras e ainda ficou encarando. Muito triste um lugar tão lindo e com uma equipe tão despreparada.
reviews.author: Viviane De Paula Martins

reviews.text:
Fui a noite com Meus filhos ,sobrinho e amiga ,em número. Determinado momento fecharam as portas imaginávamos que estava para fechar (aparentemente apenas um Controle de público ) .
Falei para minha amiga que ia ao banheiro, tenho problema renal ,estava tudo fechado e alegaram que estava interditado por estar sem água.
Tivemos que sair desesperadamente a procura de um Banheiro na estação do metro .
Sem palavras ,péssima gestão.
Lanche frio os painéis de pedido 90%desativados ,horrível, só vale a pena a fotografia que a loja é  linda mas só isso mesmo .
reviews.author: grace raphael

reviews.text:
Se apropriaram de 100 reais meus!

Totem travou, paguei e não saiu confirmação nem número de pedido. Procurei o gerente Fran- Francisco, que disse que “não constava nada no sistema” e que o valor seria estornado, que deveria aguardar prazo do cartao, então confiei e refiz o pedido. Depois, a cobrança apareceu e agora a loja não quer devolver, dizendo que falta evidência porque eu não fiz “prova” na hora — sendo que eu só segui a orientação do próprio gerente. Resultado: ficaram com mais de R$ 100 meus. Atendimento e pós-venda péssimos
reviews.author: Lilian Brandão

reviews.text:
If I could give zero starts, I would:
1. It took 50 minutes for our food to be ready.
2. When it was ready, they got 2 orders wrong. By the time we were able to eat everything was mushy and cold.
3. There was water all over the stairs, and even though I asked them to just dry it because it was a hazard, they just didn’t care.
4. At the exit, I went for an ice-cream, but couldn’t get it.
Service was awful, people were super disrespectful, and just the worst experience in São  Paulo.
DONT GO
reviews.author: Aline Dala Valle

reviews.text:
Lugar que vive apenas do hype das redes sociais, mas o atendimento, nota ZERO!
Mais de 15 minutos em uma fila que não tinha atendente nenhum.
Fiquei na fila do Mc café por 15 minutos (sem nenhum atendente) depois de perguntar para o segurança se não tinha atendimento, vem uma pessoa e diz: o caixa está fechado.
Além das redes sociais, é necessário ter o mínimo de atenção/ atendimento ao cliente.

Se não tem atendimento, melhor não ter o Mc café lá 🤷🏻‍♂️
reviews.author: Marcos A.R.E.

reviews.text:
O Pior McDonald's que já fui na minha vida!
Tive problemas com 3 totens de venda. No 3°, descontou do meu cartão mas o pedido não saiu e apresentou erro. Fui informado que o prazo era de 24 horas para o estorno. No final, não obtive reembolso e ainda tive que voltar e consumir o valor descontado para não perder o dinheiro.
Muita cheio, poucas pessoas para atender. O lanche vem faltando as coisas, não vem completo. Experiência horrível!
reviews.author: Igor Dias

reviews.text: I came here with my kids and was so  disappointed that after all the trouble and long lines to get our meals my son's Happy meal was missing the fries and the toy.  There were  2 associates collecting "costumer service" answers from a table  next to me and I showed them the empty box. Instead of doing anything  they  just kept talking to the couple next to us and told me to go  downstairs and get it myself. Terrible costumer service!
reviews.author: Ana Cooper

reviews.text: The worst McDonald’s EVER! We were extremely excited to visit and order from here but, as it turned out, the worst experience: they forgot our French fries, our McNuggets’ sauces (paid for an extra one too) and everything that was deep fried, tasted bitter (McNuggets and Banana Pie). Their oil needed changing and as a result, completely destroyed our experience there. Sorry, we are not visiting this location in the future again.
reviews.author: Liv Lo

reviews.text:
Experiência mais horrível que tive em toda minha vida
Lanchonete lotada, sem funcionários suficientes pra atender altíssima demanda. Mais de 1 hora para receber os lanches . Refrigerante pura agua com gas e corante .Falta total de organização e preparo.  Pelo preço que pagamos deveriam ter o mínimo de consideração por quem sustenta tudo isso.
Primeira vez que vim e saio daqui hj bem decepcionada com o que vi.
reviews.author: Patricia Martins

reviews.text:
Sinceramente não gostei , levei minha filha hoje pretendíamos fazer fotos conhecer o ambiente e fomos abordadas por uma funcionária muito mau educada que ficou repetindo inúmeras vezes que não estava aberto para entrar .
Engraçado que as portas estavam abertas ,não tinha sinalização de limpeza ou área interditada .
Enfim saímos decepcionadas e comemos numa barraquinha ali perto.
reviews.author: Glaucia Cristina

reviews.text:
The place is amazing, no doubt about that.
The food is normal.
But the service is terrible. Super unfriendly. I received my food on a tray that was completely dirty with crumbs of someone else's burger and dried up ketchup. Those trays are always put away on top of the bin. So a minimum of hygiene really is a must. Disgusting, no other words to describe this.
reviews.author: Alexis

reviews.text: Todas, absolutamente TODAS as vezes que fui ali o meu pedido veio com algum problema (errado, faltando, molhado, etc...). Para mim é cômodo pois trabalho bem próximo, mas eu recomendo andar mais um pouco e ir no mequi do lado do shopping center 3, que além de ser mais vazio o pedido vem bem melhor. Esse mequi 1000 é o famoso "bonitinho, mas ordinário".

reviews.text: Nunca comi um @MCDONALD'S tão ruim e sem gosto. A caixa estava aberta e suja. O cardápio não era o que pedimos, o frango parecia uma tábua e estava frio, provavelmente de ontem. Eu gosto do #McDonald's, mas esta é a primeira e última vez no Brasil. Além disso, ninguém limpa 🤮 e não falam inglês, nem mesmo palavras simples como açúcar e leite de soja.

reviews.text: Ambiente muito bonito, ótimo para tirar fotos. Mas o atendimento é péssimo, os totens estão sempre fora de sistema. Tenho redução de mobilidade, fui pegar a fila preferêncial e o ATENDENTE SIMPLESMENTE RIU DA MINHA CARA DIZENDO QUE EU NÃO SOU PREFERÊNCIAL!!! Mesmo eu tendo laudo médico... muito bom conhecer o lugar, mas não pretendo voltar...

reviews.text: Foi a pior experiência em drivetrue que tivemos, ficamos mais de 30min para ser atendido, não tinha ninguém na cabine, tivemos que descer do carro para solicitar atendimento e mesmo assim demorou para vir uma pessoa nos atender. Como se já não bastasse entregaram as batatas e lanches frios e ainda um lanche a menos que o solicitado no pedido.

reviews.text: Eu, minha esposa e nossos amigos estávamos muito ansiosos para conhecer o Méqui Mil, porém foi muito ruim, o lanche estava frio, o ambiente estava sujo e tivemos que usar o banheiro para deficientes, muito sujo e a descarga não funciona, tirei algumas fotos. Pensei que por ser na PAULISTA, deveria ser impecável.

reviews.text: Too dirty dirty dirty, too much people yes but need mor people to clean fast, more more. No security too upstairs, bathroom its better to do all at street. Yo have a 1000 m2 store and have a two meters table to pick up your order, when its full its a disaster. Escales.

reviews.text: A comida estava horrível. O hambúrguer estava frio, as batatas fritas não estavam frescas e a apresentação era deprimente. O atendimento no balcão também foi péssimo. Uma experiência ruim, mesmo sabendo que o Mequi1000 é uma “atração turística” da cidade.

reviews.text:
Pelo ambiente e pela experiência nao vale , loja demorada, loja totalmente suja, banheiros sem água péssima experiência.

E um extra não poderam lavar a mamadeira do meu filho, pois alegaram que estava cheio, detalhe não tinha água em nenhum banheiro.

reviews.text: Unbelievably bad. 14 payment terminals with 4 working as the don't want orders due to staffing. Unbelievably bad service unbelievably bad experience. This is a shame as it's obviously a big McDonald's with an entire make over for Minecraft.

reviews.text: Essa é a realidade do Méqui Mil, essa é o banheiro para PCD. Já os outros banheiros que ficam no primeiro andar estão com acesso bloqueado. A empresa se beneficia com o estabelecimento lotado, entretanto, não há um local para lavar as mãos.

reviews.text:
Not good.

They lost my order and, after I called them out, gave it to me incomplete.
I had to go to other part of the store to get my coffee.
Good for pictures not for lunch.

reviews.text: They got my order wrong. I got a regular sandwich when I ordered a much more expensive premium one. The decor is nice and the location is great. However, the food quality is sub-standard and it's over priced.

reviews.text:
UM LIXO!

Funcionários com o atendimento péssimo, restaurante sujo, banheiros lamentáveis e sem papel higiênico!
Gente, como pode?

Em um dos endereços mais frequentados de São Paulo, o MEQUI1000 um lixo!

reviews.text: No soap and toilets were defect. I received the wrong order - instead of cheese ball just two pieces of bread with some cheese cream in between (totally different from what was advertised). Not tasty.

reviews.text: Bad attitude from very young staff. Coffee was very bitter. Didn't offer typical McDonald's breakfast. I settled for a ham/cheese stuffed hot pocket..it was cold on the inside. Would never return.

reviews.text:
El Segundo peor Macdonald's de la ARGENTINA, Desastre! Falta de respeto, sin una autoridad competente que de la cara, dicen que determinados días es de 24 hs , entras a comer a las 22.30 hs, hora normal de pedir un combo en Buenos Aires ( aclaro, los famosos días que son de 24hs), del piso superior prácticamente te barren debajo de los pies para liberar completamente ese piso y que quede planta baja, donde hay pocas mesas y donde 23:00 hs sin aviso previo te cierran con sillas ("PB") y te van achicando los espacios y se ponen a pasar el lampazo mientras cenas, en una actitud odiosa, sin respeto, sin las mínimas normas de bioseguridad, se supone que si estás comiendo no se deberían poner a limpiar al lado tuyo volatilizando gérmenes y demás cosas, donde está Salubridad? Bromatología?, a dónde está Higiene y Seguridad? Es tremenda la experiencia, Nefasta! Lo que se vive en ese Macdonals sobre todo de noche.
En el medio se mezclan personas en situacion de calle (Fisuras) , Seres humanos Neurodivergentes en situacion de absoluta precariedad y vulnerabilidad, con sus bolsas y ropas, tratando de ocupar los pocos lugares de allí adentro para dormir sentados, Seres humanos que no tienen la culpa y que requieren de Asistencia Social o algo, Donde esta la Fundación Ronald Macdonalds? El Gobierno de la Ciudad, etc, pleno obelisco, La ventana al mundo! De un comercio internacional, prácticamente esa Sucursal es un Hospital de día en todo su magnificencia, entre eso, los empleados barriendo y cerrandote los pocos lugares que quedan, de noche es una mezcla de vivencias como si estuvieras entre la serie de...Los Juegos del hambre y el Juego del Calamar, realmente Épico y Cinematográfico, uno de los empleados ,hasta tuvo el descaro de decirme que era un " lugar de comidas rápidas! y al paso" y que... una vez que se cena "inmediatamente" hay que levantarse e irse, no es un lugar... para hacer sobremesa por más mínimo que sea.
A lo que le respondí, pero con todo lo que gaste y comí, necesito dijerir un poco antes de irme, por favor..🙏
A lo que insistió 😬 que esto.. no es un Restaurante!...para hacer sobremesa!.
🤦Tremendo, ni loco me quedaba a pedir un café después de la cena.
Eso es la experiencia Macdonals? Maltrato, violencia, descaro , falta de ubicación y  respeto.
No comprendo está nueva Misión y Visión de la empresa, no la entiendo, ni la comparto.
Es una Gran Pena.
reviews.author: Dey D

reviews.text:
Soy un cliente fiel de McDonald’s desde hace años. Siempre que viajo a alguna ciudad donde haya un local, en cualquier parte del mundo, lo visito porque disfruto de la experiencia y confío en la marca. Sin embargo, lo vivido hoy fue, sin dudas, la peor experiencia que tuve en un McDonald’s.

Para empezar, el local estaba absolutamente sucio y descuidado. Fui con una embarazada al baño y me encontré con que no había papel higiénico, no había canilla para lavarse las manos y el lugar estaba sucio y con muy mal olor. Lo más sorprendente es que, al solicitar papel, simplemente me entregaron servilletas, algo inadmisible para un local de este nivel.

Luego, al pedir la comida, la demora fue excesiva. McDonald’s siempre fue sinónimo de rapidez y eficiencia, pero esta vez tardaron muchísimo sin ninguna explicación. Cuando finalmente trajeron el pedido, había solicitado el combo de Stranger Things, justamente por la propuesta y el marketing que lo acompaña, y no me entregaron el packaging correspondiente, lo cual arruinó aún más la experiencia.

La comida llegó fría, las papas estaban sin sal, blandas, frías y con gusto a viejas. Realmente nada estuvo a la altura de lo que uno espera de McDonald’s.

Me voy muy desilusionado. Siempre fui un gran recomendador de la marca, pero esta vez la experiencia fue completamente negativa. Espero sinceramente que situaciones así no vuelvan a repetirse, porque afectan la confianza de quienes elegimos McDonald’s justamente por su calidad, estándares y consistencia en todo el mundo.
reviews.author: Francisco Carrara

reviews.text: Fuimos el martes en la mañana a comer el combo de stranger things (el cual no parece en la foto por qué le falta el packaging) habíamos pedido por la aplicación para que llegáramos y sea más rápido, estuvimos esperando 1 hora. 1 HORA. Al principio se entendía recién arrancaban y estaban con los desayunos, pusieron mil excusas, había una sola chica atendiendo, que nos preguntó todo lo que tenía el pedido. Cuando por fin llegó las papas fritas tenían MOSQUITAS (como se ve en la foto) el cheddar estaba helado y ni para llevar nos lo pusieron. Yo ya había ido el lunes en la mañana a desayunar un sanguche con huevo cuando termine comiendo algo crujiente que era un cáscara de huevo enorme, no tienen mucho control de lo que sale, la encargada trató super mal a la pobre chica que recién arrancaba su turno en conjunto con ella nos habló mal a nosotras también, diciendo que la máquina de helados todavía no estaba lista y que si lo pagábamos ella no iba a estar devolviendo ninguna plata ni entregando ningún producto. Es un horror este lugar de los peores Macdonald’s que fui, entras a comer algo al paso y de repente tenes gente en situación de calle durmiendo al lado tuyo pidiéndote comida. Si les agarra el bajón en la noche cocinen en casa no hagan como yo.

-Recomiendo la cheesecake con frutos rojos-

Al final terminé comiendo en otro lugar.

In english:
I was unfortunate enough to find myself on a weekday almost midnight in front of the establishment, thinking I could enjoy the menu. What I got was a total absence of attention, a long wait, and other diners in the same situation.
Eventually I ended up eating somewhere else.

El McDonald’s más bizarro del mundo.

En la entrada principal, se ve que sacaron la basura y los jugos de basura se derramaron en la entrada, del lado de la calle, entonces hay que bordear o brincar el lago de agua de basura. Un asco.

reviews.text:
¿En qué momento McDonald’s se comenzo a acabar en Colombia? Era bueno ¿que le paso?

No volvere en mi vida

Felipe Barmar
Crítico  –

Fui al McDonald’s de la 93 con amigos, sabiendo que iba a arrepentirme. Y no falló. El AutoMac era una escena absurda: carros esperando por eternidades, empleados desbordados, pedidos confundidos.

Pedí una McNífica. Recibí una hamburguesa seca, sin sabor, mal empacada. Las papas, frías. Los conos, derretidos. Uno lo tiraron por error. Nadie usa guantes. Nadie se disculpa. Nadie parece importarles.

No fue un mal día. Es un mal lugar. Y lo ha sido durante años. Este punto se volvió el símbolo del deterioro de la marca: promesas globales con ejecución desastrosa.

En que McDonald’s se comenzo a dañar  en Colombia.
Y la calle 93 es su vitrina más triste.

Empleados maleducados, cero cuidado y pésima atención.
Dejo la foto de cómo debería verse la hamburguesa… y cómo me la entregaron.
Además, terminé con dolor de estómago. Así no se puede.
reviews.author: Felipe Barrera Guía gastronómica La Ruta

reviews.text: 1. Horrible quality of burger. I specially asked for burger pictured in menu and received a flat, sad, and low quality burger. 2. No toilet paper and a way of drying hands in women's bathroom. My wife also said bathroom were dirty. 3. There were at least 7 children beggars entered asking for donations, food, selling pencils, coloring books, etc. I was really concerned after saying 'NO' each child would look at our possessions and baby stroller as if it was worth stealing. I spoke to the manager very nice about it and she was sorry for the bad experience. She said they only had 1 guard to keep beggars out and previous instantances the beggars pulled out knifes, screw drivers, and other weapons. This McDonald's is in an upscale location that our expectations was higher but it's worst than McDonald's in risky areas.

reviews.text:
First of all, thanks for offering the possibility for ordering in English. However, most of the steps in the ordering process are still in Spanish. If you have no spanish proficiency at all, it is useless. The provided pictures are all from the English menu 😅.

Secondly, we asked the order to be brought to our table and took a number. Even so, I heard our order number being called out. It was not being brought to our table, I came to get it myself.

Finally, and most importantly, I am used to McDonalds having a consistent quality of food. All around the world, you know what to expect, and you get what you expect. Except for this place: the chicken nuggets were not crispy anymore, the fries were soft, and the coca cola was served lukewarm and without ice.

The second chance occurred when I ordered a McFlurry. Again, I waited for 15 minutes. When I went to the pickup counter, they sent me to the ice-cream counter. At the ice-cream counter, they send me back to the main counter. Finally, someone started to acknowledge that I didn't get my icecream and started making it. When it was finally delivered, it felt like it wasn't a full portion.. see picture.

Do not expect the usual McDonald's quality.
reviews.author: Joep van der Weijden

reviews.text:
Minimal training of staff, who are nice but sluggish at best.  Certainly NOT the "gringo" version of this restaurant.
Serving food hot is optional and accidental in Peru.  Be prepared to be served many things tepid.  You might think French Fries need to be hot, but no, not here.  This and all other McDonald's'  in Peru never got the memo concerning the importance of serving their items hot.

Retarded management knows they can hire these employees at about $1 per hour so they flood the zone with crew.  Yet they are always "in the weeds". Corporate doesn't seem to mind or care about this market too much, that is, they threw all restaurant concepts overboard when the sleek marketing metrics arrived.  Why care about product quality when you can quickly determine which ad campaigns are driving eaters into the shop?

Sluggish, tepid, and sometimes alarmingly unfresh.  Brace yourself. Open 24 hours! Prices are about what you would expect, but a VERY limited selection--NO shakes!

reviews.text:
El día de hoy pase por el Automac, antes de ir revise en Internet el horario del lugar y decía que estaba abierto...
Cuando llegue habían dos carros delante de mi y observe que los atendieron con completa normalidad, me acerco yo a la bocina, espere al rededor de 10 minutos y no me atendían.
Un trabajador paso cerca del carro así que le pregunte si no había servicio a lo que el me responde: "SI, QUE PENA, YA MISMO TE ATIENDO"...
Espere un rato mas, y escucho por la bocina una voz de una muchacha que me dice algo inentendible; le doy los buenos dias y paso a decirle cual es mi orden... no me contesta mas.
Otro momento después vuelve a hablar y me dice de forma muy grosera que el restaurante no tiene servicio, yo molesta le digo que si debía esperar media hora para que ella me diera esa indicación, a lo que ella muy grosera me responde: "Si, demalas" y procede a colgarme...
Yo entiendo que no tengan servicio, lo que no entiendo es cual es la razón de dejar esperando a un cliente y atenderlo de mala manera, como si fuera culpa del cliente que ellos no tengan atención y sus horarios de Google diga que si?
Siempre que voy al automac y me atiende un muchacho, el es super amable, pero cuando voy y esta la muchacha es un fastidio, es super grosera y déspota.
Me da pesar, puede ser que no le guste su trabajo y por eso tenga tan mal servicio al cliente, pero eso se soluciona buscando otro trabajo que si le guste o cambiando de actitud para que su amargura no le amargue el rato a una persona que solo quiere desayunar antes de ir al trabajo...

reviews.text: I moved here from Arizona 2yrs ago. This McDonalds is in the “Scottsdale” part of Medellin & is a nice place but the service has been terrible every time I’ve come here. I ordered a sausage McMuffin w/ egg & part of the muffin was missing. I ordered 2 coffee’s & asked for sugar & was told they didn’t have any but only had Splenda (my mind was blown to be told that a McDonalds was OUT of sugar) then the mgr told her there was and then she brought us the sugar. They NEVER bring you napkins or condiments w/ your food withOUT having to ask for them. I’ve had to speak w/ the manager a few times but she blamed the poor service here on corporate. She also said she would talk to the employees. On my last visit, there were other extranjeros that ordered a Sausage McMuffin w/ egg but was brought without egg. A lot of Americans come here but the service here is extremely unacceptable and this is the closest location to Bello for breakfast. It was a battle asking for a refill of coffee. The cashier told me that only coffee was free but withOUT creamer. Corporate please step in. These employees need to be retrained or something.

Fui hoy sobre las 2 de la tarde. ¡¡¡¡Una terrible cola de personas que quieren hacer un pedido en línea desde el teléfono, y el personal decidió organizar una conferencia sobre cómo usarlo, me quedé durante 20 minutos, viendo a la gente en 2025 se comportan como si por primera vez ver esta máquina para ordenar, fui al mostrador para hacer un pedido y pagar en efectivo, pero me negué !!!!.
¡La razón no se me explicó, y ahora pensar en la lógica de estos trabajadores, es decir, para ellos es mejor si usted está parado en una cola todo el día, que para aceptar la orden y dinero en efectivo!
Estúpidos y no orientados al cliente, muy mala gestión.
¡¡¡¡Por cierto, los empleados están constantemente en horas de descanso, gritando y bromeando entre ellos como si no estuvieran en el trabajo sino en un parque de atracciones!!!!.
Los empleados sois el colmo y vuestro jefe también.
reviews.author: E L

reviews.text:
Increíble que en el automac de hoy 2 de agosto a las 12:48 "Andy" el vendedor fuera han grosero, se le pidió 2 hamburguesas en combo y responde de muy mala manera que no hay que busque en la aplicación. No sé estaba buscando promociones solo 2 hamburguesas en combo.
Cuando dice que las que están exhibidas se pueden pedir en combo miramos y responde como que hágalo rápido y que si no sabíamos que pedir que retrocedieramos (no se podía) entonces que avanzaramos, le pedí el nombre y solo dijo "Andy" después se un rato y que si teníamos algún problema que habláramos con el supervisor; supervisor que nunca salió y nadie dió respuesta de esta mala atención.
Ni a este ni a otro Macdonald
Que falta de respeto con los clientes 🤦🏻‍♀️
reviews.author: Taty Alcaraz

reviews.text: I went to have lunch there today. After almost 3 months of having my lunch daily on there.... I asked kindly for more ketchup, but the managger called luisa denied my request. She preffered to sell me this ketchup. I only required 1 bag of ketchup. Instead of giving it to me, they charge me 2.000 cop for additional ketchup. (The option of aditional ketchup is not listed on the register its mean to be free with your order) I had paid for the aditional ketchup but is te last time i go to this precise mcdonalds. Also there is a lot of staff there but there is no customer service. All the staff was there just speaking between them while the customers wait. 0 STARS
reviews.author: John Vangrieken

reviews.text: Hotrible expérience, il y avait des cheveux dans les frite et le burger était froid, perzonne ne parle un mot d'anglais, Fernanda Luisa la responsable est d'une arrogance extrême, elle m'a demander de supprimer les photos que j'ai prise et a refuser de me changer dans un premier temps tous le menu, elle a estimer bon de ne changer que le burger, j'ai du demander a changer les frites, mais j'ai aussi fais de meme pour le coca, elle me disait qu'il n'y avait pas de cheveux dans le coca, j'ai pas reussi a manger le nouveau menu, j'ai préféré le donner au mendiant devant, de plus AUCUNE EXCUSE DE SA PART MAIS JUSTE QUELQUES SOUPIRES ET DES SOURIRES MOQUEURS
reviews.author: Sofiane EL HABBAZI

reviews.text:
Worst McDonald’s food I’ve ever had. Fries were awfully cold. Burger was 2 hours old, probably. Also cold. Awful awful awful. I wish I could refund this. Terrible experience.

Update: it was so bad that I ordered an Uber to go back to the restaurant and return my meal. I had to pay for my replacement, which I offered to anyway, but I would never, ever, trust delivery from this franchise ever again.

Don’t order delivery from here. They will give you the oldest fries and burger. AWFUL location. The franchisee should be disenfranchised for allowing this.

I will be submitting a review to McDonalds corporate as well.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Fui dos veces em la misma semana y  las dos me fui sin comprar. La primera se rompió una parrilla y había que esperar entre 10 a 20 minutos en el automac. Hoy, fue la segunda, tenía dos cupones por la app, uno me lo tomo y el otro decía que era invalido, le pregunte a la chica, busque tiros cupones en la app (cupon automac) y me decía lo mismo. La chica no me colaboraba con nada. No me daba otras opciones, y solo se quedaba callada, seguía intentando con 4 distintos y pedía si podía no ser con qr sino con el código se abajo, 0 soluciones la que me atendió. Cancele el pedido. 0 ganas de trabajar.

Sale el chico y me entrega el vaso sin tapa, le confirmo que es para llevar, me dice q toca así q porque no tenían, lo empaca en bolsa de papel 🤷🏼‍♀️ y les digo como me voy a llevar eso así... Osea que falta de proactividad, si no hay las tapitas y bolsitas con separadores, al menos empaquen en un vaso de gaseosa con tapa, sean recursivos perooo no y muevale q hay fila 🥹 q decepción. reviews.text:
2 de 2 veces sin servicio a las 23:55 en menos de una semana.

Primera visita nocturna: sin servicio pasada la media noche.

Segunda visita nocturna, sin autoservicio. Tras más de 20 minutos de espera en caja, pasamos del “esperemos que vuelva pronto el sistema” a “mejor vaya a otra parte: ni idea de a qué hora vuelve”.

Hoy, la tercera y vencida: 23:55 y ya sin servicio.

No sé si compartimos el mismo concepto de “24 horas” 🤔

reviews.text: If you’re expecting McDonald’s as you know it from the states, think again. The food doesn’t even come close. I don’t know how they managed to ruin pre manufactured food. I usually don’t eat the junk but I know very well how it should taste. The food here is terrible!! Dry burgers and unrecognizable fries. All of this compiled with terrible service. I only came here because it was the only thing open .

reviews.text: This place is always HORRIBLY busy.  I chose to walk in but I regret, there were about 30 people starring at the order monitor but there were no order number at all.  After close to 40 minutes waiting for my 2 meals with 2 fries no salt, end up I got salt all over my hand and the food I got was cold.  Asked to change the hot fries with no salt and complained I had been waiting for my food over 30 mins.  The manager gave an attitude, "it is not my problem, we were busy", I said "so is that my problem? you are the manager on duty and not responsible the human power?"  She turned around and shout "it's not my problem, give her something hot".  I am patience enough to wait more than 30 mins for FAST FOOD and I deserve to receive this kind of "Customer service"????  The manager was trying to hide when I was taking her picture for evidence.  And other manager on duty was trying to cover her and asked me am I using human right.  There is nothing to do with human right but I was not treated right.  I brought it up to McDonald Headquarter about the incident I experienced at this location and asked for refund coz I threw them away.  The headquarter told me this restaurant manager would contact me within 10 business days but I never receive any phone call or email.  I received 2 meal coupons from Headquarter as a refund.  I will never ever come back again.  P.S. This restaurant is always full of garbage everywhere and no one was doing cleaning.
reviews.author: Me Me

reviews.text:
I came here to pick up an Uber Eats order and had a really bad experience. In the Uber app it clearly says that after 8 PM, orders should be picked up from the drive-thru. I followed the instructions, but the guy working there, named Chetanbir, was extremely rude.

When I showed him the Uber notes, he still refused to give me the order and said, “I will not give it, I am working here now. If you want it, come inside, otherwise cancel the order.” That’s not how you talk to people. Instead of helping, he started arguing with me, saying bad things about Uber drivers, like we don’t deserve respect.

Then it went even further—he insulted my family, including my mother, and even threatened to call 911 for no reason at all. This was shocking and very disrespectful. No one should have to go through that while just trying to do their job.

I recorded the whole thing on video, so I have proof of how badly he behaved. Honestly, McDonald’s should not keep people like this representing their store. I hope the manager looks into this because drivers like me just want to pick up food and move on, not be disrespected and abused. If the manager wants to see the video, please contact me and I can share it.
reviews.author: Sukhman singh Narang

reviews.text:
I am a regular late-night customer at this location, but what I’ve experienced recently has been extremely disappointing and unprofessional. Within the past month, I’ve witnessed behavior from the late-night manager, a woman named Sahil, that is completely unacceptable in a customer service role.

While I was dining in, I clearly overheard her gossiping with staff, using foul language, cussing about customers, and openly complaining in a sarcastic and negative tone. She had no idea I was listening, yet continued to speak this way in front of both staff and customers. As a paying guest, it was shocking and honestly very disrespectful.

This is not what customer service in Canada should represent. A manager sets the tone for the entire team, and when the person in charge is openly insulting customers and behaving unprofessionally, it ruins the entire atmosphere of the restaurant.

I strongly urge the GM of this location to address this issue immediately. Staff need to be reminded that customers come first, and that professionalism, respect, and courtesy are non-negotiable. If this behavior continues, it will drive loyal customers away.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.text: Been an avid customer of McDonald kerrisdale location for a decade. Today I’m so disappointed for I ordered iced coffee fries and nuggets I their drive thru… the staff forgot to hand me my coffee for she seems busy talking to her colleagues or over the head set… I got my fries it’s saggy already I guest passed the holding time… nuggets not that fresh… today seems not a good day. Called their phone number, talked to the lady named sukh claiming she’s the manager… for I asked for the manager she said she is the store manager so I asked her again … she then asked for my name and spelled it out to her several times she still got it wrong saying it. She didn’t apologized she just insisted that the crew told me to wait for the iced coffee. Anyhow it’s disappointing the way she deal with me I think the store need to review how to deal with customers and how you do the customer service thing. For at first you apologized to the custome and you don’t argue… not coming back there again. I just missed the old crew who listens and very attentive now a days it changed so much bunch of youngsters who need to be taught customer service etiquette!
reviews.author: Rosale Lamason

reviews.text:
I was very upset and concerned to see a young employee handling ready-to-eat breakfast food with his bare hands and without wearing gloves.  Shouldn’t tongs be used to handle ready-to-eat foods like eggs and sausages, instead of bare hands? I was standing there waiting for my order for several minutes, and I saw him repeatedly picking up eggs with his hands, folding the sausage and placing it on the bagel, and covering it with the bun — all entirely with his bare hands.
I was so uncomfortable that I spoke to someone I believe was the manager. She told me that they use a timer for proper handwashing and that employees are allowed to handle food with bare hands.
This experience was very disappointing. I have always trusted McDonald’s as a company with well-trained staff and strong food safety standards. However, after seeing this with my own eyes—and hearing more and more negative reports—I am now very concerned about food safety.
I found this experience very unpleasant and unhygienic. Would you feel comfortable eating food handled this way? There are invisible germs that cannot be seen, and this raises serious concerns.
reviews.author: Aifen Situ

reviews.text: Consistently below average. Been going to this one for years because i live near by and the last few years have been terrible. Slow service. Major long wait times for drive thru. At least 50% chance your order will be wrong or missing something. Adjust anything if your order and expect it to be wrong. If you're looking for fast food at night, this isn't the place to go. You would have a quicker bite at subway or even a sit down restaurant nearby later at night. Screwed up my order one too many times. Ordered two burgers with meal last time. Got the wrong toppings on each (Angus and seriously chicken have choices), missing a box of fries, and had an extra burger (which was good I guess). Tonight, I saw the manger trying but the staff is incompetent. Again, my burger which was supposed to grilled ends up crispy. I waited 30 minutes in line, and 10 minutes after paying at the last window to still get the wrong order. Cold hard fries, no straw for drink. Messed up burger order.
reviews.author: N Y

reviews.text: Honestly I always thought it was a slightly below average McDonald's but the last two times I had horrible experiences. Last time the tables were extremely dirty and the staff didn't seem to care about it (even when covid is still a thing) and they took over 20 min in a McFlury.... I complained 3 times and only after the third time they did something about it (talk about fast food). The time before that one, the tables were super messy again and the trash was full and they didn't care to change it the whole time I was there. I think McDonald's is a great fast food chain restaurant, but this location is just a disgrace
reviews.author: alejandro mercado

reviews.text:
One of the nastiest branches. I had to ask them 3 times to give me a clean tray. First time the cashier guy had the audacity to give me a tray with an oiled paper and food residuals that is obviously not cleaned after being used by another diner. I asked to change it. He went back and changed the paper again with the same food pieces on the tray. I asked another lady to clean it. She wiped it, changed the paper and hand it back to me. It's just nasty and oily.
Regarding the food, the bread of egg and cheese mcmuffin was mushy and not roasted at all. Just soggy and a little wet. Too bad this is happening to McDonald's
reviews.author: Mohamed Ezzat

reviews.text:
Sad. Just sad. If you’re experiencing excessive happiness, this place will solve that for you. It starts with a long order placement wait time (took 5 minutes for cashier to even show up) and borderline theft in the form of automatic credit card charges when you’re standing there with a gift card. Then they take an excessive amount of time to give you a sad burger and some of the saddest fries known to man. This place used to be good, but now it’s truly awful.

The one star they get is out of pity for the manager who’s faced with grossly insufficient staff.

UPDATE (3/2024): the Coke machine is now broken as well
reviews.author: RandomAlpaca

reviews.text:
I’m quite disappointed with the experience here. This is a multicultural space, and I believe the staff should be more mindful of the environment. During my visit, Punjabi music was being played at an extremely loud volume, making it very difficult to enjoy a peaceful meal.

While I appreciate cultural diversity, there should be a basic level of respect for all customers  not everyone may be comfortable with such loud music in a dining area. I sincerely hope management takes this feedback seriously and creates a more inclusive and pleasant atmosphere moving forward

reviews.text: A disgrace.  I really do love McDonald's in general, but this is definitely the worst one I've been to.  Orders constantly wrong or missing something (egg BLT with missing egg, Caesar salad with no bacon and/or croutons, no napkins or straws...), waiting for up to 40 minutes for a simple order (!), super unfriendly staff (got a coupon for complaining on the website, then had to get into an argument with the manager who didn't want to accept the coupon)... It doesn't seem to matter whether it's night or day, busy or slow; it's always frustrating.

Zero service. Had to flag them down and watch as they had no organization.
Highly recommend either training/better system/ or just go to a different McDonald’s.

reviews.text:
I work on the block so I am here pretty often. It's a Food Court McDonald's so the bar is already pretty low and I have come to terms with that being part of the arrangement on convenience.

But there is only so long you can line up and just accept that you will get what you get.

I've noticed in the last several months, they have prompted their cashiers to start peppering the customers with questions. Are you collecting points with the app? NO. How many ketchups do you want? NONE. How many napkins? TWO. I don't blame the cashiers, I don't think they have a choice, but now, asking me what type of pop I am going to get? What difference does it make? You are handing me an empty cup, you can press whatever button you want, it doesn't matter. Unless you are going to come around and fill it up for me, you don't need to know. I might take one shot of each of the pops, I might eat the cup, who knows!

The straw that broke the camel's back for me was tonight though. I have had too many warm cokes because they can't keep the ice machine running. I'm standing there, like an idiot, pressing my cup against the handle waiting for ice and nothing. I asked the supervisor if they have anything back there, ice in a jug, crushed ice, anything that would save me from a warm drink. NOPE, apparently they have to truck the ice in from across the food court somewhere and she needs to find someone to go get it.

What a mess. This place was already circling the drain on service, but now I can't even depend on them for ice. I suppose this is a positive for me, I'll put in more steps walking somewhere else.

You got me right there girl, I am happy that I made your day with the amount of proud and provocation I saw in that face you were making we almost looked at each other for a good minute as if you were expecting me to make a fool of myself for that paper bag. reviews.text:
Dear McDonald’s Surfers Paradise Team,

I am writing to formally raise a serious concern following my visit to your restaurant yesterday.

While waiting for my lunch order, I witnessed a staff member — visible from the front counter — coughing repeatedly while handling food in the kitchen area.

Disturbed by this, I asked the manager whether this particular individual would be preparing my meal. I was reassured that he would not be.

However, despite this assurance, I saw the same person — the one who had been coughing — preparing what appeared to be my burger.

I felt extremely uncomfortable and unable to eat the meal as I had just witnessed him coughing without any attempt to shield his mouth or follow proper hygiene protocols.

I returned to the counter and requested a refund, explaining that I could not eat the food prepared by someone visibly unwell.

The staff member I spoke with apologised and claimed that the individual was actually the cleaner.

Regardless of their title, this person was clearly involved in food preparation.

To make matters worse, I overheard the manager shout, “Hey Nathan, you should be wearing a mask,” to which the individual responded with laughter and continued working — still coughing.

As a customer, I find this completely unacceptable. McDonald’s is a global brand known for upholding strict health and safety standards.

It is deeply concerning to see basic food safety practices so blatantly disregarded.

McDonald’s prides itself on the quality and safety of its food — but that commitment is undermined when sick staff are allowed to handle meals.

I trust this incident will be taken seriously, and I would appreciate a response outlining the steps being taken to ensure this does not happen again.

reviews.text:
Whoever was at the checkout tonight around 9pm needs to be trained or fired. I placed an order through the app and I had my order code. This is enough to get your order even when you are not using your phone's location to check into the restaurant. It literally says to just show the code to a crew member if you have any problem. I've done it many times before myself. This time I placed an order and my girlfriend went to pick it up for me, but the crew member refused to prepare the order by showing them the code. They insisted multiple times that it wasn't possible and that the only way was to complete the check-in using the smartphone's GPS inside the restaurant. This really pissed me off, as I even know first hand how to complete the order myself using their checkout screen as I have seen them doing it other times. They literally have a button that says "Mobile Order" and after they tap it they can introduce the order number as well as they get a list with the placed orders on the sidebar. Even a kid could do it. They just refused to do so.

There's no excuse for this. They cannot force customers to use their GPS as the only way to get their order, and the app itself offers alternatives for it. Whoever was working there, shouldn't be doing it anymore.

reviews.text: Horribly busy. Ordered 4 Sundays. No printer paper. Took 20 minutes, when it was ready had caramel all over the cups horribly. Then a older big women tried fixing it with a rag, did one and was like it wasn't cleaned. Horrible experience. You can cross the daintree river by ferry to and back quicker then this place. No drive through and can't handle it. Please don't go here! Please go to the one 2ks down the road. Also why shove the spoons into the end of a lardge caramel Sunday. I knew the person making had a disability wich is fine, but they need to be supervised. Don't leave them by themselves at the front in peak 6-7pm o'clock time. Manager needs to be sacked. Worst I've ever been too. Sticky hands. Simple quick order. Horrible. Literally will ruin your day in wich is a beatfull lagoon. Paid parking here too so speed needs to be imidiate.

reviews.text: The worker misunderstood our order, and put someone else’s coffee in our takeaway tray. My mum ordered it so I didn’t know that it wasn’t part of our meal. The worker came over and told us that we took someone else’s coffee, so we told her that it was part of our tray and we didn’t know that it was someone else. The waitress rolls her eye and gave us a very harsh attitude, so we got really confused. We are willing to pay for the extra coffee and their mistake, then the manager came and insisted that the order was right and that it was our fault that this whole thing happened. So this ended with them saying that we don’t need to pay for the coffee, which made us look like that we were trying to steal other people’s meal. Overall, the attitude of this maccas really disappointed me and the service is unbelievably bad. Really wish google could let me do a zero star for the service…
